class LeafClassifier(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__()
        self.margin_branch = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(64, 1024),
            nn.BatchNorm1d(1024),
            nn.Mish(),
            nn.Dropout(0.5),
        )
        self.shape_branch = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(64, 1024),
            nn.BatchNorm1d(1024),
            nn.Mish(),
            nn.Dropout(0.5),
        )
        self.texture_branch = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(64, 1024),
            nn.BatchNorm1d(1024),
            nn.Mish(),
            nn.Dropout(0.5),
        )

        self.main = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(3072, 2048),
            nn.BatchNorm1d(2048),
            nn.Mish(),
            nn.Dropout(0.6),
            nn.Linear(2048, 1024),
            nn.BatchNorm1d(1024),
            nn.Mish(),
            nn.Dropout(0.5),
            nn.Linear(1024, 99),
        )

        self.stochastic_depth = torch.rand(1).item()  # Initial depth probability

    def forward(self, x):
        # Split input into feature groups
        margin = self.margin_branch(x[:, :64])
        shape = self.shape_branch(x[:, 64:128])
        texture = self.texture_branch(x[:, 128:192])

        # Stochastic depth regularization
        if self.training:
            if torch.rand(1).item() < self.stochastic_depth:
                margin = torch.zeros_like(margin)
            if torch.rand(1).item() < self.stochastic_depth:
                shape = torch.zeros_like(shape)
            if torch.rand(1).item() < self.stochastic_depth:
                texture = torch.zeros_like(texture)

        combined = torch.cat([margin, shape, texture], dim=1)
        return self.main(combined)

class LabelSmoothingCrossEntropy(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, smoothing=0.1):
        super().__init__()
        self.confidence = 1.0 - smoothing
        self.smoothing = smoothing

    def forward(self, pred, target):
        log_probs = torch.nn.functional.log_softmax(pred, dim=-1)
        nll_loss = -log_probs.gather(dim=-1, index=target.unsqueeze(1))
        nll_loss = nll_loss.squeeze(1)
        smooth_loss = -log_probs.mean(dim=-1)
        loss = self.confidence * nll_loss + self.smoothing * smooth_loss
        return loss.mean()

class ResidualBlock(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, in_channels, out_channels, stride=1):
        super().__init__()
        self.conv1 = nn.Conv2d(
            in_channels, out_channels, 3, stride=stride, padding=1, bias=False
        )
        self.bn1 = nn.BatchNorm2d(out_channels)
        self.conv2 = nn.Conv2d(out_channels, out_channels, 3, padding=1, bias=False)
        self.bn2 = nn.BatchNorm2d(out_channels)
        self.shortcut = nn.Sequential()
        if stride != 1 or in_channels != out_channels:
            self.shortcut = nn.Sequential(
                nn.Conv2d(in_channels, out_channels, 1, stride=stride, bias=False),
                nn.BatchNorm2d(out_channels),
            )

    def forward(self, x):
        out = nn.ReLU()(self.bn1(self.conv1(x)))
        out = self.bn2(self.conv2(out))
        out += self.shortcut(x)
        return nn.ReLU()(out)


class LeafClassifier(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, num_features, num_classes):
        super().__init__()
        self.image_net = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Conv2d(1, 64, 3, padding=1, bias=False),
            nn.BatchNorm2d(64),
            nn.ReLU(),
            ResidualBlock(64, 64),
            nn.MaxPool2d(2),
            ResidualBlock(64, 128, stride=2),
            ResidualBlock(128, 256, stride=2),
            nn.AdaptiveAvgPool2d(1),
            nn.Flatten(),
        )
        self.feature_net = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(num_features, 1024),
            nn.BatchNorm1d(1024),
            nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Dropout(0.5),
            nn.Linear(1024, 512),
            nn.BatchNorm1d(512),
            nn.ReLU(),
        )
        self.classifier = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(512 + 256, 512),
            nn.BatchNorm1d(512),
            nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Dropout(0.3),
            nn.Linear(512, num_classes),
        )

    def forward(self, x_feat, x_img):
        img_features = self.image_net(x_img)
        tab_features = self.feature_net(x_feat)
        combined = torch.cat([tab_features, img_features], 1)
        return self.classifier(combined)

class LeafDataset(Dataset):
    def __init__(self, df, tabular_data, img_dir, mode="train"):
        self.df = df
        self.tabular_data = tabular_data
        self.img_dir = img_dir
        self.mode = mode
        self.augment = (
            transforms.Compose(
                [
                    transforms.RandomHorizontalFlip(p=0.5),
                    transforms.RandomRotation(30),
                    transforms.ColorJitter(
                        brightness=0.2, contrast=0.2, saturation=0.2
                    ),
                    transforms.Resize(380),
                    transforms.CenterCrop(380),
                    transforms.ToTensor(),
                    transforms.Normalize([0.485, 0.456, 0.406], [0.229, 0.224, 0.225]),
                ]
            )
            if mode == "train"
            else transforms.Compose(
                [
                    transforms.Resize(380),
                    transforms.CenterCrop(380),
                    transforms.ToTensor(),
                    transforms.Normalize([0.485, 0.456, 0.406], [0.229, 0.224, 0.225]),
                ]
            )
        )

    def __len__(self):
        return len(self.df)

    def __getitem__(self, idx):
        img_id = self.df.iloc[idx]["id"]
        img = Image.open(f"{self.img_dir}/{img_id}.jpg").convert("RGB")
        img = self.augment(img)
        tabular = self.tabular_data[idx]
        if self.mode == "test":
            return img, tabular
        return img, tabular, torch.tensor(self.df.iloc[idx]["label"])


class EnhancedLeafClassifier(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, num_classes, tabular_size):
        super().__init__()
        self.cnn = efficientnet_b4(weights=EfficientNet_B4_Weights.IMAGENET1K_V1)
        self.cnn.classifier = nn.Identity()
        self.tabular_net = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(tabular_size, 512),
            nn.BatchNorm1d(512),
            nn.GELU(),
            nn.Dropout(0.5),
        )
        self.classifier = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(1792 + 512, 1024),
            nn.BatchNorm1d(1024),
            nn.GELU(),
            nn.Dropout(0.3),
            nn.Linear(1024, num_classes),
        )

    def forward(self, img, tabular):
        img_features = self.cnn(img)
        tabular_features = self.tabular_net(tabular)
        combined = torch.cat([img_features, tabular_features], dim=1)
        return self.classifier(combined)

            val_loss += criterion(outputs, targets).item() * imgs.size(0)

    scheduler.step()
    print(
        f'Epoch {epoch+1}/{EPOCHS} - Val Loss: {val_loss:.4f}, LR: {optimizer.param_groups[0]["lr"]:.2e}'

class LabelSmoothingCrossEntropy(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, smoothing=0.1):
        super().__init__()
        self.confidence = 1.0 - smoothing
        self.smoothing = smoothing

    def forward(self, pred, target):
        log_probs = torch.nn.functional.log_softmax(pred, dim=-1)
        nll_loss = -log_probs.gather(dim=-1, index=target.unsqueeze(1))
        nll_loss = nll_loss.squeeze(1)
        smooth_loss = -log_probs.mean(dim=-1)
        loss = self.confidence * nll_loss + self.smoothing * smooth_loss
        return loss.mean()

class ResidualBlock(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, in_channels, out_channels, stride=1):
        super().__init__()
        self.conv1 = nn.Conv2d(
            in_channels, out_channels, 3, stride=stride, padding=1, bias=False
        )
        self.bn1 = nn.BatchNorm2d(out_channels)
        self.conv2 = nn.Conv2d(out_channels, out_channels, 3, padding=1, bias=False)
        self.bn2 = nn.BatchNorm2d(out_channels)
        self.shortcut = nn.Sequential()
        if stride != 1 or in_channels != out_channels:
            self.shortcut = nn.Sequential(
                nn.Conv2d(in_channels, out_channels, 1, stride=stride, bias=False),
                nn.BatchNorm2d(out_channels),
            )

    def forward(self, x):
        out = nn.ReLU()(self.bn1(self.conv1(x)))
        out = self.bn2(self.conv2(out))
        out += self.shortcut(x)
        return nn.ReLU()(out)


class LeafClassifier(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, num_features, num_classes):
        super().__init__()
        self.image_net = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Conv2d(1, 64, 3, padding=1, bias=False),
            nn.BatchNorm2d(64),
            nn.ReLU(),
            ResidualBlock(64, 64),
            nn.MaxPool2d(2),
            ResidualBlock(64, 128, stride=2),
            ResidualBlock(128, 256, stride=2),
            nn.AdaptiveAvgPool2d(1),
            nn.Flatten(),
        )
        self.feature_net = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(num_features, 1024),
            nn.BatchNorm1d(1024),
            nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Dropout(0.5),
            nn.Linear(1024, 512),
            nn.BatchNorm1d(512),
            nn.ReLU(),
        )
        self.classifier = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(512 + 256, 512),
            nn.BatchNorm1d(512),
            nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Dropout(0.3),
            nn.Linear(512, num_classes),
        )

    def forward(self, x_feat, x_img):
        img_features = self.image_net(x_img)
        tab_features = self.feature_net(x_feat)
        combined = torch.cat([tab_features, img_features], 1)
        return self.classifier(combined)


device = torch.device("cuda" if torch.cuda.is_available() else "cpu")

def train_epoch(loader):
    model.train()
    for features, images, labels in loader:
        features, images, labels = (
            features.to(device),
            images.to(device),
            labels.to(device),
        )
        alpha = 0.4
        lam = np.random.beta(alpha, alpha) if alpha > 0 else 1
        perm = torch.randperm(features.size(0), device=device)

        mixed_features = lam * features + (1 - lam) * features[perm]
        mixed_images = lam * images + (1 - lam) * images[perm]

        optimizer.zero_grad()
        outputs = model(mixed_features, mixed_images)
        loss = lam * criterion(outputs, labels) + (1 - lam) * criterion(
            outputs, labels[perm]
        )
        loss.backward()
        nn.utils.clip_grad_norm_(model.parameters(), 5.0)
        optimizer.step()


def validate(loader):
    model.eval()
    val_loss, correct = 0, 0
    with torch.no_grad():
        for features, images, labels in loader:
            features, images, labels = (
                features.to(device),
                images.to(device),
                labels.to(device),
            )
            outputs = model(features, images)
            val_loss += criterion(outputs, labels).item()
            correct += (outputs.argmax(1) == labels).sum().item()
    return val_loss / len(loader), correct / len(loader.dataset)

        )
        self.texture_branch = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(64, 1024),
            nn.BatchNorm1d(1024),
            nn.Mish(),

        )
        self.image_branch = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(512, 1024),
            nn.BatchNorm1d(1024),
            nn.Mish(),
            nn.Dropout(0.5),
        )

        self.main = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(4096, 2048),
            nn.BatchNorm1d(2048),
            nn.Mish(),
            nn.Dropout(0.6),
            nn.Linear(2048, 1024),
            nn.BatchNorm1d(1024),
            nn.Mish(),
            nn.Dropout(0.5),
            nn.Linear(1024, 99),
        )
        self.stochastic_depth = 0.0

    def forward(self, x):
        margin = self.margin_branch(x[:, :64])
        shape = self.shape_branch(x[:, 64:128])
        texture = self.texture_branch(x[:, 128:192])
        image = self.image_branch(x[:, 192:704])

        if self.training:
            for branch in [margin, shape, texture, image]:
                if torch.rand(1).item() < self.stochastic_depth:
                    branch = torch.zeros_like(branch)

        combined = torch.cat([margin, shape, texture, image], 1)
        return self.main(combined)

import pandas as pd

LR = 0.001

class LeafDataset(Dataset):
    def __init__(self, df, tabular_data, img_dir, mode="train"):
        self.df = df
        self.tabular_data = tabular_data
        self.img_dir = img_dir
        self.mode = mode
        self.augment = (
            transforms.Compose(
                [
                    transforms.RandomHorizontalFlip(p=0.5),
                    transforms.RandomRotation(30),
                    transforms.ColorJitter(
                        brightness=0.2, contrast=0.2, saturation=0.2
                    ),
                    transforms.Resize(380),
                    transforms.CenterCrop(380),
                    transforms.ToTensor(),
                    transforms.Normalize([0.485, 0.456, 0.406], [0.229, 0.224, 0.225]),
                ]
            )
            if mode == "train"
            else transforms.Compose(
                [
                    transforms.Resize(380),
                    transforms.CenterCrop(380),
                    transforms.ToTensor(),
                    transforms.Normalize([0.485, 0.456, 0.406], [0.229, 0.224, 0.225]),
                ]
            )
        )

    def __len__(self):
        return len(self.df)

    def __getitem__(self, idx):
        img_id = str(int(self.df.iloc[idx]["id"]))  # Convert to integer ID first
        img_path = f"{self.img_dir}/{img_id}.jpg"
        try:
            img = Image.open(img_path).convert("RGB")
        except FileNotFoundError:
            print(f"Warning: Missing image {img_id}, using blank image")
            img = Image.new("RGB", (380, 380), (255, 255, 255))

        img = self.augment(img)
        tabular = self.tabular_data[idx]
        if self.mode == "test":
            return img, tabular
        return img, tabular, torch.tensor(self.df.iloc[idx]["label"])


class EnhancedLeafClassifier(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, num_classes, tabular_size):
        super().__init__()
        self.cnn = efficientnet_b4(weights=EfficientNet_B4_Weights.IMAGENET1K_V1)
        self.cnn.classifier = nn.Identity()
        self.tabular_net = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(tabular_size, 512),
            nn.BatchNorm1d(512),
            nn.GELU(),
            nn.Dropout(0.5),
        )
        self.classifier = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(1792 + 512, 1024),
            nn.BatchNorm1d(1024),
            nn.GELU(),
            nn.Dropout(0.3),
            nn.Linear(1024, num_classes),
        )

    def forward(self, img, tabular):
        img_features = self.cnn(img)
        tabular_features = self.tabular_net(tabular)
        combined = torch.cat([img_features, tabular_features], dim=1)
        return self.classifier(combined)


# Load and preprocess data
train_df = pd.read_csv("input/train.csv")
test_df = pd.read_csv("input/test.csv").astype({"id": int})  # Ensure integer IDs
le = LabelEncoder()

tabular_cols = [c for c in train_df.columns if c not in ["id", "species", "label"]]

    train_df.index, test_size=0.15, stratify=train_df["label"], random_state=42
)

# Create datasets
train_dataset = LeafDataset(
    train_df.iloc[train_idx], train_tabular[train_idx], "input/images", "train"
)
val_dataset = LeafDataset(
    train_df.iloc[val_idx], train_tabular[val_idx], "input/images", "val"
)
test_dataset = LeafDataset(test_df, test_tabular, "input/images", "test")

# DataLoaders
train_loader = DataLoader(
    train_dataset, batch_size=BATCH_SIZE, shuffle=True, num_workers=8, pin_memory=True
)

test_loader = DataLoader(test_dataset, batch_size=BATCH_SIZE * 2, num_workers=8)

# Model setup
model = EnhancedLeafClassifier(len(le.classes_), train_tabular.shape[1]).to(DEVICE)
optimizer = optim.AdamW(model.parameters(), lr=LR, weight_decay=WEIGHT_DECAY)
scheduler = optim.lr_scheduler.CosineAnnealingWarmRestarts(optimizer, T_0=10, T_mult=1)
criterion = nn.CrossEntropyLoss(label_smoothing=SMOOTHING)
scaler = GradScaler()

# Training loop
best_loss, counter = float("inf"), 0
for epoch in range(EPOCHS):
    model.train()
    for imgs, tabular, targets in train_loader:
        imgs = imgs.to(DEVICE)
        tabular = tabular.float().to(DEVICE)
        targets = targets.to(DEVICE)

        optimizer.zero_grad()
        with autocast():
            outputs = model(imgs, tabular)
            loss = criterion(outputs, targets)

        scaler.scale(loss).backward()
        scaler.step(optimizer)
        scaler.update()

    model.eval()
    val_loss, total = 0, 0
    with torch.no_grad():
        for imgs, tabular, targets in val_loader:
            imgs = imgs.to(DEVICE)
            tabular = tabular.float().to(DEVICE)
            targets = targets.to(DEVICE)

            outputs = model(imgs, tabular)
            val_loss += criterion(outputs, targets).item() * imgs.size(0)
            total += imgs.size(0)

    val_loss /= total
    scheduler.step()
    print(
        f'Epoch {epoch+1}/{EPOCHS} - Val Loss: {val_loss:.4f}, LR: {optimizer.param_groups[0]["lr"]:.2e}'
    )

    if val_loss < best_loss:
        best_loss = val_loss
        counter = 0
        torch.save(model.state_dict(), "best_model.pth")
    else:
        counter += 1
        if counter >= PATIENCE:

class ResidualBlock(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, in_channels, out_channels, stride=1):
        super().__init__()
        self.conv1 = nn.Conv2d(in_channels, out_channels, 3, stride, 1, bias=False)
        self.bn1 = nn.BatchNorm2d(out_channels)
        self.relu = nn.ReLU(inplace=True)
        self.conv2 = nn.Conv2d(out_channels, out_channels, 3, 1, 1, bias=False)
        self.bn2 = nn.BatchNorm2d(out_channels)
        self.downsample = nn.Sequential()
        if stride != 1 or in_channels != out_channels:
            self.downsample = nn.Sequential(
                nn.Conv2d(in_channels, out_channels, 1, stride, bias=False),
                nn.BatchNorm2d(out_channels),
            )

    def forward(self, x):
        identity = self.downsample(x)
        out = self.conv1(x)
        out = self.bn1(out)
        out = self.relu(out)
        out = self.conv2(out)
        out = self.bn2(out)
        out += identity
        out = self.relu(out)
        return out

        )

            nn.Linear(num_features, 1024),
            nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Dropout(0.5),
            nn.Linear(1024, 512),

        )
        self.classifier = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(256 + 512, 512),
            nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Dropout(0.3),
            nn.Linear(512, num_classes),
        )

    def forward(self, x_feat, x_img):
        img_feat = self.image_net(x_img)
        tab_feat = self.feature_net(x_feat)
        combined = torch.cat([tab_feat, img_feat], 1)
        return self.classifier(combined)

class ResidualBlock(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, in_dim, out_dim):
        super().__init__()
        self.linear = nn.Linear(in_dim, out_dim)
        self.bn = nn.BatchNorm1d(out_dim)
        self.dropout = nn.Dropout(0.3)
        self.activation = nn.SiLU()
        self.shortcut = (
            nn.Linear(in_dim, out_dim) if in_dim != out_dim else nn.Identity()
        )

    def forward(self, x):
        return self.activation(self.dropout(self.bn(self.linear(x)))) + self.shortcut(x)


class EnhancedBranch(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, input_dim):
        super().__init__()
        self.net = nn.Sequential(
            ResidualBlock(input_dim, 512),
            ResidualBlock(512, 512),
            nn.Linear(512, 256),
            nn.BatchNorm1d(256),
            nn.SiLU(),
            nn.Dropout(0.3),
        )

    def forward(self, x):
        return self.net(x)


class MultiHeadCrossAttention(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, feature_dim, num_heads=8):
        super().__init__()
        self.num_heads = num_heads
        self.head_dim = feature_dim // num_heads
        self.query = nn.Linear(feature_dim, feature_dim)
        self.key = nn.Linear(feature_dim, feature_dim)
        self.value = nn.Linear(feature_dim, feature_dim)
        self.attn_drop = nn.Dropout(0.1)
        self.proj = nn.Linear(feature_dim, feature_dim)

    def forward(self, margin, shape, texture):
        branches = torch.stack([margin, shape, texture], dim=1)
        batch_size = branches.size(0)

        Q = (
            self.query(branches)
            .view(batch_size, 3, self.num_heads, self.head_dim)
            .permute(0, 2, 1, 3)
        )
        K = (
            self.key(branches)
            .view(batch_size, 3, self.num_heads, self.head_dim)
            .permute(0, 2, 1, 3)
        )
        V = (
            self.value(branches)
            .view(batch_size, 3, self.num_heads, self.head_dim)
            .permute(0, 2, 1, 3)
        )

        attn = torch.softmax(
            (Q @ K.transpose(-2, -1)) / torch.sqrt(torch.tensor(self.head_dim)), dim=-1
        )
        out = (
            (self.attn_drop(attn) @ V)
            .permute(0, 2, 1, 3)
            .contiguous()
            .view(batch_size, 3, -1)
        )
        return self.proj(out.mean(dim=1))


class LeafClassifier(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, input_size, num_classes):
        super().__init__()
        self.margin_branch = EnhancedBranch(64)
        self.shape_branch = EnhancedBranch(64)
        self.texture_branch = EnhancedBranch(64)
        self.attention = MultiHeadCrossAttention(256)

        # Image processing branch
        self.image_net = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Conv2d(1, 32, 3, padding=1),
            nn.BatchNorm2d(32),
            nn.SiLU(),
            nn.MaxPool2d(2),
            nn.Conv2d(32, 64, 3, padding=1),
            nn.BatchNorm2d(64),
            nn.SiLU(),
            nn.MaxPool2d(2),
            nn.Conv2d(64, 128, 3, padding=1),
            nn.BatchNorm2d(128),
            nn.SiLU(),
            nn.AdaptiveAvgPool2d(1),
            nn.Flatten(),
            nn.Linear(128, 256),
        )

        self.classifier = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(256 * 4 + 256, 1024),
            nn.BatchNorm1d(1024),
            nn.SiLU(),
            nn.Dropout(0.5),
            nn.Linear(1024, 512),
            nn.BatchNorm1d(512),
            nn.SiLU(),
            nn.Dropout(0.5),
            nn.Linear(512, num_classes),
        )

    def forward(
        self, x, img, mixup_layer=None, lam=None, labels=None, mixup_labels=None
    ):
        margin = self.margin_branch(x[:, :64])
        shape = self.shape_branch(x[:, 64:128])
        texture = self.texture_branch(x[:, 128:192])

        if mixup_layer == "branches":
            margin = lam * margin + (1 - lam) * margin[mixup_labels]
            shape = lam * shape + (1 - lam) * shape[mixup_labels]
            texture = lam * texture + (1 - lam) * texture[mixup_labels]

        attended = self.attention(margin, shape, texture)

        if mixup_layer == "attention":
            attended = lam * attended + (1 - lam) * attended[mixup_labels]

        combined = torch.cat([margin, shape, texture, attended], dim=1)
        img_features = self.image_net(img)
        combined = torch.cat([combined, img_features], dim=1)
        return self.classifier(combined)


class LeafDataset(Dataset):
    def __init__(self, df, img_dir, scaler, label_encoder=None, is_test=False):
        self.df = df
        self.img_dir = img_dir
        self.is_test = is_test
        self.transform = transforms.Compose(
            [
                transforms.Resize((64, 64)),
                transforms.Grayscale(),
                transforms.ToTensor(),

            ]
        )
        self.features = scaler.transform(df.filter(regex="margin|shape|texture").values)
        if not is_test:
            self.labels = label_encoder.transform(df["species"])

    def __len__(self):

    def __getitem__(self, idx):
        img_id = self.df["id"].iloc[idx]
        img_path = os.path.join(self.img_dir, f"{img_id}.jpg")
        image = Image.open(img_path).convert("L")
        image = self.transform(image)
        features = torch.FloatTensor(self.features[idx])
        return (
            (features, image, torch.LongTensor([self.labels[idx]]))
            if not self.is_test
            else (features, image)
        )

class LabelSmoothCrossEntropy(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, smoothing=0.1):
        super().__init__()
        self.smoothing = smoothing

    def forward(self, outputs, labels):
        n_classes = outputs.size(-1)
        log_preds = F.log_softmax(outputs, dim=-1)
        with torch.no_grad():
            true_dist = torch.zeros_like(log_preds)
            true_dist.fill_(self.smoothing / (n_classes - 1))
            true_dist.scatter_(1, labels.unsqueeze(1), 1 - self.smoothing)
        return torch.mean(torch.sum(-true_dist * log_preds, dim=-1))


class ResidualBlock(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, in_channels, out_channels, stride=1):
        super().__init__()
        self.conv1 = nn.Conv2d(in_channels, out_channels, 3, stride, 1, bias=False)
        self.bn1 = nn.BatchNorm2d(out_channels)
        self.relu = nn.ReLU(inplace=True)
        self.conv2 = nn.Conv2d(out_channels, out_channels, 3, 1, 1, bias=False)
        self.bn2 = nn.BatchNorm2d(out_channels)
        self.downsample = nn.Sequential()
        if stride != 1 or in_channels != out_channels:
            self.downsample = nn.Sequential(
                nn.Conv2d(in_channels, out_channels, 1, stride, bias=False),
                nn.BatchNorm2d(out_channels),
            )

    def forward(self, x):
        identity = self.downsample(x)
        out = self.conv1(x)
        out = self.bn1(out)
        out = self.relu(out)
        out = self.conv2(out)
        out = self.bn2(out)
        out += identity
        out = self.relu(out)
        return out


class LeafClassifier(nn.Module):

        super().__init__()
        self.image_net = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Conv2d(1, 64, 7, stride=2, padding=3, bias=False),
            nn.BatchNorm2d(64),
            nn.ReLU(inplace=True),
            nn.MaxPool2d(3, stride=2, padding=1),
            ResidualBlock(64, 64),
            ResidualBlock(64, 128, stride=2),
            ResidualBlock(128, 256, stride=2),
            nn.AdaptiveAvgPool2d(1),
            nn.Flatten(),
        )
        self.feature_net = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(num_features, 1024),
            nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Dropout(0.5),
            nn.Linear(1024, 512),
            nn.ReLU(),
        )
        self.classifier = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(256 + 512, 512),
            nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Dropout(0.3),
            nn.Linear(512, num_classes),
        )

    def forward(self, x_feat, x_img):
        img_feat = self.image_net(x_img)
        tab_feat = self.feature_net(x_feat)
        combined = torch.cat([tab_feat, img_feat], 1)
        return self.classifier(combined)

class ResidualBlock(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, in_dim, out_dim):
        super().__init__()
        self.linear = nn.Linear(in_dim, out_dim)
        self.bn = nn.BatchNorm1d(out_dim)
        self.dropout = nn.Dropout(0.3)
        self.activation = nn.SiLU()
        self.shortcut = (
            nn.Linear(in_dim, out_dim) if in_dim != out_dim else nn.Identity()
        )

    def forward(self, x):
        return self.activation(self.dropout(self.bn(self.linear(x)))) + self.shortcut(x)


class EnhancedBranch(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, input_dim):
        super().__init__()
        self.net = nn.Sequential(
            ResidualBlock(input_dim, 512),
            ResidualBlock(512, 512),
            nn.Linear(512, 256),
            nn.BatchNorm1d(256),
            nn.SiLU(),
            nn.Dropout(0.3),
        )

    def forward(self, x):
        return self.net(x)


class MultiHeadCrossAttention(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, feature_dim, num_heads=8):
        super().__init__()
        self.num_heads = num_heads
        self.head_dim = feature_dim // num_heads
        self.query = nn.Linear(feature_dim, feature_dim)
        self.key = nn.Linear(feature_dim, feature_dim)
        self.value = nn.Linear(feature_dim, feature_dim)
        self.attn_drop = nn.Dropout(0.1)
        self.proj = nn.Linear(feature_dim, feature_dim)

    def forward(self, margin, shape, texture):
        branches = torch.stack([margin, shape, texture], dim=1)
        batch_size = branches.size(0)

        Q = (
            self.query(branches)
            .view(batch_size, 3, self.num_heads, self.head_dim)
            .permute(0, 2, 1, 3)
        )
        K = (
            self.key(branches)
            .view(batch_size, 3, self.num_heads, self.head_dim)
            .permute(0, 2, 1, 3)
        )
        V = (
            self.value(branches)
            .view(batch_size, 3, self.num_heads, self.head_dim)
            .permute(0, 2, 1, 3)
        )

        attn = torch.softmax(
            (Q @ K.transpose(-2, -1)) / torch.sqrt(torch.tensor(self.head_dim)), dim=-1
        )
        out = (
            (self.attn_drop(attn) @ V)
            .permute(0, 2, 1, 3)
            .contiguous()
            .view(batch_size, 3, -1)
        )
        return self.proj(out.mean(dim=1))


class LeafClassifier(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, input_size, num_classes):
        super().__init__()
        self.margin_branch = EnhancedBranch(64)
        self.shape_branch = EnhancedBranch(64)
        self.texture_branch = EnhancedBranch(64)
        self.attention = MultiHeadCrossAttention(256)

        # Enhanced image processing with EfficientNet
        self.image_net = models.efficientnet_b0(pretrained=True)
        self.image_net.features[0][0] = nn.Conv2d(
            1, 32, kernel_size=3, stride=2, padding=1, bias=False
        )
        self.image_net.classifier = nn.Identity()
        self.image_proj = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(1280, 512), nn.BatchNorm1d(512), nn.SiLU(), nn.Dropout(0.3)
        )

        self.classifier = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(256 * 3 + 256 + 512, 1024),
            nn.BatchNorm1d(1024),
            nn.SiLU(),
            nn.Dropout(0.5),
            nn.Linear(1024, 512),
            nn.BatchNorm1d(512),
            nn.SiLU(),
            nn.Dropout(0.5),
            nn.Linear(512, num_classes),
        )

    def forward(
        self, x, img, mixup_layer=None, lam=None, labels=None, mixup_labels=None
    ):
        margin = self.margin_branch(x[:, :64])
        shape = self.shape_branch(x[:, 64:128])
        texture = self.texture_branch(x[:, 128:192])

        if mixup_layer == "branches":
            margin = lam * margin + (1 - lam) * margin[mixup_labels]
            shape = lam * shape + (1 - lam) * shape[mixup_labels]
            texture = lam * texture + (1 - lam) * texture[mixup_labels]

        attended = self.attention(margin, shape, texture)

        if mixup_layer == "attention":
            attended = lam * attended + (1 - lam) * attended[mixup_labels]

        combined = torch.cat([margin, shape, texture, attended], dim=1)

        # Process images through EfficientNet
        img_features = self.image_net.features(img)
        img_features = nn.functional.adaptive_avg_pool2d(img_features, (1, 1)).squeeze()
        img_features = self.image_proj(img_features)

        combined = torch.cat([combined, img_features], dim=1)
        return self.classifier(combined)


class LeafDataset(Dataset):
    def __init__(self, df, img_dir, scaler, label_encoder=None, is_test=False):
        self.df = df
        self.img_dir = img_dir
        self.is_test = is_test
        self.transform = transforms.Compose(
            [
                transforms.Resize((224, 224)),
                transforms.Grayscale(num_output_channels=1),
                transforms.ToTensor(),
                transforms.Normalize([0.5], [0.5]),
            ]
        )
        self.features = scaler.transform(df.filter(regex="margin|shape|texture").values)
        if not is_test:
            self.labels = label_encoder.transform(df["species"])

    def __len__(self):
        return len(self.df)

    def __getitem__(self, idx):
        img_id = self.df["id"].iloc[idx]
        img_path = os.path.join(self.img_dir, f"{img_id}.jpg")
        image = Image.open(img_path)
        image = self.transform(image)
        features = torch.FloatTensor(self.features[idx])
        return (
            (features, image, torch.LongTensor([self.labels[idx]]))
            if not self.is_test
            else (features, image)
        )

model = LeafClassifier(192, len(le.classes_)).to(device)
optimizer = optim.AdamW(model.parameters(), lr=0.0005, weight_decay=0.1)

best_loss, patience = float("inf"), 30

# Training loop
for epoch in range(200):
    model.train()
    train_loss = 0

    for features, images, labels in train_loader:
        features = features.to(device)
        images = images.to(device)
        labels = labels.squeeze().to(device)

        lam = Beta(mixup_alpha, mixup_alpha).sample().to(device)
        index = torch.randperm(features.size(0)).to(device)
        mix_layer = np.random.choice([None, "branches", "attention"], p=[0.2, 0.4, 0.4])

        optimizer.zero_grad()
        outputs = model(features, images, mix_layer, lam, labels, index)

        if mix_layer:
            loss = lam * criterion(outputs, labels) + (1 - lam) * criterion(
                outputs, labels[index]
            )
        else:
            loss = criterion(outputs, labels)

        loss.backward()
        torch.nn.utils.clip_grad_norm_(model.parameters(), 1.0)

import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split
from sklearn.preprocessing import LabelEncoder, StandardScaler
from sklearn.metrics import log_loss
import torch
import torch.nn as nn
import torch.optim as optim
from torch.utils.data import Dataset, DataLoader
from torchvision.models import efficientnet_b4, EfficientNet_B4_Weights
import torchvision.transforms as transforms
from PIL import Image
import os
from torch.cuda.amp import autocast, GradScaler

DEVICE = torch.device("cuda" if torch.cuda.is_available() else "cpu")
BATCH_SIZE = 64
EPOCHS = 100
PATIENCE = 15  # Increased patience for MixUp convergence
LR = 0.001
WEIGHT_DECAY = 1e-4
SMOOTHING = 0.1
MIXUP_ALPHA = 0.4  # MixUp parameter


def mixup_data(x, t, y, alpha=1.0):
    if alpha > 0:
        lam = np.random.beta(alpha, alpha)
    else:
        lam = 1

    batch_size = x.size(0)
    index = torch.randperm(batch_size).to(DEVICE)

    mixed_x = lam * x + (1 - lam) * x[index]
    mixed_t = lam * t + (1 - lam) * t[index]
    y_a, y_b = y, y[index]
    return mixed_x, mixed_t, y_a, y_b, lam


def mixup_criterion(criterion, pred, y_a, y_b, lam):
    return lam * criterion(pred, y_a) + (1 - lam) * criterion(pred, y_b)


class LeafDataset(Dataset):
    def __init__(self, df, tabular_data, img_dir, mode="train"):
        self.df = df
        self.tabular_data = tabular_data
        self.img_dir = img_dir
        self.mode = mode
        self.augment = (
            transforms.Compose(
                [
                    transforms.RandomHorizontalFlip(p=0.5),
                    transforms.RandomRotation(30),
                    transforms.ColorJitter(
                        brightness=0.2, contrast=0.2, saturation=0.2
                    ),
                    transforms.RandomErasing(
                        p=0.2, scale=(0.02, 0.1)
                    ),  # Added RandomErasing
                    transforms.Resize(380),
                    transforms.CenterCrop(380),
                    transforms.ToTensor(),
                    transforms.Normalize([0.485, 0.456, 0.406], [0.229, 0.224, 0.225]),
                ]
            )
            if mode == "train"
            else transforms.Compose(
                [
                    transforms.Resize(380),
                    transforms.CenterCrop(380),
                    transforms.ToTensor(),
                    transforms.Normalize([0.485, 0.456, 0.406], [0.229, 0.224, 0.225]),
                ]
            )
        )

    def __len__(self):
        return len(self.df)

    def __getitem__(self, idx):
        img_id = str(int(self.df.iloc[idx]["id"]))
        img_path = f"{self.img_dir}/{img_id}.jpg"
        try:
            img = Image.open(img_path).convert("RGB")
        except FileNotFoundError:
            img = Image.new("RGB", (380, 380), (255, 255, 255))

        img = self.augment(img)
        tabular = self.tabular_data[idx]
        if self.mode == "test":
            return img, tabular
        return img, tabular, torch.tensor(self.df.iloc[idx]["label"])


class EnhancedLeafClassifier(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, num_classes, tabular_size):
        super().__init__()
        self.cnn = efficientnet_b4(weights=EfficientNet_B4_Weights.IMAGENET1K_V1)
        self.cnn.classifier = nn.Identity()
        self.tabular_net = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(tabular_size, 512),
            nn.BatchNorm1d(512),
            nn.GELU(),
            nn.Dropout(0.5),
        )
        self.classifier = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(1792 + 512, 1024),
            nn.BatchNorm1d(1024),
            nn.GELU(),
            nn.Dropout(0.3),
            nn.Linear(1024, num_classes),
        )

    def forward(self, img, tabular):
        img_features = self.cnn(img)
        tabular_features = self.tabular_net(tabular)
        combined = torch.cat([img_features, tabular_features], dim=1)
        return self.classifier(combined)


# Load and preprocess data
train_df = pd.read_csv("input/train.csv")
test_df = pd.read_csv("input/test.csv").astype({"id": int})
le = LabelEncoder()
train_df["label"] = le.fit_transform(train_df["species"])

tabular_cols = [c for c in train_df.columns if c not in ["id", "species", "label"]]
scaler = StandardScaler()

test_tabular = scaler.transform(test_df[tabular_cols])

    train_df.index, test_size=0.15, stratify=train_df["label"], random_state=42
)

train_dataset = LeafDataset(
    train_df.iloc[train_idx], train_tabular[train_idx], "input/images", "train"
)
val_dataset = LeafDataset(
    train_df.iloc[val_idx], train_tabular[val_idx], "input/images", "val"
)
test_dataset = LeafDataset(test_df, test_tabular, "input/images", "test")

train_loader = DataLoader(
    train_dataset, batch_size=BATCH_SIZE, shuffle=True, num_workers=8, pin_memory=True
)
val_loader = DataLoader(val_dataset, batch_size=BATCH_SIZE * 2, num_workers=8)
test_loader = DataLoader(test_dataset, batch_size=BATCH_SIZE * 2, num_workers=8)

model = EnhancedLeafClassifier(len(le.classes_), train_tabular.shape[1]).to(DEVICE)
optimizer = optim.AdamW(model.parameters(), lr=LR, weight_decay=WEIGHT_DECAY)
scheduler = optim.lr_scheduler.CosineAnnealingWarmRestarts(optimizer, T_0=10, T_mult=1)
criterion = nn.CrossEntropyLoss(label_smoothing=SMOOTHING)
scaler = GradScaler()

best_loss, counter = float("inf"), 0
for epoch in range(EPOCHS):
    model.train()
    for imgs, tabular, targets in train_loader:
        imgs = imgs.to(DEVICE)
        tabular = tabular.float().to(DEVICE)
        targets = targets.to(DEVICE)

        # Apply MixUp
        imgs, tabular, targets_a, targets_b, lam = mixup_data(
            imgs, tabular, targets, alpha=MIXUP_ALPHA
        )

        optimizer.zero_grad()
        with autocast():
            outputs = model(imgs, tabular)
            loss = mixup_criterion(criterion, outputs, targets_a, targets_b, lam)

        scaler.scale(loss).backward()
        scaler.step(optimizer)
        scaler.update()

    model.eval()
    val_loss, total = 0, 0
    with torch.no_grad():
        for imgs, tabular, targets in val_loader:
            imgs = imgs.to(DEVICE)
            tabular = tabular.float().to(DEVICE)
            targets = targets.to(DEVICE)

            outputs = model(imgs, tabular)
            val_loss += criterion(outputs, targets).item() * imgs.size(0)
            total += imgs.size(0)

    val_loss /= total
    scheduler.step()
    print(
        f'Epoch {epoch+1}/{EPOCHS} - Val Loss: {val_loss:.4f}, LR: {optimizer.param_groups[0]["lr"]:.2e}'
    )

    if val_loss < best_loss:
        best_loss = val_loss
        counter = 0
        torch.save(model.state_dict(), "best_model.pth")
    else:
        counter += 1
        if counter >= PATIENCE:
            print("Early stopping")
            break

model.load_state_dict(torch.load("best_model.pth"))
model.eval()
val_probs = []
with torch.no_grad():
    for imgs, tabular, targets in val_loader:
        imgs = imgs.to(DEVICE)

class ResidualBlock(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, in_dim, out_dim):
        super().__init__()
        self.linear = nn.Linear(in_dim, out_dim)
        self.bn = nn.BatchNorm1d(out_dim)
        self.dropout = nn.Dropout(0.3)
        self.activation = nn.SiLU()
        self.shortcut = (
            nn.Linear(in_dim, out_dim) if in_dim != out_dim else nn.Identity()
        )

    def forward(self, x):
        return self.activation(self.dropout(self.bn(self.linear(x)))) + self.shortcut(x)


class EnhancedBranch(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, input_dim):
        super().__init__()
        self.net = nn.Sequential(
            ResidualBlock(input_dim, 512),
            ResidualBlock(512, 512),
            nn.Linear(512, 256),
            nn.BatchNorm1d(256),
            nn.SiLU(),
            nn.Dropout(0.3),
        )

    def forward(self, x):
        return self.net(x)


class MultiHeadCrossAttention(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, feature_dim, num_heads=8):
        super().__init__()
        self.num_heads = num_heads
        self.head_dim = feature_dim // num_heads
        self.query = nn.Linear(feature_dim, feature_dim)
        self.key = nn.Linear(feature_dim, feature_dim)
        self.value = nn.Linear(feature_dim, feature_dim)
        self.attn_drop = nn.Dropout(0.1)
        self.proj = nn.Linear(feature_dim, feature_dim)

    def forward(self, margin, shape, texture):
        branches = torch.stack([margin, shape, texture], dim=1)
        batch_size = branches.size(0)

        Q = (
            self.query(branches)
            .view(batch_size, 3, self.num_heads, self.head_dim)
            .permute(0, 2, 1, 3)
        )
        K = (
            self.key(branches)
            .view(batch_size, 3, self.num_heads, self.head_dim)
            .permute(0, 2, 1, 3)
        )
        V = (
            self.value(branches)
            .view(batch_size, 3, self.num_heads, self.head_dim)
            .permute(0, 2, 1, 3)
        )

        attn = torch.softmax(
            (Q @ K.transpose(-2, -1)) / torch.sqrt(torch.tensor(self.head_dim)), dim=-1
        )
        out = (
            (self.attn_drop(attn) @ V)
            .permute(0, 2, 1, 3)
            .contiguous()
            .view(batch_size, 3, -1)
        )
        return self.proj(out.mean(dim=1))


class LeafClassifier(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, input_size, num_classes):
        super().__init__()
        self.margin_branch = EnhancedBranch(64)
        self.shape_branch = EnhancedBranch(64)
        self.texture_branch = EnhancedBranch(64)
        self.attention = MultiHeadCrossAttention(256)

        self.image_net = models.efficientnet_b0(pretrained=True)
        self.image_net.features[0][0] = nn.Conv2d(
            1, 32, kernel_size=3, stride=2, padding=1, bias=False
        )
        self.image_net.classifier = nn.Identity()
        self.image_proj = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(1280, 512), nn.BatchNorm1d(512), nn.SiLU(), nn.Dropout(0.3)
        )

        self.classifier = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(256 * 3 + 256 + 512, 1024),
            nn.BatchNorm1d(1024),
            nn.SiLU(),
            nn.Dropout(0.5),
            nn.Linear(1024, 512),
            nn.BatchNorm1d(512),
            nn.SiLU(),
            nn.Dropout(0.5),
            nn.Linear(512, num_classes),
        )

    def forward(
        self, x, img, mixup_layer=None, lam=None, labels=None, mixup_labels=None
    ):
        margin = self.margin_branch(x[:, :64])
        shape = self.shape_branch(x[:, 64:128])
        texture = self.texture_branch(x[:, 128:192])

        if mixup_layer == "branches":
            margin = lam * margin + (1 - lam) * margin[mixup_labels]
            shape = lam * shape + (1 - lam) * shape[mixup_labels]
            texture = lam * texture + (1 - lam) * texture[mixup_labels]

        attended = self.attention(margin, shape, texture)
        if mixup_layer == "attention":
            attended = lam * attended + (1 - lam) * attended[mixup_labels]

        combined = torch.cat([margin, shape, texture, attended], dim=1)

        img_features = self.image_net.features(img)
        img_features = nn.functional.adaptive_avg_pool2d(img_features, (1, 1)).squeeze()
        img_features = self.image_proj(img_features)

        combined = torch.cat([combined, img_features], dim=1)
        return self.classifier(combined)

DEVICE = torch.device("cuda" if torch.cuda.is_available() else "cpu")
BATCH_SIZE = 64
EPOCHS = 100
PATIENCE = 15
LR = 0.001
WEIGHT_DECAY = 1e-4
SMOOTHING = 0.1
MIXUP_ALPHA = 0.4


def mixup_data(x, t, y, alpha=1.0):
    if alpha > 0:
        lam = np.random.beta(alpha, alpha)
    else:
        lam = 1

    batch_size = x.size(0)
    index = torch.randperm(batch_size).to(DEVICE)

    mixed_x = lam * x + (1 - lam) * x[index]
    mixed_t = lam * t + (1 - lam) * t[index]
    y_a, y_b = y, y[index]
    return mixed_x, mixed_t, y_a, y_b, lam


def mixup_criterion(criterion, pred, y_a, y_b, lam):
    return lam * criterion(pred, y_a) + (1 - lam) * criterion(pred, y_b)


class LeafDataset(Dataset):
    def __init__(self, df, tabular_data, img_dir, mode="train"):
        self.df = df
        self.tabular_data = tabular_data
        self.img_dir = img_dir
        self.mode = mode
        self.augment = (
            transforms.Compose(
                [
                    transforms.RandomHorizontalFlip(p=0.5),
                    transforms.RandomRotation(30),
                    transforms.ColorJitter(
                        brightness=0.2, contrast=0.2, saturation=0.2
                    ),
                    transforms.Resize(380),
                    transforms.CenterCrop(380),
                    transforms.ToTensor(),
                    transforms.Normalize([0.485, 0.456, 0.406], [0.229, 0.224, 0.225]),
                    transforms.RandomErasing(p=0.2, scale=(0.02, 0.1)),
                ]
            )
            if mode == "train"
            else transforms.Compose(
                [
                    transforms.Resize(380),
                    transforms.CenterCrop(380),
                    transforms.ToTensor(),
                    transforms.Normalize([0.485, 0.456, 0.406], [0.229, 0.224, 0.225]),
                ]
            )
        )

    def __len__(self):
        return len(self.df)

    def __getitem__(self, idx):
        img_id = str(int(self.df.iloc[idx]["id"]))
        img_path = f"{self.img_dir}/{img_id}.jpg"
        try:
            img = Image.open(img_path).convert("RGB")
        except FileNotFoundError:
            img = Image.new("RGB", (380, 380), (255, 255, 255))

        img = self.augment(img)
        tabular = self.tabular_data[idx]
        if self.mode == "test":
            return img, tabular
        return img, tabular, torch.tensor(self.df.iloc[idx]["label"])


class EnhancedLeafClassifier(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, num_classes, tabular_size):
        super().__init__()
        self.cnn = efficientnet_b4(weights=EfficientNet_B4_Weights.IMAGENET1K_V1)
        self.cnn.classifier = nn.Identity()
        self.tabular_net = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(tabular_size, 512),
            nn.BatchNorm1d(512),
            nn.GELU(),
            nn.Dropout(0.5),
        )
        self.classifier = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(1792 + 512, 1024),
            nn.BatchNorm1d(1024),
            nn.GELU(),
            nn.Dropout(0.3),
            nn.Linear(1024, num_classes),
        )

    def forward(self, img, tabular):
        img_features = self.cnn(img)
        tabular_features = self.tabular_net(tabular)
        combined = torch.cat([img_features, tabular_features], dim=1)
        return self.classifier(combined)

train_loader = DataLoader(

criterion = nn.CrossEntropyLoss(label_smoothing=SMOOTHING)
scaler = GradScaler()

best_loss, counter = float("inf"), 0
for epoch in range(EPOCHS):
    model.train()
    for imgs, tabular, targets in train_loader:
        imgs = imgs.to(DEVICE)

        with autocast():

            total += imgs.size(0)

    val_loss /= total
    scheduler.step()
    print(
        f'Epoch {epoch+1}/{EPOCHS} - Val Loss: {val_loss:.4f}, LR: {optimizer.param_groups[0]["lr"]:.2e}'
    )

    if val_loss < best_loss:
        best_loss = val_loss
        counter = 0
        torch.save(model.state_dict(), "best_model.pth")
    else:
        counter += 1
        if counter >= PATIENCE:
            print("Early stopping")
            break

import torch
import torch.nn as nn
import torch.optim as optim
from torch.utils.data import Dataset, DataLoader

from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split
from sklearn.metrics import log_loss
import pandas as pd

from torch.distributions.beta import Beta
from PIL import Image
import os
from torchvision import transforms, models

le = LabelEncoder()


class ResidualBlock(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, in_dim, out_dim):
        super().__init__()
        self.linear = nn.Linear(in_dim, out_dim)
        self.bn = nn.BatchNorm1d(out_dim)
        self.dropout = nn.Dropout(0.3)
        self.activation = nn.SiLU()
        self.shortcut = (
            nn.Linear(in_dim, out_dim) if in_dim != out_dim else nn.Identity()
        )

    def forward(self, x):
        return self.activation(self.dropout(self.bn(self.linear(x)))) + self.shortcut(x)


class EnhancedBranch(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, input_dim):
        super().__init__()
        self.net = nn.Sequential(
            ResidualBlock(input_dim, 512),
            ResidualBlock(512, 512),
            nn.Linear(512, 256),
            nn.BatchNorm1d(256),
            nn.SiLU(),
            nn.Dropout(0.3),
        )

    def forward(self, x):
        return self.net(x)


class MultiHeadCrossAttention(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, feature_dim, num_heads=8):
        super().__init__()
        self.num_heads = num_heads
        self.head_dim = feature_dim // num_heads
        self.query = nn.Linear(feature_dim, feature_dim)
        self.key = nn.Linear(feature_dim, feature_dim)
        self.value = nn.Linear(feature_dim, feature_dim)
        self.attn_drop = nn.Dropout(0.1)
        self.proj = nn.Linear(feature_dim, feature_dim)

    def forward(self, margin, shape, texture):
        branches = torch.stack([margin, shape, texture], dim=1)
        batch_size = branches.size(0)

        Q = (
            self.query(branches)
            .view(batch_size, 3, self.num_heads, self.head_dim)
            .permute(0, 2, 1, 3)
        )
        K = (
            self.key(branches)
            .view(batch_size, 3, self.num_heads, self.head_dim)
            .permute(0, 2, 1, 3)
        )
        V = (
            self.value(branches)
            .view(batch_size, 3, self.num_heads, self.head_dim)
            .permute(0, 2, 1, 3)
        )

        attn = torch.softmax(
            (Q @ K.transpose(-2, -1)) / torch.sqrt(torch.tensor(self.head_dim)), dim=-1
        )
        out = (
            (self.attn_drop(attn) @ V)
            .permute(0, 2, 1, 3)
            .contiguous()
            .view(batch_size, 3, -1)
        )
        return self.proj(out.mean(dim=1))


class LeafClassifier(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, input_size, num_classes):
        super().__init__()
        self.margin_branch = EnhancedBranch(64)
        self.shape_branch = EnhancedBranch(64)
        self.texture_branch = EnhancedBranch(64)
        self.attention = MultiHeadCrossAttention(256)

        self.image_net = models.efficientnet_b3(pretrained=True)
        self.image_net.features[0][0] = nn.Conv2d(
            1, 40, kernel_size=3, stride=2, padding=1, bias=False
        )
        self.image_net.classifier = nn.Identity()
        self.image_proj = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(1536, 512), nn.BatchNorm1d(512), nn.SiLU(), nn.Dropout(0.3)
        )

        self.classifier = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(256 * 3 + 256 + 512, 1024),
            nn.BatchNorm1d(1024),
            nn.SiLU(),
            nn.Dropout(0.5),
            nn.Linear(1024, 512),
            nn.BatchNorm1d(512),
            nn.SiLU(),
            nn.Dropout(0.5),
            nn.Linear(512, num_classes),
        )

    def forward(self, x, img):
        margin = self.margin_branch(x[:, :64])
        shape = self.shape_branch(x[:, 64:128])
        texture = self.texture_branch(x[:, 128:192])
        attended = self.attention(margin, shape, texture)
        combined = torch.cat([margin, shape, texture, attended], dim=1)

        img_features = self.image_net.features(img)
        img_features = nn.functional.adaptive_avg_pool2d(img_features, (1, 1)).squeeze()
        img_features = self.image_proj(img_features)
        combined = torch.cat([combined, img_features], dim=1)
        return self.classifier(combined)


class LeafDataset(Dataset):
    def __init__(
        self, df, img_dir, scaler, transform, label_encoder=None, is_test=False
    ):
        self.df = df
        self.img_dir = img_dir
        self.transform = transform
        self.is_test = is_test
        self.features = scaler.transform(df.filter(regex="margin|shape|texture").values)
        if not is_test:
            self.labels = label_encoder.transform(df["species"])

    def __len__(self):
        return len(self.df)

    def __getitem__(self, idx):
        img_id = self.df["id"].iloc[idx]
        img_path = os.path.join(self.img_dir, f"{img_id}.jpg")
        image = Image.open(img_path)
        image = self.transform(image)
        features = torch.FloatTensor(self.features[idx])
        return (
            (features, image, torch.LongTensor([self.labels[idx]]))
            if not self.is_test
            else (features, image)
        )

# Attention fusion module
class AttentionFusion(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, img_feat_size, tab_feat_size):
        super().__init__()
        self.attn = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(img_feat_size + tab_feat_size, 256),
            nn.Tanh(),
            nn.Linear(256, 1),
            nn.Sigmoid(),
        )

    def forward(self, img_feat, tab_feat):
        combined = torch.cat([img_feat, tab_feat], dim=1)
        attn_weights = self.attn(combined)
        fused = attn_weights * img_feat + (1 - attn_weights) * tab_feat
        return fused

        super().__init__()

        )

            nn.Linear(1536 + 256, 512),
            nn.BatchNorm1d(512),
            nn.SiLU(),
            nn.Dropout(0.3),
            nn.Linear(512, NUM_CLASSES),
        )

    def forward(self, img, tab):
        img_feat = self.img_net(img)
        tab_feat = self.tab_net(tab)
        fused = self.fusion(img_feat, tab_feat)
        return self.classifier(fused)

# Loss function with label smoothing
class FocalLoss(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, alpha=0.25, gamma=2.0, smoothing=0.1):
        super().__init__()
        self.alpha = alpha
        self.gamma = gamma
        self.smoothing = smoothing

    def forward(self, inputs, targets):
        ce_loss = F.cross_entropy(
            inputs, targets, reduction="none", label_smoothing=self.smoothing
        )
        pt = torch.exp(-ce_loss)
        focal_loss = self.alpha * (1 - pt) ** self.gamma * ce_loss
        return focal_loss.mean()

class LeafClassifier(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, input_size, num_classes):
        super().__init__()
        self.margin_branch = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(64, 128), nn.BatchNorm1d(128), nn.ReLU(), nn.Dropout(0.3)
        )
        self.shape_branch = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(64, 128), nn.BatchNorm1d(128), nn.ReLU(), nn.Dropout(0.3)
        )
        self.texture_branch = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(64, 128), nn.BatchNorm1d(128), nn.ReLU(), nn.Dropout(0.3)
        )
        self.gate = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(384, 64), nn.ReLU(), nn.Linear(64, 3), nn.Sigmoid()
        )
        self.classifier = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(384, 256),
            nn.BatchNorm1d(256),
            nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Dropout(0.5),
            nn.Linear(256, num_classes),
        )

    def forward(self, x):
        margin = self.margin_branch(x[:, :64])
        shape = self.shape_branch(x[:, 64:128])
        texture = self.texture_branch(x[:, 128:])

        # Concatenate features for gating
        combined = torch.cat([margin, shape, texture], dim=1)
        gates = self.gate(combined)

        # Apply modality-specific gating
        gated_margin = margin * gates[:, 0].unsqueeze(1)
        gated_shape = shape * gates[:, 1].unsqueeze(1)
        gated_texture = texture * gates[:, 2].unsqueeze(1)

        gated_combined = torch.cat([gated_margin, gated_shape, gated_texture], dim=1)
        return self.classifier(gated_combined)

# Attention fusion with projection
class AttentionFusion(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, img_feat_size, tab_feat_size):
        super().__init__()
        self.tab_proj = nn.Linear(tab_feat_size, img_feat_size)
        self.attn = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(img_feat_size * 2, 256),
            nn.Tanh(),
            nn.Linear(256, 1),
            nn.Sigmoid(),
        )

    def forward(self, img_feat, tab_feat):
        tab_proj = self.tab_proj(tab_feat)
        combined = torch.cat([img_feat, tab_proj], dim=1)
        attn_weights = self.attn(combined)
        return attn_weights * img_feat + (1 - attn_weights) * tab_proj

    def __init__(self):

        return self.classifier(fused)

class LeafClassifier(nn.Module):

            nn.Linear(64, 256),
            nn.BatchNorm1d(256),
            nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Dropout(0.3),
            nn.Linear(256, 128),
            nn.BatchNorm1d(128),
            nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Dropout(0.3),
        )
        self.shape_branch = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(64, 256),
            nn.BatchNorm1d(256),
            nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Dropout(0.3),
            nn.Linear(256, 128),
            nn.BatchNorm1d(128),
            nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Dropout(0.3),
        )
        self.texture_branch = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(64, 256),
            nn.BatchNorm1d(256),
            nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Dropout(0.3),
            nn.Linear(256, 128),
            nn.BatchNorm1d(128),
            nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Dropout(0.3),
        )
        self.gate = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(384, 64), nn.ReLU(), nn.Linear(64, 3), nn.Sigmoid()
        )
        self.classifier = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(384, 256),
            nn.BatchNorm1d(256),
            nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Dropout(0.5),
            nn.Linear(256, num_classes),
        )

        margin = self.margin_branch(x[:, :64])
        shape = self.shape_branch(x[:, 64:128])
        texture = self.texture_branch(x[:, 128:])
        combined = torch.cat([margin, shape, texture], dim=1)
        gates = self.gate(combined)
        gated_combined = torch.cat(
            [
                margin * gates[:, 0].unsqueeze(1),
                shape * gates[:, 1].unsqueeze(1),
                texture * gates[:, 2].unsqueeze(1),
            ],
            dim=1,
        )
        return self.classifier(gated_combined)

DEVICE = torch.device("cuda" if torch.cuda.is_available() else "cpu")
BATCH_SIZE = 32  # Reduced to accommodate larger model
EPOCHS = 100
PATIENCE = 15
LR = 0.0005  # Adjusted learning rate for larger model
WEIGHT_DECAY = 1e-4
SMOOTHING = 0.1
MIXUP_ALPHA = 0.4


def mixup_data(x, t, y, alpha=1.0):
    if alpha > 0:
        lam = np.random.beta(alpha, alpha)
    else:
        lam = 1
    batch_size = x.size(0)
    index = torch.randperm(batch_size).to(DEVICE)
    mixed_x = lam * x + (1 - lam) * x[index]
    mixed_t = lam * t + (1 - lam) * t[index]
    return mixed_x, mixed_t, y, y[index], lam


def mixup_criterion(criterion, pred, y_a, y_b, lam):
    return lam * criterion(pred, y_a) + (1 - lam) * criterion(pred, y_b)


class LeafDataset(Dataset):
    def __init__(self, df, tabular_data, img_dir, mode="train"):
        self.df = df
        self.tabular_data = tabular_data
        self.img_dir = img_dir
        self.mode = mode
        self.augment = (
            transforms.Compose(
                [
                    transforms.Resize(530),
                    transforms.RandomResizedCrop(456, scale=(0.7, 1.0)),
                    transforms.RandAugment(num_ops=3, magnitude=9),
                    transforms.ToTensor(),
                    transforms.Normalize([0.485, 0.456, 0.406], [0.229, 0.224, 0.225]),
                    transforms.RandomErasing(p=0.3, scale=(0.02, 0.15)),
                ]
            )
            if mode == "train"
            else transforms.Compose(
                [
                    transforms.Resize(530),
                    transforms.CenterCrop(456),
                    transforms.ToTensor(),
                    transforms.Normalize([0.485, 0.456, 0.406], [0.229, 0.224, 0.225]),
                ]
            )
        )

    def __len__(self):
        return len(self.df)

    def __getitem__(self, idx):
        img_id = str(int(self.df.iloc[idx]["id"]))
        img_path = f"{self.img_dir}/{img_id}.jpg"
        try:
            img = Image.open(img_path).convert("RGB")
        except:
            img = Image.new("RGB", (456, 456), (255, 255, 255))
        img = self.augment(img)
        tabular = self.tabular_data[idx]
        return (
            (img, tabular)
            if self.mode == "test"
            else (img, tabular, torch.tensor(self.df.iloc[idx]["label"]))
        )


class EnhancedLeafClassifier(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, num_classes, tabular_size):
        super().__init__()
        self.cnn = efficientnet_b5(weights=EfficientNet_B5_Weights.IMAGENET1K_V1)
        self.cnn.classifier = nn.Identity()
        self.tabular_net = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(tabular_size, 512),
            nn.BatchNorm1d(512),
            nn.GELU(),
            nn.Dropout(0.5),
        )
        self.classifier = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(2048 + 512, 1024),
            nn.BatchNorm1d(1024),
            nn.GELU(),
            nn.Dropout(0.3),
            nn.Linear(1024, num_classes),
        )

    def forward(self, img, tabular):
        img_features = self.cnn(img)
        tabular_features = self.tabular_net(tabular)
        return self.classifier(torch.cat([img_features, tabular_features], dim=1))

    train_df.index, test_size=0.15, stratify=train_df["label"], random_state=42
)

train_dataset = LeafDataset(

)
val_dataset = LeafDataset(
    train_df.iloc[val_idx], train_tabular[val_idx], "input/images", "val"
)
test_dataset = LeafDataset(test_df, test_tabular, "input/images", "test")

train_loader = DataLoader(

criterion = nn.CrossEntropyLoss(label_smoothing=SMOOTHING)

best_loss, counter = float("inf"), 0
for epoch in range(EPOCHS):

            nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Dropout(0.5),
            nn.Linear(256, num_classes),
        )

    def forward(self, x):
        margin = self.margin_branch(x[:, :64])
        shape = self.shape_branch(x[:, 64:128])
        texture = self.texture_branch(x[:, 128:])
        combined = torch.cat([margin, shape, texture], dim=1)
        gates = self.gate(combined)
        gated_combined = torch.cat(
            [
                margin * gates[:, 0].unsqueeze(1),
                shape * gates[:, 1].unsqueeze(1),
                texture * gates[:, 2].unsqueeze(1),
            ],
            dim=1,
        )
        return self.classifier(gated_combined)

        mixed_x = lam * X_batch + (1 - lam) * X_batch[idx]
        y_a, y_b = y_batch, y_batch[idx]

        optimizer.zero_grad()
        outputs = model(mixed_x)
        loss = lam * criterion(outputs, y_a) + (1 - lam) * criterion(outputs, y_b)
        loss.backward()
        optimizer.step()
        train_loss += loss.item()

class LabelSmoothingCrossEntropy(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, smoothing=0.1):
        super().__init__()
        self.smoothing = smoothing
        self.confidence = 1.0 - smoothing

    def forward(self, x, target):
        log_probs = nn.functional.log_softmax(x, dim=-1)
        nll_loss = -log_probs.gather(dim=-1, index=target.unsqueeze(1))
        nll_loss = nll_loss.squeeze(1)
        smooth_loss = -log_probs.mean(dim=-1)
        loss = self.confidence * nll_loss + self.smoothing * smooth_loss
        return loss.mean()

MIXUP_ALPHA = 0.4


class CrossAttentionFusion(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, img_dim, tab_dim, hidden_dim):
        super().__init__()
        self.img_proj = nn.Linear(img_dim, hidden_dim)
        self.tab_proj = nn.Linear(tab_dim, hidden_dim)
        self.attention = nn.MultiheadAttention(
            hidden_dim, num_heads=8, batch_first=True
        )
        self.norm = nn.LayerNorm(hidden_dim)
        self.dropout = nn.Dropout(0.3)

    def forward(self, img_feats, tab_feats):
        img_proj = F.gelu(self.img_proj(img_feats))
        tab_proj = F.gelu(self.tab_proj(tab_feats))

        attn_output, _ = self.attention(
            img_proj.unsqueeze(1), tab_proj.unsqueeze(1), tab_proj.unsqueeze(1)
        )
        attn_output = self.dropout(attn_output.squeeze(1))
        return self.norm(img_proj + attn_output)


class EnhancedLeafClassifier(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, num_classes, tabular_size):
        super().__init__()
        self.cnn = efficientnet_b5(weights=EfficientNet_B5_Weights.IMAGENET1K_V1)
        self.cnn.classifier = nn.Identity()

        self.tabular_net = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(tabular_size, 1024),
            nn.BatchNorm1d(1024),
            nn.GELU(),
            nn.Dropout(0.5),
        )

        self.fusion = CrossAttentionFusion(2048, 1024, 1024)

        self.classifier = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(1024, 512),
            nn.BatchNorm1d(512),
            nn.GELU(),
            nn.Dropout(0.3),
            nn.Linear(512, num_classes),
        )

    def forward(self, img, tabular):
        img_feats = self.cnn(img)
        tab_feats = self.tabular_net(tabular)
        fused = self.fusion(img_feats, tab_feats)
        return self.classifier(fused)


def mixup_data(x, t, y, alpha=1.0):
    if alpha > 0:
        lam = np.random.beta(alpha, alpha)
    else:
        lam = 1
    batch_size = x.size(0)
    index = torch.randperm(batch_size).to(DEVICE)
    mixed_x = lam * x + (1 - lam) * x[index]
    mixed_t = lam * t + (1 - lam) * t[index]
    return mixed_x, mixed_t, y, y[index], lam


def mixup_criterion(criterion, pred, y_a, y_b, lam):
    return lam * criterion(pred, y_a) + (1 - lam) * criterion(pred, y_b)

    def __init__(self, df, tabular_data, img_dir, mode="train"):

        tabular = self.tabular_data[idx]

        )
        optimizer.zero_grad()
        with autocast():
            outputs = model(imgs, tabular)
            loss = mixup_criterion(criterion, outputs, targets_a, targets_b, lam)

class TransformerFusion(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, img_dim, tab_dim, hidden_dim):
        super().__init__()

        self.tab_proj = nn.Linear(tab_dim, hidden_dim)

        self.transformer = nn.TransformerEncoder(
            nn.TransformerEncoderLayer(
                d_model=hidden_dim * 2,
                nhead=8,
                dim_feedforward=hidden_dim * 4,
                dropout=0.2,
                activation="gelu",
                batch_first=True,
            ),
            num_layers=4,
        )
        self.norm = nn.LayerNorm(hidden_dim * 2)
        self.final_proj = nn.Linear(hidden_dim * 2, hidden_dim)

    def forward(self, img_feats, tab_feats):
        img_proj = F.gelu(self.img_proj(img_feats))
        tab_proj = F.gelu(self.tab_proj(tab_feats))

        # Concatenate features and add transformer processing
        combined = torch.cat([img_proj.unsqueeze(1), tab_proj.unsqueeze(1)], dim=1)
        transformed = self.transformer(combined)
        fused = self.norm(transformed.mean(dim=1))
        return self.final_proj(fused)

class LabelSmoothingCrossEntropy(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, smoothing=0.1):
        super().__init__()
        self.smoothing = smoothing
        self.confidence = 1.0 - smoothing

    def forward(self, x, target):
        log_probs = nn.functional.log_softmax(x, dim=-1)
        nll_loss = -log_probs.gather(dim=-1, index=target.unsqueeze(1))
        nll_loss = nll_loss.squeeze(1)

            nn.Linear(40, 256),
            nn.BatchNorm1d(256),
            nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Dropout(0.3),
            nn.Linear(256, 128),
            nn.BatchNorm1d(128),
            nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Dropout(0.3),
        )
        self.shape_branch = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(40, 256),
            nn.BatchNorm1d(256),
            nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Dropout(0.3),
            nn.Linear(256, 128),
            nn.BatchNorm1d(128),
            nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Dropout(0.3),
        )
        self.texture_branch = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(40, 256),
            nn.BatchNorm1d(256),
            nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Dropout(0.3),
            nn.Linear(256, 128),
            nn.BatchNorm1d(128),
            nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Dropout(0.3),
        )
        self.gate = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(384, 64), nn.ReLU(), nn.Linear(64, 3), nn.Sigmoid()
        )
        self.classifier = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(384, 256),
            nn.BatchNorm1d(256),
            nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Dropout(0.5),
            nn.Linear(256, num_classes),
        )

    def forward(self, x):
        margin = self.margin_branch(x[:, :40])
        shape = self.shape_branch(x[:, 40:80])
        texture = self.texture_branch(x[:, 80:120])
        combined = torch.cat([margin, shape, texture], dim=1)
        gates = self.gate(combined)
        gated_combined = torch.cat(
            [
                margin * gates[:, 0].unsqueeze(1),
                shape * gates[:, 1].unsqueeze(1),
                texture * gates[:, 2].unsqueeze(1),
            ],
            dim=1,
        )
        return self.classifier(gated_combined)

        optimizer.zero_grad()
        outputs = model(mixed_x)
        loss = lam * criterion(outputs, y_a) + (1 - lam) * criterion(outputs, y_b)
        loss.backward()

        train_loss += loss.item()

    val_probs, val_true = [], []

class LeafDataset(Dataset):
    def __init__(self, df, feature_matrix, image_dir, mode="train", transform=None):
        self.df = df
        self.features = feature_matrix
        self.image_dir = image_dir
        self.mode = mode
        self.transform = transform or transforms.Compose(
            [
                transforms.Resize((224, 224)),
                transforms.Grayscale(num_output_channels=3),
                transforms.ToTensor(),
                transforms.Normalize([0.485, 0.456, 0.406], [0.229, 0.224, 0.225]),
            ]
        )

    def __len__(self):
        return len(self.df)

    def __getitem__(self, idx):
        img_id = self.df.iloc[idx]["id"]
        img_path = os.path.join(self.image_dir, f"{img_id}.jpg")
        image = Image.open(img_path)
        features = self.features[idx]

        if self.transform:
            image = self.transform(image)

        if self.mode == "train":
            label = self.df.iloc[idx]["species"]
            return image, features, label
        return image, features


# Feature Extraction Model
class FeatureExtractor(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__()
        effnet = models.efficientnet_b0(pretrained=True)
        self.features = nn.Sequential(*list(effnet.children())[:-1])

    def forward(self, x):
        x = self.features(x)
        return x.flatten(1)


# Main Classifier Model
class MultimodalLeafClassifier(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, num_tabular_features, num_classes):
        super().__init__()
        self.image_extractor = FeatureExtractor()

        # Image branch
        self.image_processor = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(1280, 512), nn.BatchNorm1d(512), nn.ReLU(), nn.Dropout(0.3)
        )

        # Tabular branch
        self.tabular_processor = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(num_tabular_features, 512),
            nn.BatchNorm1d(512),
            nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Dropout(0.3),
        )

        # Combined classifier
        self.classifier = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(1024, 512),
            nn.BatchNorm1d(512),
            nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Dropout(0.5),
            nn.Linear(512, num_classes),
        )

    def forward(self, img, tab):
        img_features = self.image_extractor(img)
        img_processed = self.image_processor(img_features)
        tab_processed = self.tabular_processor(tab)
        combined = torch.cat([img_processed, tab_processed], dim=1)
        return self.classifier(combined)

class LabelSmoothingCrossEntropy(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, smoothing=0.1):
        super().__init__()
        self.smoothing = smoothing
        self.confidence = 1.0 - smoothing

    def forward(self, x, target):
        log_probs = nn.functional.log_softmax(x, dim=-1)
        nll_loss = -log_probs.gather(dim=-1, index=target.unsqueeze(1))
        nll_loss = nll_loss.squeeze(1)
        smooth_loss = -log_probs.mean(dim=-1)
        loss = self.confidence * nll_loss + self.smoothing * smooth_loss
        return loss.mean()

    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__()
        self.cnn = models.efficientnet_b3(pretrained=True)
        self.cnn.classifier = nn.Identity()

        # Tabular processing branch
        self.tabular_fc = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(192, 512), nn.BatchNorm1d(512), nn.ReLU(), nn.Dropout(0.3)
        )

        # FiLM generator network
        self.film_generator = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(512, 512),
            nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Linear(512, 2 * 1536),
        )

        # Image processing after FiLM
        self.image_fc = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(1536, 256), nn.BatchNorm1d(256), nn.ReLU(), nn.Dropout(0.5)
        )

        # Combined classifier

            nn.Linear(256 + 512, 512),
            nn.BatchNorm1d(512),
            nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Dropout(0.5),
            nn.Linear(512, 99),
        )

    def forward(self, img, tabular):
        # Process tabular data
        tab_features = self.tabular_fc(tabular)

        # Generate FiLM parameters
        film_params = self.film_generator(tab_features)
        gamma, beta = torch.chunk(film_params, 2, dim=1)

        # Process image with FiLM modulation
        img_features = self.cnn(img)
        img_features = gamma * img_features + beta
        img_features = self.image_fc(img_features)

        # Combine features
        combined = torch.cat([img_features, tab_features], dim=1)
        return self.classifier(combined)

EPOCHS = 100
PATIENCE = 20
LR = 0.0005
WEIGHT_DECAY = 1e-4
SMOOTHING = 0.1
MIXUP_ALPHA = 0.4


class TransformerFusion(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, img_dim, tab_dim, hidden_dim):
        super().__init__()
        self.img_proj = nn.Linear(img_dim, hidden_dim)
        self.tab_proj = nn.Linear(tab_dim, hidden_dim)

        self.transformer = nn.TransformerEncoder(
            nn.TransformerEncoderLayer(
                d_model=hidden_dim,  # Fixed dimension
                nhead=8,
                dim_feedforward=hidden_dim * 4,
                dropout=0.2,
                activation="gelu",
                batch_first=True,
            ),
            num_layers=4,
        )
        self.norm = nn.LayerNorm(hidden_dim)
        self.final_proj = nn.Linear(hidden_dim, hidden_dim)

    def forward(self, img_feats, tab_feats):
        img_proj = F.gelu(self.img_proj(img_feats))
        tab_proj = F.gelu(self.tab_proj(tab_feats))

        combined = torch.stack([img_proj, tab_proj], dim=1)
        transformed = self.transformer(combined)
        fused = self.norm(transformed.mean(dim=1))
        return self.final_proj(fused)


class EnhancedLeafClassifier(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, num_classes, tabular_size):
        super().__init__()
        self.cnn = efficientnet_b5(weights=EfficientNet_B5_Weights.IMAGENET1K_V1)
        self.cnn.classifier = nn.Identity()

        self.tabular_net = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(tabular_size, 1024),
            nn.BatchNorm1d(1024),
            nn.GELU(),
            nn.Dropout(0.5),
        )

        self.fusion = TransformerFusion(2048, 1024, 1024)

        self.classifier = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(1024, 512),
            nn.BatchNorm1d(512),
            nn.GELU(),
            nn.Dropout(0.3),
            nn.Linear(512, num_classes),
        )

    def forward(self, img, tabular):
        img_feats = self.cnn(img)
        tab_feats = self.tabular_net(tabular)
        fused = self.fusion(img_feats, tab_feats)
        return self.classifier(fused)


def mixup_data(x, t, y, alpha=1.0):
    if alpha > 0:
        lam = np.random.beta(alpha, alpha)
    else:
        lam = 1
    batch_size = x.size(0)
    index = torch.randperm(batch_size).to(DEVICE)
    mixed_x = lam * x + (1 - lam) * x[index]
    mixed_t = lam * t + (1 - lam) * t[index]
    return mixed_x, mixed_t, y, y[index], lam


def mixup_criterion(criterion, pred, y_a, y_b, lam):
    return lam * criterion(pred, y_a) + (1 - lam) * criterion(pred, y_b)


class LeafDataset(Dataset):
    def __init__(self, df, tabular_data, img_dir, mode="train"):
        self.df = df
        self.tabular_data = tabular_data
        self.img_dir = img_dir
        self.mode = mode
        self.augment = (
            transforms.Compose(
                [
                    transforms.Resize(530),
                    transforms.RandomResizedCrop(456, scale=(0.6, 1.0)),
                    transforms.RandomHorizontalFlip(p=0.5),
                    transforms.RandomVerticalFlip(p=0.5),
                    transforms.RandAugment(num_ops=3, magnitude=9),
                    transforms.ToTensor(),
                    transforms.Normalize([0.485, 0.456, 0.406], [0.229, 0.224, 0.225]),
                    transforms.RandomErasing(p=0.3, scale=(0.02, 0.15)),
                ]
            )
            if mode == "train"
            else transforms.Compose(
                [
                    transforms.Resize(530),
                    transforms.CenterCrop(456),
                    transforms.ToTensor(),
                    transforms.Normalize([0.485, 0.456, 0.406], [0.229, 0.224, 0.225]),
                ]
            )
        )

    def __len__(self):
        return len(self.df)

    def __getitem__(self, idx):
        img_id = str(int(self.df.iloc[idx]["id"]))
        img_path = f"{self.img_dir}/{img_id}.jpg"
        try:
            img = Image.open(img_path).convert("RGB")
        except:
            img = Image.new("RGB", (456, 456), (255, 255, 255))
        img = self.augment(img)
        tabular = self.tabular_data[idx]
        return (
            (img, tabular)
            if self.mode == "test"
            else (img, tabular, torch.tensor(self.df.iloc[idx]["label"]))
        )

class LeafDataset(Dataset):
    def __init__(self, df, feature_matrix, image_dir, labels=None, transform=None):
        self.df = df
