        self.image_dir = image_dir
        self.labels = labels  # Pre-encoded labels

        if self.labels is not None:

class FeatureExtractor(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__()
        effnet = models.efficientnet_b0(pretrained=True)
        self.features = nn.Sequential(*list(effnet.children())[:-1])

    def forward(self, x):
        x = self.features(x)
        return x.flatten(1)


class MultimodalLeafClassifier(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, num_tabular_features, num_classes):
        super().__init__()
        self.image_extractor = FeatureExtractor()
        self.image_processor = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(1280, 512), nn.BatchNorm1d(512), nn.ReLU(), nn.Dropout(0.3)
        )
        self.tabular_processor = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(num_tabular_features, 512),
            nn.BatchNorm1d(512),
            nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Dropout(0.3),
        )
        self.classifier = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(1024, 512),
            nn.BatchNorm1d(512),
            nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Dropout(0.5),
            nn.Linear(512, num_classes),
        )

    def forward(self, img, tab):
        img_features = self.image_extractor(img)
        img_processed = self.image_processor(img_features)
        tab_processed = self.tabular_processor(tab)
        combined = torch.cat([img_processed, tab_processed], dim=1)
        return self.classifier(combined)

class TransformerFusion(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, img_dim, tab_dim, hidden_dim):
        super().__init__()
        self.img_proj = nn.Linear(img_dim, hidden_dim)
        self.tab_proj = nn.Linear(tab_dim, hidden_dim)
        self.transformer = nn.TransformerEncoder(
            nn.TransformerEncoderLayer(
                d_model=hidden_dim,
                nhead=8,
                dim_feedforward=hidden_dim * 4,
                dropout=0.2,
                activation="gelu",
                batch_first=True,
            ),
            num_layers=4,
        )
        self.norm = nn.LayerNorm(hidden_dim)
        self.final_proj = nn.Linear(hidden_dim, hidden_dim)

    def forward(self, img_feats, tab_feats):
        img_proj = F.gelu(self.img_proj(img_feats))
        tab_proj = F.gelu(self.tab_proj(tab_feats))
        combined = torch.stack([img_proj, tab_proj], dim=1)
        transformed = self.transformer(combined)
        fused = self.norm(transformed.mean(dim=1))
        return self.final_proj(fused)


class EnhancedLeafClassifier(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, num_classes, tabular_size):
        super().__init__()
        self.cnn = efficientnet_b5(weights=EfficientNet_B5_Weights.IMAGENET1K_V1)
        self.cnn.classifier = nn.Identity()
        self.tabular_net = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(tabular_size, 1024),
            nn.BatchNorm1d(1024),
            nn.GELU(),
            nn.Dropout(0.5),
        )
        self.fusion = TransformerFusion(2048, 1024, 1024)
        self.classifier = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(1024, 512),
            nn.BatchNorm1d(512),
            nn.GELU(),
            nn.Dropout(0.3),
            nn.Linear(512, num_classes),
        )

    def forward(self, img, tabular):
        img_feats = self.cnn(img)
        tab_feats = self.tabular_net(tabular)
        fused = self.fusion(img_feats, tab_feats)
        return self.classifier(fused)


class LeafDataset(Dataset):
    def __init__(self, df, tabular_data, img_dir, mode="train"):
        self.df = df
        self.tabular_data = tabular_data
        self.img_dir = img_dir
        self.mode = mode
        self.augment = (
            transforms.Compose(
                [
                    transforms.Resize(530),
                    transforms.RandomResizedCrop(456, scale=(0.6, 1.0)),
                    transforms.RandomHorizontalFlip(p=0.5),
                    transforms.RandomVerticalFlip(p=0.5),
                    transforms.RandAugment(num_ops=3, magnitude=9),
                    transforms.ToTensor(),
                    transforms.Normalize([0.485, 0.456, 0.406], [0.229, 0.224, 0.225]),
                    transforms.RandomErasing(p=0.3, scale=(0.02, 0.15)),
                ]
            )
            if mode == "train"
            else transforms.Compose([transforms.Resize(530)])
        )

    def __len__(self):
        return len(self.df)

    def __getitem__(self, idx):
        img_id = str(int(self.df.iloc[idx]["id"]))
        img_path = f"{self.img_dir}/{img_id}.jpg"
        try:
            img = Image.open(img_path).convert("RGB")
        except:
            img = Image.new("RGB", (456, 456), (255, 255, 255))
        img = self.augment(img)
        tabular = self.tabular_data[idx]
        return (
            (img, tabular)
            if self.mode == "test"
            else (img, tabular, torch.tensor(self.df.iloc[idx]["label"]))
        )

def mixup_data(x, tabular, y, alpha=1.0):
    if alpha > 0:
        lam = np.random.beta(alpha, alpha)
    else:
        lam = 1
    batch_size = x.size(0)
    index = torch.randperm(batch_size).to(x.device)
    mixed_x = lam * x + (1 - lam) * x[index]
    mixed_tab = lam * tabular + (1 - lam) * tabular[index]
    y_a, y_b = y, y[index]
    return mixed_x, mixed_tab, y_a, y_b, lam


def mixup_criterion(criterion, pred, y_a, y_b, lam):
    return lam * criterion(pred, y_a) + (1 - lam) * criterion(pred, y_b)

class LeafDataset(Dataset):

        self.df = df
        self.tabular = tabular_data
        self.img_dir = img_dir
        self.mode = mode
        self.transform = transform or transforms.Compose(
            [
                transforms.Resize((456, 456)),
                transforms.ToTensor(),
                transforms.Normalize(
                    mean=[0.485, 0.456, 0.406], std=[0.229, 0.224, 0.225]
                ),
            ]
        )

        if mode == "train":
            self.aug = transforms.Compose(
                [
                    transforms.RandomHorizontalFlip(),
                    transforms.RandomRotation(15),
                    transforms.ColorJitter(
                        brightness=0.2, contrast=0.2, saturation=0.2
                    ),
                ]

        return len(self.df)

        img = Image.open(img_path).convert("RGB")

        if self.mode == "train":
            img = self.aug(img)
        img = self.transform(img)

        tab = self.tabular[idx]

        if self.mode == "test":
            return img, tab
        else:
            label = self.df.iloc[idx]["species"]
            return img, tab, label


# Model definition
class LeafModel(nn.Module):

        super().__init__()
        self.cnn = efficientnet_b5(weights=EfficientNet_B5_Weights.IMAGENET1K_V1)
        in_features = self.cnn.classifier[1].in_features
        self.cnn.classifier = nn.Identity()

        self.tabular_fc = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(tabular_size, 512),
            nn.BatchNorm1d(512),
            nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Dropout(0.3),
        )

        self.classifier = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(in_features + 512, 1024),
            nn.BatchNorm1d(1024),
            nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Dropout(0.5),
            nn.Linear(1024, num_classes),
        )

    def forward(self, img, tab):
        img_feat = self.cnn(img)
        tab_feat = self.tabular_fc(tab)
        combined = torch.cat([img_feat, tab_feat], dim=1)
        return self.classifier(combined)

# Dataset class
class LeafDataset(Dataset):
    def __init__(
        self, df, features, labels=None, image_dir="./input/images", is_test=False
    ):
        self.df = df.reset_index(drop=True)
        self.features = features
        self.labels = labels
        self.image_dir = image_dir
        self.transform = transforms.Compose(
            [
                transforms.Resize((224, 224)),
                transforms.Grayscale(num_output_channels=3),
                transforms.ToTensor(),
                transforms.Normalize([0.485, 0.456, 0.406], [0.229, 0.224, 0.225]),
            ]
        )
        self.is_test = is_test

    def __len__(self):
        return len(self.df)

    def __getitem__(self, idx):
        img_id = self.df.loc[idx, "id"]
        try:
            img = Image.open(f"{self.image_dir}/{img_id}.jpg")
        except:
            img = Image.new("RGB", (224, 224))  # Blank for missing

        img = self.transform(img)
        features = torch.FloatTensor(self.features[idx])

        if self.is_test:
            return img, features
        return img, features, torch.LongTensor([self.labels[idx]])


# Model architecture
class MultiInputModel(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, num_features, num_classes):
        super().__init__()
        self.cnn = models.resnet18(pretrained=True)
        self.cnn.fc = nn.Linear(self.cnn.fc.in_features, 128)
        self.feature_net = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(num_features, 256),
            nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Dropout(0.3),
            nn.Linear(256, 128),
        )
        self.classifier = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(256, 128), nn.ReLU(), nn.Dropout(0.3), nn.Linear(128, num_classes)
        )

    def forward(self, img, features):
        img_features = self.cnn(img)
        tab_features = self.feature_net(features)
        combined = torch.cat([img_features, tab_features], dim=1)
        return self.classifier(combined)


# Training setup

        for img, feats, labels in val_loader:
            img, feats, labels = img.to(device), feats.to(device), labels.to(device)
            outputs = model(img, feats)
            val_loss += criterion(outputs, labels.squeeze()).item()

    if val_loss < best_loss:
        best_loss = val_loss
        torch.save(model.state_dict(), "./working/best_model.pt")

# Squeeze-and-Excitation Block
class SEBlock(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, channels, reduction=16):
        super().__init__()
        self.avg_pool = nn.AdaptiveAvgPool1d(1)
        self.fc = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(channels, channels // reduction),
            nn.GELU(),
            nn.Linear(channels // reduction, channels),
            nn.Sigmoid(),
        )

    def forward(self, x):
        b, c = x.size()
        y = self.avg_pool(x.unsqueeze(2)).view(b, c)
        y = self.fc(y)
        return x * y

class SEBlock(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, channels, reduction=16):
        super().__init__()
        self.avg_pool = nn.AdaptiveAvgPool1d(1)
        self.fc = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(channels, channels // reduction),
            nn.GELU(),
            nn.Linear(channels // reduction, channels),
            nn.Sigmoid(),
        )

    def forward(self, x):
        b, c = x.size()
        y = self.avg_pool(x.unsqueeze(2)).view(b, c)
        y = self.fc(y)
        return x * y


class LeafClassifier(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, num_classes):
        super().__init__()
        # Feature branches
        self.margin_net = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(64, 256),
            nn.BatchNorm1d(256),
            nn.GELU(),
            SEBlock(256),
            nn.Dropout(0.4),
        )
        self.shape_net = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(64, 256),
            nn.BatchNorm1d(256),
            nn.GELU(),
            SEBlock(256),
            nn.Dropout(0.4),
        )
        self.texture_net = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(64, 256),
            nn.BatchNorm1d(256),
            nn.GELU(),
            SEBlock(256),
            nn.Dropout(0.4),
        )
        self.image_net = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(512, 256),
            nn.BatchNorm1d(256),
            nn.GELU(),
            SEBlock(256),
            nn.Dropout(0.4),
        )

        # Multimodal fusion
        self.classifier = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(256 * 10, 1536),
            nn.BatchNorm1d(1536),
            nn.GELU(),
            nn.Dropout(0.5),
            nn.Linear(1536, 768),
            nn.BatchNorm1d(768),
            nn.GELU(),
            nn.Dropout(0.3),
            nn.Linear(768, num_classes),
        )

    def forward(self, m, s, t, i):
        m = self.margin_net(m)
        s = self.shape_net(s)
        t = self.texture_net(t)
        i = self.image_net(i)

        interactions = torch.cat(
            [
                m * s,
                m * t,
                m * i,
                s * t,
                s * i,
                t * i,
                (m + s + t + i),
                (m * s * t * i),
            ],
            dim=1,
        )

        return self.classifier(interactions)

class LeafDataset(Dataset):
    def __init__(self, df, tabular_data, img_dir, mode="train", transform=None):
        self.df = df
        self.tabular = tabular_data.astype(np.float32)
        self.img_dir = img_dir
        self.mode = mode
        self.transform = transform or transforms.Compose(
            [
                transforms.Resize((456, 456)),
                transforms.ToTensor(),
                transforms.Normalize(
                    mean=[0.485, 0.456, 0.406], std=[0.229, 0.224, 0.225]
                ),
            ]
        )
        self.aug = (
            transforms.Compose(
                [
                    transforms.RandomHorizontalFlip(),
                    transforms.RandomRotation(15),
                    transforms.ColorJitter(
                        brightness=0.2, contrast=0.2, saturation=0.2
                    ),
                ]
            )
            if mode == "train"
            else None
        )

    def __len__(self):
        return len(self.df)

    def __getitem__(self, idx):
        img_id = self.df.iloc[idx]["id"]
        img_path = os.path.join(self.img_dir, f"{img_id}.jpg")
        img = Image.open(img_path).convert("RGB")

        if self.mode == "train" and self.aug:
            img = self.aug(img)
        img = self.transform(img)

        tab = torch.tensor(self.tabular[idx])

        if self.mode == "test":
            return img, tab
        else:
            label = torch.tensor(self.df.iloc[idx]["label"], dtype=torch.long)
            return img, tab, label


class LeafModel(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, num_classes, tabular_size):
        super().__init__()
        self.cnn = efficientnet_b5(weights=EfficientNet_B5_Weights.IMAGENET1K_V1)
        in_features = self.cnn.classifier[1].in_features
        self.cnn.classifier = nn.Identity()

        self.tabular_fc = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(tabular_size, 512),
            nn.BatchNorm1d(512),
            nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Dropout(0.3),
        )

        self.classifier = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(in_features + 512, 1024),
            nn.BatchNorm1d(1024),
            nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Dropout(0.5),
            nn.Linear(1024, num_classes),
        )

    def forward(self, img, tab):
        img_feat = self.cnn(img)
        tab_feat = self.tabular_fc(tab)
        combined = torch.cat([img_feat, tab_feat], dim=1)
        return self.classifier(combined)

class LabelSmoothingCrossEntropy(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, smoothing=0.1):
        super().__init__()
        self.smoothing = smoothing
        self.confidence = 1.0 - smoothing

    def forward(self, x, target):
        log_probs = F.log_softmax(x, dim=-1)
        nll_loss = -log_probs.gather(dim=-1, index=target.unsqueeze(1))
        nll_loss = nll_loss.squeeze(1)
        smooth_loss = -log_probs.mean(dim=-1)
        loss = self.confidence * nll_loss + self.smoothing * smooth_loss
        return loss.mean()

# Enhanced configuration

BATCH_SIZE = 32

test_df = pd.read_csv("input/test.csv")

X_test_tab = test_df[tabular_features].values

)


# Enhanced Dataset class with improved augmentations
class LeafDataset(Dataset):
    def __init__(self, ids, tab_data, labels=None, mode="train"):
        self.ids = ids
        self.tab_data = tab_data
        self.labels = labels
        self.mode = mode

        self.transform = (
            transforms.Compose(
                [
                    transforms.Resize(IMG_SIZE),
                    transforms.RandomResizedCrop(IMG_SIZE - 40, scale=(0.7, 1.0)),
                    transforms.RandomHorizontalFlip(),
                    transforms.RandomVerticalFlip(),
                    transforms.RandomRotation(45),
                    transforms.RandomAffine(
                        degrees=0, translate=(0.15, 0.15), scale=(0.8, 1.2), shear=15
                    ),
                    transforms.ToTensor(),
                    transforms.Normalize([0.485, 0.456, 0.406], [0.229, 0.224, 0.225]),
                    transforms.RandomErasing(
                        p=0.6, scale=(0.03, 0.12), ratio=(0.3, 3.3)
                    ),
                ]
            )
            if mode == "train"
            else transforms.Compose(
                [
                    transforms.Resize(IMG_SIZE),
                    transforms.CenterCrop(IMG_SIZE - 40),
                    transforms.ToTensor(),
                    transforms.Normalize([0.485, 0.456, 0.406], [0.229, 0.224, 0.225]),
                ]
            )
        )

    def __len__(self):
        return len(self.ids)

    def __getitem__(self, idx):
        img_path = f"input/images/{self.ids.iloc[idx]}.jpg"
        image = Image.open(img_path).convert("RGB")
        image = self.transform(image)
        tabular = torch.FloatTensor(self.tab_data[idx])
        return (
            (image, tabular, self.labels[idx])
            if self.labels is not None
            else (image, tabular)
        )


# Attention fusion with projection
class AttentionFusion(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, img_feat_size, tab_feat_size):
        super().__init__()
        self.tab_proj = nn.Linear(tab_feat_size, img_feat_size)
        self.attn = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(img_feat_size * 2, 512),
            nn.Tanh(),
            nn.Linear(512, 1),
            nn.Sigmoid(),
        )

    def forward(self, img_feat, tab_feat):
        tab_proj = self.tab_proj(tab_feat)
        combined = torch.cat([img_feat, tab_proj], dim=1)
        attn_weights = self.attn(combined)
        return attn_weights * img_feat + (1 - attn_weights) * tab_proj


# Upgraded model architecture with EfficientNet-B4
class LeafModel(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__()
        self.img_net = models.efficientnet_b4(pretrained=True)
        self.img_net.classifier = nn.Identity()

        self.tab_net = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(X_tab.shape[1], 1024),
            nn.BatchNorm1d(1024),
            nn.SiLU(),
            nn.Dropout(0.5),
            nn.Linear(1024, 512),
            nn.BatchNorm1d(512),
            nn.SiLU(),
        )

        self.fusion = AttentionFusion(1792, 512)
        self.classifier = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(1792, 1024),
            nn.BatchNorm1d(1024),
            nn.SiLU(),
            nn.Dropout(0.4),
            nn.Linear(1024, NUM_CLASSES),
        )

    def forward(self, img, tab):
        img_feat = self.img_net(img)
        tab_feat = self.tab_net(tab)
        fused = self.fusion(img_feat, tab_feat)
        return self.classifier(fused)


# Initialize model
model = LeafModel().to(DEVICE)

)
test_loader = DataLoader(

)

# Training setup with label smoothing
criterion = nn.CrossEntropyLoss(label_smoothing=0.1)
optimizer = torch.optim.AdamW(model.parameters(), lr=1e-4, weight_decay=1e-4)
scheduler = ReduceLROnPlateau(optimizer, "min", patience=2, factor=0.5)

# Training loop
best_loss = float("inf")
for epoch in range(EPOCHS):
    model.train()
    train_loss = 0
    for img, tab, y_batch in tqdm(train_loader, desc=f"Epoch {epoch+1}"):
        img, tab, y_batch = img.to(DEVICE), tab.to(DEVICE), y_batch.to(DEVICE)
        optimizer.zero_grad()
        outputs = model(img, tab)

        train_loss += loss.item() * img.size(0)

    # Validation
    model.eval()
    val_loss = 0
    val_preds = []
    val_true = []
    with torch.no_grad():
        for img, tab, y_batch in val_loader:
            img, tab, y_batch = img.to(DEVICE), tab.to(DEVICE), y_batch.to(DEVICE)

            val_preds.append(F.softmax(outputs, dim=1).cpu().numpy())

    # Metrics
    train_loss /= len(train_idx)
    val_loss /= len(val_idx)
    val_preds = np.concatenate(val_preds)
    val_true = np.concatenate(val_true)
    val_logloss = log_loss(val_true, val_preds)

    print(
        f"Epoch {epoch+1}: Train Loss: {train_loss:.4f} | Val LogLoss: {val_logloss:.4f}"

    scheduler.step(val_logloss)

    if val_logloss < best_loss:

# Generate predictions

model.eval()

class SEBlock(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, channels, reduction=16):
        super().__init__()
        self.avg_pool = nn.AdaptiveAvgPool1d(1)
        self.fc = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(channels, channels // reduction),
            nn.GELU(),
            nn.Linear(channels // reduction, channels),
            nn.Sigmoid(),
        )

    def forward(self, x):
        b, c = x.size()
        y = self.avg_pool(x.unsqueeze(2)).view(b, c)
        y = self.fc(y)
        return x * y


class LeafClassifier(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, num_classes):
        super().__init__()
        self.margin_net = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(64, 256),
            nn.BatchNorm1d(256),
            nn.GELU(),
            SEBlock(256),
            nn.Dropout(0.4),
        )
        self.shape_net = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(64, 256),
            nn.BatchNorm1d(256),
            nn.GELU(),
            SEBlock(256),
            nn.Dropout(0.4),
        )
        self.texture_net = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(64, 256),
            nn.BatchNorm1d(256),
            nn.GELU(),
            SEBlock(256),
            nn.Dropout(0.4),
        )
        self.image_net = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(512, 256),
            nn.BatchNorm1d(256),
            nn.GELU(),
            SEBlock(256),
            nn.Dropout(0.4),
        )

        self.classifier = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(256 * 8, 1536),
            nn.BatchNorm1d(1536),
            nn.GELU(),
            nn.Dropout(0.5),
            nn.Linear(1536, 768),
            nn.BatchNorm1d(768),
            nn.GELU(),
            nn.Dropout(0.3),
            nn.Linear(768, num_classes),
        )

    def forward(self, m, s, t, i):
        m = self.margin_net(m)
        s = self.shape_net(s)
        t = self.texture_net(t)
        i = self.image_net(i)

        interactions = torch.cat(
            [
                m * s,
                m * t,
                m * i,
                s * t,
                s * i,
                t * i,
                (m + s + t + i),
                (m * s * t * i),
            ],
            dim=1,
        )
        return self.classifier(interactions)

class LabelSmoothingCrossEntropy(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, smoothing=0.1):
        super().__init__()
        self.smoothing = smoothing
        self.confidence = 1.0 - smoothing

    def forward(self, x, target):
        log_probs = F.log_softmax(x, dim=-1)
        nll_loss = -log_probs.gather(dim=-1, index=target.unsqueeze(1))
        nll_loss = nll_loss.squeeze(1)
        smooth_loss = -log_probs.mean(dim=-1)
        loss = self.confidence * nll_loss + self.smoothing * smooth_loss
        return loss.mean()

    def forward(self, x):

        scores = torch.cat(

        margin = margin * attn_weights[:, 0].unsqueeze(1)

        texture = texture * attn_weights[:, 2].unsqueeze(1)
        image_feat = image_feat * attn_weights[:, 3].unsqueeze(1)

        combined = torch.cat([margin, shape, texture, image_feat], dim=1)
        return self.classifier(combined)

class LeafDataset(Dataset):
    def __init__(self, ids, tab_data, labels=None, mode="train"):
        self.ids = ids
        self.tab_data = tab_data
        self.labels = labels
        self.mode = mode

        self.transform = (
            transforms.Compose(
                [
                    transforms.Resize(IMG_SIZE),
                    transforms.RandomResizedCrop(IMG_SIZE - 40, scale=(0.7, 1.0)),
                    transforms.RandomHorizontalFlip(),

                    transforms.RandomErasing(

                    ),
                ]
            )
            if mode == "train"

                    transforms.ToTensor(),
                    transforms.Normalize([0.485, 0.456, 0.406], [0.229, 0.224, 0.225]),
                ]
            )
        )

        )


class CrossAttentionFusion(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, img_dim, tab_dim, num_heads=8):
        super().__init__()
        self.img_proj = nn.Linear(img_dim, img_dim)
        self.tab_proj = nn.Linear(tab_dim, img_dim)
        self.attention = nn.MultiheadAttention(img_dim, num_heads, batch_first=True)
        self.norm = nn.LayerNorm(img_dim)

    def forward(self, img_feats, tab_feats):
        # Project both modalities to same dimension
        img_proj = self.img_proj(img_feats.unsqueeze(1))  # [B, 1, D]
        tab_proj = self.tab_proj(tab_feats.unsqueeze(1))  # [B, 1, D]

        # Cross attention
        attn_output, _ = self.attention(query=img_proj, key=tab_proj, value=tab_proj)
        fused = self.norm(img_proj + attn_output)
        return fused.squeeze(1)


class LeafModel(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__()
        self.img_net = models.efficientnet_b4(pretrained=True)
        self.img_net.classifier = nn.Identity()

        self.tab_net = nn.Sequential(

            nn.Dropout(0.5),
            nn.Linear(1024, 512),
            nn.BatchNorm1d(512),
            nn.SiLU(),
        )

        self.fusion = CrossAttentionFusion(1792, 512)
        self.classifier = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(1792, 1024),
            nn.BatchNorm1d(1024),
            nn.SiLU(),
            nn.Dropout(0.4),
            nn.Linear(1024, NUM_CLASSES),
        )

    def forward(self, img, tab):
        img_feat = self.img_net(img)  # [B, 1792]
        tab_feat = self.tab_net(tab)  # [B, 512]
        fused = self.fusion(img_feat, tab_feat)
        return self.classifier(fused)

class SEBlock(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, channels, reduction=16):
        super().__init__()
        self.avg_pool = nn.AdaptiveAvgPool1d(1)
        self.fc = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(channels, channels // reduction),
            nn.GELU(),
            nn.Linear(channels // reduction, channels),
            nn.Sigmoid(),
        )

    def forward(self, x):
        b, c = x.size()
        y = self.avg_pool(x.unsqueeze(2)).view(b, c)
        y = self.fc(y)
        return x * y


class LeafClassifier(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, num_classes):
        super().__init__()
        self.margin_net = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(64, 512),
            nn.BatchNorm1d(512),
            nn.GELU(),
            SEBlock(512),
            nn.Dropout(0.4),
        )
        self.shape_net = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(64, 512),
            nn.BatchNorm1d(512),
            nn.GELU(),
            SEBlock(512),
            nn.Dropout(0.4),
        )
        self.texture_net = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(64, 512),
            nn.BatchNorm1d(512),
            nn.GELU(),
            SEBlock(512),
            nn.Dropout(0.4),
        )
        self.image_net = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(512, 512),
            nn.BatchNorm1d(512),
            nn.GELU(),
            SEBlock(512),
            nn.Dropout(0.4),
        )

        self.pos_embed = nn.Parameter(torch.randn(4, 512))
        self.transformer = nn.TransformerEncoder(
            nn.TransformerEncoderLayer(
                d_model=512, nhead=8, dim_feedforward=2048, dropout=0.1
            ),
            num_layers=3,
        )

        self.classifier = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(512 * 4, 2048),
            nn.BatchNorm1d(2048),
            nn.GELU(),
            nn.Dropout(0.5),
            nn.Linear(2048, 1024),
            nn.BatchNorm1d(1024),
            nn.GELU(),
            nn.Dropout(0.3),
            nn.Linear(1024, num_classes),
        )

    def forward(self, m, s, t, i):
        m = self.margin_net(m)
        s = self.shape_net(s)
        t = self.texture_net(t)
        i = self.image_net(i)

        features = torch.stack([m, s, t, i], dim=1) + self.pos_embed.unsqueeze(0)
        features = features.permute(1, 0, 2)  # [seq, batch, features]
        transformed = self.transformer(features)
        transformed = (
            transformed.permute(1, 0, 2).contiguous().view(transformed.size(1), -1)
        )

        return self.classifier(transformed)


def extract_features(df):
    return [
        df.filter(regex="margin").values,

        for param in self.resnet.layer4.parameters():

        return self.classifier(combined)

        self.tab_proj = nn.Linear(tab_dim, img_dim)
        self.attention = nn.MultiheadAttention(img_dim, num_heads, batch_first=True)
        self.norm = nn.LayerNorm(img_dim)

    def forward(self, img_feats, tab_feats):
        img_proj = self.img_proj(img_feats.unsqueeze(1))
        tab_proj = self.tab_proj(tab_feats.unsqueeze(1))
        attn_output, _ = self.attention(query=img_proj, key=tab_proj, value=tab_proj)
        fused = self.norm(img_proj + attn_output)
        return fused.squeeze(1)

class HierarchicalFusion(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, img_dim, tab_dim, num_heads=8):
        super().__init__()
        # Self-attention layers for each modality
        self.img_self_attn = nn.MultiheadAttention(img_dim, num_heads, batch_first=True)
        self.tab_self_attn = nn.MultiheadAttention(tab_dim, num_heads, batch_first=True)

        # Cross-attention layers
        self.img_cross = nn.MultiheadAttention(img_dim, num_heads, batch_first=True)
        self.tab_cross = nn.MultiheadAttention(tab_dim, num_heads, batch_first=True)

        # Gating mechanism
        self.gate = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(img_dim + tab_dim, (img_dim + tab_dim) // 2),
            nn.SiLU(),
            nn.Linear((img_dim + tab_dim) // 2, 2),
            nn.Softmax(dim=-1),
        )

        # Normalization layers
        self.norm_img = nn.LayerNorm(img_dim)
        self.norm_tab = nn.LayerNorm(tab_dim)
        self.norm_fusion = nn.LayerNorm(img_dim + tab_dim)

        # Projection layers
        self.img_proj = nn.Linear(img_dim, img_dim)
        self.tab_proj = nn.Linear(tab_dim, tab_dim)

    def forward(self, img_feats, tab_feats):
        # Self-attention refinement
        img_self, _ = self.img_self_attn(
            img_feats.unsqueeze(1), img_feats.unsqueeze(1), img_feats.unsqueeze(1)
        )
        tab_self, _ = self.tab_self_attn(
            tab_feats.unsqueeze(1), tab_feats.unsqueeze(1), tab_feats.unsqueeze(1)
        )

        # Cross-attention interaction
        img_cross, _ = self.img_cross(img_self, tab_self, tab_self)
        tab_cross, _ = self.tab_cross(tab_self, img_self, img_self)

        # Residual connections
        img_fused = self.norm_img(img_feats + self.img_proj(img_cross.squeeze(1)))
        tab_fused = self.norm_tab(tab_feats + self.tab_proj(tab_cross.squeeze(1)))

        # Concatenate features
        combined = torch.cat([img_fused, tab_fused], dim=1)

        # Dynamic gating
        gate_weights = self.gate(combined)
        gated_combined = (
            gate_weights[:, 0:1] * img_fused + gate_weights[:, 1:2] * tab_fused
        )

        return self.norm_fusion(gated_combined)

class SEBlock(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, channels, reduction=16):
        super().__init__()
        self.avg_pool = nn.AdaptiveAvgPool1d(1)
        self.fc = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(channels, channels // reduction),
            nn.GELU(),
            nn.Linear(channels // reduction, channels),
            nn.Sigmoid(),
        )

    def forward(self, x):
        b, c = x.size()
        y = self.avg_pool(x.unsqueeze(2)).view(b, c)
        y = self.fc(y)
        return x * y


class LeafClassifier(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, num_classes):
        super().__init__()
        self.margin_net = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(64, 512),
            nn.BatchNorm1d(512),
            nn.GELU(),
            SEBlock(512),
            nn.Dropout(0.4),
        )
        self.shape_net = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(64, 512),
            nn.BatchNorm1d(512),
            nn.GELU(),
            SEBlock(512),
            nn.Dropout(0.4),
        )
        self.texture_net = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(64, 512),
            nn.BatchNorm1d(512),
            nn.GELU(),
            SEBlock(512),
            nn.Dropout(0.4),
        )
        self.image_net = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(2048, 512),  # Fixed input dimension
            nn.BatchNorm1d(512),
            nn.GELU(),
            SEBlock(512),
            nn.Dropout(0.4),
        )

        self.pos_embed = nn.Parameter(torch.randn(4, 512))
        self.transformer = nn.TransformerEncoder(
            nn.TransformerEncoderLayer(
                d_model=512, nhead=8, dim_feedforward=2048, dropout=0.1
            ),
            num_layers=3,
        )

        self.classifier = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(512 * 4, 2048),
            nn.BatchNorm1d(2048),
            nn.GELU(),
            nn.Dropout(0.5),
            nn.Linear(2048, 1024),
            nn.BatchNorm1d(1024),
            nn.GELU(),
            nn.Dropout(0.3),
            nn.Linear(1024, num_classes),
        )

    def forward(self, m, s, t, i):
        m = self.margin_net(m)
        s = self.shape_net(s)
        t = self.texture_net(t)
        i = self.image_net(i)

        features = torch.stack([m, s, t, i], dim=1) + self.pos_embed.unsqueeze(0)
        features = features.permute(1, 0, 2)
        transformed = self.transformer(features)
        transformed = (
            transformed.permute(1, 0, 2).contiguous().view(transformed.size(1), -1)
        )
        return self.classifier(transformed)

class LeafDataset(Dataset):
    def __init__(self, ids, tab_data, labels=None, mode="train"):
        self.ids = ids.reset_index(drop=True)
        self.tab_data = tab_data
        self.labels = labels
        self.mode = mode

        # Augmentations
        self.train_transform = transforms.Compose(
            [
                transforms.Resize(IMG_SIZE),
                transforms.RandomResizedCrop(IMG_SIZE - 40, scale=(0.7, 1.0)),
                transforms.RandomHorizontalFlip(),
                transforms.RandomVerticalFlip(),
                transforms.RandomRotation(45),
                transforms.RandomAffine(
                    degrees=0, translate=(0.15, 0.15), scale=(0.8, 1.2), shear=15
                ),
                transforms.ToTensor(),
                transforms.Normalize([0.485, 0.456, 0.406], [0.229, 0.224, 0.225]),
                transforms.RandomErasing(p=0.6, scale=(0.03, 0.12), ratio=(0.3, 3.3)),
            ]
        )

        self.test_transform = transforms.Compose(
            [
                transforms.Resize(IMG_SIZE),
                transforms.FiveCrop(IMG_SIZE - 40),
                transforms.Lambda(
                    lambda crops: torch.stack(
                        [
                            transforms.Compose(
                                [
                                    transforms.ToTensor(),
                                    transforms.Normalize(
                                        [0.485, 0.456, 0.406], [0.229, 0.224, 0.225]
                                    ),
                                ]
                            )(crop)
                            for crop in crops
                        ]
                    )
                ),
            ]
        )

    def __len__(self):
        return len(self.ids)

    def __getitem__(self, idx):
        img_path = f"input/images/{self.ids.iloc[idx]}.jpg"
        try:
            image = Image.open(img_path).convert("RGB")
        except:
            image = Image.new("RGB", (IMG_SIZE, IMG_SIZE))  # Fallback blank image

        if self.mode == "train":
            image = self.train_transform(image)
        else:
            image = self.test_transform(image)

        tabular = torch.FloatTensor(self.tab_data[idx])
        return (
            (image, tabular, self.labels[idx])
            if self.labels is not None
            else (image, tabular)
        )


# Model definition remains unchanged from original code
class HierarchicalFusion(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, img_dim, tab_dim, num_heads=8):
        super().__init__()
        self.img_self_attn = nn.MultiheadAttention(img_dim, num_heads, batch_first=True)
        self.tab_self_attn = nn.MultiheadAttention(tab_dim, num_heads, batch_first=True)
        self.img_cross = nn.MultiheadAttention(img_dim, num_heads, batch_first=True)
        self.tab_cross = nn.MultiheadAttention(tab_dim, num_heads, batch_first=True)
        self.gate = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(img_dim + tab_dim, (img_dim + tab_dim) // 2),
            nn.SiLU(),
            nn.Linear((img_dim + tab_dim) // 2, 2),
            nn.Softmax(dim=-1),
        )
        self.norm_img = nn.LayerNorm(img_dim)
        self.norm_tab = nn.LayerNorm(tab_dim)
        self.norm_fusion = nn.LayerNorm(img_dim + tab_dim)
        self.img_proj = nn.Linear(img_dim, img_dim)
        self.tab_proj = nn.Linear(tab_dim, tab_dim)

    def forward(self, img_feats, tab_feats):
        img_self, _ = self.img_self_attn(
            img_feats.unsqueeze(1), img_feats.unsqueeze(1), img_feats.unsqueeze(1)
        )
        tab_self, _ = self.tab_self_attn(
            tab_feats.unsqueeze(1), tab_feats.unsqueeze(1), tab_feats.unsqueeze(1)
        )
        img_cross, _ = self.img_cross(img_self, tab_self, tab_self)
        tab_cross, _ = self.tab_cross(tab_self, img_self, img_self)
        img_fused = self.norm_img(img_feats + self.img_proj(img_cross.squeeze(1)))
        tab_fused = self.norm_tab(tab_feats + self.tab_proj(tab_cross.squeeze(1)))
        combined = torch.cat([img_fused, tab_fused], dim=1)
        gate_weights = self.gate(combined)
        gated_combined = (
            gate_weights[:, 0:1] * img_fused + gate_weights[:, 1:2] * tab_fused
        )
        return self.norm_fusion(gated_combined)


class EnhancedLeafModel(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__()
        self.img_net = models.efficientnet_b4(pretrained=True)
        self.img_net.classifier = nn.Identity()

        )
        self.fusion = HierarchicalFusion(1792, 512)
        self.classifier = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(1792 + 512, 1024),
            nn.BatchNorm1d(1024),
            nn.SiLU(),
            nn.Dropout(0.4),
            nn.Linear(1024, NUM_CLASSES),
        )

    def forward(self, img, tab):
        img_feat = self.img_net(img)
        tab_feat = self.tab_net(tab)
        fused = self.fusion(img_feat, tab_feat)
        return self.classifier(fused)

class LeafDataset(Dataset):
    def __init__(self, ids, tab_data, labels=None, mode="train"):
        self.ids = ids.reset_index(drop=True)
        self.tab_data = tab_data  # Pre-sliced array
        self.labels = labels
        self.mode = mode

        self.train_transform = transforms.Compose(
            [
                transforms.Resize(IMG_SIZE),
                transforms.RandomHorizontalFlip(),
                transforms.RandomVerticalFlip(),
                transforms.RandomRotation(45),
                transforms.ToTensor(),
                transforms.Normalize([0.485, 0.456, 0.406], [0.229, 0.224, 0.225]),
            ]
        )

        self.test_transform = transforms.Compose(
            [
                transforms.Resize(IMG_SIZE),
                transforms.ToTensor(),
                transforms.Normalize([0.485, 0.456, 0.406], [0.229, 0.224, 0.225]),
            ]
        )

    def __len__(self):
        return len(self.ids)

    def __getitem__(self, idx):
        img_path = f"input/images/{self.ids.iloc[idx]}.jpg"
        try:
            image = Image.open(img_path).convert("RGB")
        except:
            image = Image.new("RGB", (IMG_SIZE, IMG_SIZE))

        image = (
            self.train_transform(image)
            if self.mode == "train"
            else self.test_transform(image)
        )
        tabular = torch.FloatTensor(self.tab_data[idx])
        return (

class LeafClassifier(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, input_size, num_classes):
        super().__init__()
        self.margin_branch = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(64, 256), nn.GELU(), nn.BatchNorm1d(256), nn.Dropout(0.4)
        )
        self.shape_branch = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(64, 256), nn.GELU(), nn.BatchNorm1d(256), nn.Dropout(0.4)
        )
        self.texture_branch = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(64, 256), nn.GELU(), nn.BatchNorm1d(256), nn.Dropout(0.4)
        )

        self.transformer = nn.TransformerEncoder(
            nn.TransformerEncoderLayer(
                d_model=256,
                nhead=8,
                dim_feedforward=1024,
                dropout=0.2,
                activation="gelu",
                batch_first=False,
            ),
            num_layers=3,
        )
        self.final_proj = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(768, 512),
            nn.GELU(),
            nn.BatchNorm1d(512),
            nn.Dropout(0.5),
            nn.Linear(512, num_classes),
        )

    def forward(self, x):
        margin = self.margin_branch(x[:, :64])
        shape = self.shape_branch(x[:, 64:128])
        texture = self.texture_branch(x[:, 128:])

        features = torch.stack([margin, shape, texture], dim=0)
        transformed = self.transformer(features)
        aggregated = transformed.permute(1, 0, 2).flatten(1)
        return self.final_proj(aggregated)

# Custom dataset with dynamic image loading
class LeafDataset(Dataset):
    def __init__(self, tab_data, ids, labels=None, is_train=True):
        self.tab_data = tab_data
        self.ids = ids
        self.labels = labels
        self.is_train = is_train

        self.train_transform = transforms.Compose(
            [
                transforms.Resize(IMG_SIZE),
                transforms.RandomHorizontalFlip(),
                transforms.RandomRotation(15),
                transforms.ColorJitter(brightness=0.2, contrast=0.2),
                transforms.CenterCrop(IMG_SIZE),
                transforms.ToTensor(),
                transforms.Normalize(
                    mean=[0.485, 0.456, 0.406], std=[0.229, 0.224, 0.225]
                ),
            ]
        )

        self.val_transform = transforms.Compose(
            [
                transforms.Resize(IMG_SIZE),
                transforms.CenterCrop(IMG_SIZE),
                transforms.ToTensor(),
                transforms.Normalize(
                    mean=[0.485, 0.456, 0.406], std=[0.229, 0.224, 0.225]
                ),
            ]
        )

    def __len__(self):
        return len(self.ids)

    def __getitem__(self, idx):
        img_id = self.ids[idx]
        img = Image.open(f"input/images/{img_id}.jpg").convert("RGB")

        transform = self.train_transform if self.is_train else self.val_transform
        img_tensor = transform(img)

        tab_tensor = torch.FloatTensor(self.tab_data[idx])

        if self.labels is not None:
            return (tab_tensor, img_tensor), torch.LongTensor([self.labels[idx]])
        return (tab_tensor, img_tensor)

# Enhanced model with dynamic image processing
class FusionModel(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__()
        # Initialize EfficientNet with partial unfreezing
        self.img_backbone = models.efficientnet_b5(pretrained=True)
        for param in self.img_backbone.parameters():
            param.requires_grad = False
        # Unfreeze last 3 blocks
        for block in self.img_backbone.features[-3:]:
            for param in block.parameters():
                param.requires_grad = True
        self.img_backbone.classifier = nn.Identity()

        # Tabular processing
        self.tab_branch = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(192, 512),
            nn.BatchNorm1d(512),
            nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Dropout(0.4),
            nn.Linear(512, 256),
        )

        # Feature fusion
        self.fusion = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(2048 + 256, 1024),
            nn.BatchNorm1d(1024),
            nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Dropout(0.5),
            nn.Linear(1024, 512),
            nn.BatchNorm1d(512),
            nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Dropout(0.4),
            nn.Linear(512, 99),
        )

    def forward(self, tab, img):
        img_feats = self.img_backbone(img)
        tab_feats = self.tab_branch(tab)
        combined = torch.cat([img_feats, tab_feats], dim=1)
        return self.fusion(combined)


model = FusionModel().to(device)

class LeafClassifier(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, input_size, num_classes):
        super().__init__()
        self.margin_branch = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(64, 256), nn.GELU(), nn.BatchNorm1d(256), nn.Dropout(0.4)
        )
        self.shape_branch = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(64, 256), nn.GELU(), nn.BatchNorm1d(256), nn.Dropout(0.4)
        )
        self.texture_branch = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(64, 256), nn.GELU(), nn.BatchNorm1d(256), nn.Dropout(0.4)
        )

        self.transformer = nn.TransformerEncoder(
            nn.TransformerEncoderLayer(
                d_model=256,
                nhead=8,
                dim_feedforward=1024,
                dropout=0.2,
                activation="gelu",
                batch_first=False,
            ),
            num_layers=3,
        )
        self.final_proj = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(768, 512),
            nn.GELU(),
            nn.BatchNorm1d(512),
            nn.Dropout(0.5),
            nn.Linear(512, num_classes),
        )

    def forward(self, x):
        margin = self.margin_branch(x[:, :64])
        shape = self.shape_branch(x[:, 64:128])
        texture = self.texture_branch(x[:, 128:])

        features = torch.stack([margin, shape, texture], dim=0)
        transformed = self.transformer(features)
        aggregated = transformed.permute(1, 0, 2).flatten(1)
        return self.final_proj(aggregated)


# Training setup
device = torch.device("cuda" if torch.cuda.is_available() else "cpu")

        index = torch.randperm(X_batch.size(0))
        mixed_X = lam * X_batch + (1 - lam) * X_batch[index]

        # Prepare one-hot labels
        y_a = y_batch
        y_b = y_batch[index]
        y_a_onehot = torch.zeros(y_a.size(0), len(le.classes_), device=device)
        y_a_onehot.scatter_(1, y_a.unsqueeze(1), 1.0)
        y_b_onehot = torch.zeros(y_b.size(0), len(le.classes_), device=device)
        y_b_onehot.scatter_(1, y_b.unsqueeze(1), 1.0)
        mixed_y = lam * y_a_onehot + (1 - lam) * y_b_onehot

        optimizer.zero_grad(set_to_none=True)
        outputs = model(mixed_X)
        log_probs = torch.log_softmax(outputs, dim=1)
        loss = train_criterion(log_probs, mixed_y)
        loss.backward()
        nn.utils.clip_grad_norm_(model.parameters(), 1.0)
        optimizer.step()
        train_loss += loss.item() * X_batch.size(0)

    scheduler.step()
    model.eval()
    val_loss = 0

    with torch.no_grad():

            val_loss += val_criterion(outputs, y_batch).item() * X_batch.size(0)
            val_probs.append(torch.softmax(outputs, 1).cpu())
            val_true.append(y_batch.cpu())

    # Calculate metrics
    train_loss /= len(train_loader.dataset)
    val_loss /= len(val_loader.dataset)
    val_probs = torch.cat(val_probs).numpy()
    val_true = torch.cat(val_true).numpy()
    current_logloss = log_loss(val_true, val_probs)

    print(
        f"Epoch {epoch+1:03d} | Train Loss: {train_loss:.4f} | Val LogLoss: {current_logloss:.4f}"
    )

    # Early stopping
    if current_logloss < best_loss:
        best_loss = current_logloss
        epochs_no_improve = 0
        torch.save(model.state_dict(), "./working/best_model.pt")
    else:
        epochs_no_improve += 1
        if epochs_no_improve >= patience:

        self.attention = nn.MultiheadAttention(embed_dim, num_heads, batch_first=True)
        self.norm = nn.LayerNorm(embed_dim)

    def forward(self, query, key, value):
        attn_out, _ = self.attention(query, key, value)
        return self.norm(query + attn_out)


class LeafClassifierV2(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, input_size, num_classes):
        super().__init__()
        # Feature projection branches
        self.margin_proj = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(64, 256), nn.SiLU(), nn.BatchNorm1d(256), nn.Dropout(0.3)
        )
        self.shape_proj = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(64, 256), nn.SiLU(), nn.BatchNorm1d(256), nn.Dropout(0.3)
        )
        self.texture_proj = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(64, 256), nn.SiLU(), nn.BatchNorm1d(256), nn.Dropout(0.3)
        )

        # Cross-feature attention modules
        self.margin_attn = CrossFeatureAttention(256, 8)
        self.shape_attn = CrossFeatureAttention(256, 8)
        self.texture_attn = CrossFeatureAttention(256, 8)

        # Final classifier
        self.classifier = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(768, 1024),
            nn.SiLU(),
            nn.BatchNorm1d(1024),
            nn.Dropout(0.5),
            nn.Linear(1024, 512),
            nn.SiLU(),
            nn.BatchNorm1d(512),
            nn.Dropout(0.4),
            nn.Linear(512, num_classes),
        )

    def forward(self, x):
        margin = self.margin_proj(x[:, :64])
        shape = self.shape_proj(x[:, 64:128])
        texture = self.texture_proj(x[:, 128:])

        # Cross attention between features
        margin = self.margin_attn(
            margin.unsqueeze(1), shape.unsqueeze(1), texture.unsqueeze(1)
        ).squeeze(1)
        shape = self.shape_attn(
            shape.unsqueeze(1), texture.unsqueeze(1), margin.unsqueeze(1)
        ).squeeze(1)
        texture = self.texture_attn(
            texture.unsqueeze(1), margin.unsqueeze(1), shape.unsqueeze(1)
        ).squeeze(1)

        combined = torch.cat([margin, shape, texture], dim=1)
        return self.classifier(combined)


# Training setup
device = torch.device("cuda" if torch.cuda.is_available() else "cpu")
model = LeafClassifierV2(X.shape[1], len(le.classes_)).to(device)
optimizer = optim.AdamW(model.parameters(), lr=2e-4, weight_decay=0.1)

for epoch in range(200):

        lam = np.random.beta(0.4, 0.4)
        idx = torch.randperm(X_batch.size(0))
        mixed_x = lam * X_batch + (1 - lam) * X_batch[idx]
        y_a, y_b = y_batch, y_batch[idx]

        optimizer.zero_grad()
        outputs = model(mixed_x)
        loss = lam * criterion(outputs, y_a) + (1 - lam) * criterion(outputs, y_b)
        loss.backward()
        nn.utils.clip_grad_norm_(model.parameters(), 1.0)
        optimizer.step()
        scheduler.step()

        train_loss += loss.item() * X_batch.size(0)

            nn.Linear(64, 512), nn.GELU(), nn.LayerNorm(512), nn.Dropout(0.2)

            nn.TransformerEncoderLayer(

                dropout=0.1,
                activation="gelu",

        mean_pool = features.mean(dim=1)
        max_pool = features.amax(dim=1)
        combined = torch.cat([mean_pool, max_pool, features[:, 0]], dim=1)

        return self.classifier(combined)

class SEBlock(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, channels, reduction=16):
        super().__init__()
        self.avg_pool = nn.AdaptiveAvgPool1d(1)
        self.fc = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(channels, channels // reduction),
            nn.GELU(),
            nn.Linear(channels // reduction, channels),
            nn.Sigmoid(),
        )

    def forward(self, x):
        b, c = x.size()
        y = self.avg_pool(x.unsqueeze(2)).view(b, c)
        y = self.fc(y)
        return x * y


class LeafClassifier(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, num_classes):
        super().__init__()
        self.margin_net = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(64, 512),
            nn.BatchNorm1d(512),
            nn.GELU(),
            SEBlock(512),
            nn.Dropout(0.4),
        )
        self.shape_net = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(64, 512),
            nn.BatchNorm1d(512),
            nn.GELU(),
            SEBlock(512),
            nn.Dropout(0.4),
        )
        self.texture_net = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(64, 512),
            nn.BatchNorm1d(512),
            nn.GELU(),
            SEBlock(512),
            nn.Dropout(0.4),
        )
        self.image_net = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(2048, 512),
            nn.BatchNorm1d(512),
            nn.GELU(),
            SEBlock(512),
            nn.Dropout(0.4),
        )

        self.pos_embed = nn.Parameter(torch.randn(4, 512))
        self.transformer = nn.TransformerEncoder(
            nn.TransformerEncoderLayer(
                d_model=512, nhead=8, dim_feedforward=2048, dropout=0.1
            ),
            num_layers=3,
        )

        self.classifier = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(512 * 4, 2048),
            nn.BatchNorm1d(2048),
            nn.GELU(),
            nn.Dropout(0.5),
            nn.Linear(2048, 1024),
            nn.BatchNorm1d(1024),
            nn.GELU(),
            nn.Dropout(0.3),
            nn.Linear(1024, num_classes),
        )

    def forward(self, m, s, t, i):
        m = self.margin_net(m)
        s = self.shape_net(s)
        t = self.texture_net(t)
        i = self.image_net(i)

        features = torch.stack([m, s, t, i], dim=1) + self.pos_embed.unsqueeze(0)
        features = features.permute(1, 0, 2)
        transformed = self.transformer(features)
        transformed = (
            transformed.permute(1, 0, 2).contiguous().view(transformed.size(1), -1)
        )
        return self.classifier(transformed)


def extract_features(df):
    return [
        df.filter(regex="margin").values,
        df.filter(regex="shape").values,
        df.filter(regex="texture").values,
    ]


resnet = models.resnet50(pretrained=True)
resnet = nn.Sequential(*list(resnet.children())[:-1]).eval().cuda()
preprocess = transforms.Compose(
    [
        transforms.Resize(256),
        transforms.CenterCrop(224),
        transforms.ToTensor(),
        transforms.Normalize([0.485, 0.456, 0.406], [0.229, 0.224, 0.225]),
    ]
)


def get_image_features(ids):
    features = []
    for id in ids:
        img = Image.open(f"./input/images/{id}.jpg").convert("RGB")
        img_t = preprocess(img).unsqueeze(0).cuda()
        with torch.no_grad():
            features.append(resnet(img_t).flatten().cpu().numpy())
    return np.array(features)


# Data processing with per-feature scaling
train_df = pd.read_csv("./input/train.csv")
test_df = pd.read_csv("./input/test.csv")

# Extract features
m_train, s_train, t_train = extract_features(train_df)
m_test, s_test, t_test = extract_features(test_df)
i_train = get_image_features(train_df.id)
i_test = get_image_features(test_df.id)

# Scale each feature group independently
m_scaler = StandardScaler().fit(m_train)
s_scaler = StandardScaler().fit(s_train)
t_scaler = StandardScaler().fit(t_train)
i_scaler = StandardScaler().fit(i_train)

m_train = m_scaler.transform(m_train)
s_train = s_scaler.transform(s_train)
t_train = t_scaler.transform(t_train)
i_train = i_scaler.transform(i_train)

m_test = m_scaler.transform(m_test)
s_test = s_scaler.transform(s_test)
t_test = t_scaler.transform(t_test)
i_test = i_scaler.transform(i_test)

X = np.hstack([m_train, s_train, t_train, i_train])
test_X = np.hstack([m_test, s_test, t_test, i_test])

le = LabelEncoder()
y = le.fit_transform(train_df.species)
X_train, X_val, y_train, y_val = train_test_split(X, y, test_size=0.2, stratify=y)

# Training setup
model = LeafClassifier(len(le.classes_)).cuda()
opt = optim.AdamW(model.parameters(), lr=2e-4, weight_decay=0.1)
scheduler = optim.lr_scheduler.CosineAnnealingWarmRestarts(opt, T_0=15, T_mult=2)
criterion = nn.CrossEntropyLoss(label_smoothing=0.15)

train_loader = DataLoader(
    TensorDataset(torch.FloatTensor(X_train), torch.LongTensor(y_train)),
    batch_size=32,
    shuffle=True,
    num_workers=4,
)
val_loader = DataLoader(
    TensorDataset(torch.FloatTensor(X_val), torch.LongTensor(y_val)), batch_size=256
)

best_logloss = float("inf")
for epoch in range(100):
    model.train()
    for x, y in train_loader:
        x, y = x.cuda(), y.cuda()
        m = x[:, :64]
        s = x[:, 64:128]
        t = x[:, 128:192]
        i = x[:, 192:]
        opt.zero_grad()
        loss = criterion(model(m, s, t, i), y)
        loss.backward()
        nn.utils.clip_grad_norm_(model.parameters(), 1.0)
        opt.step()

    model.eval()
    val_probs, val_true = [], []
    with torch.no_grad():
        for x, y in val_loader:
            x, y = x.cuda(), y.cpu()
            m = x[:, :64]
            s = x[:, 64:128]
            t = x[:, 128:192]
            i = x[:, 192:]
            val_probs.append(torch.softmax(model(m, s, t, i).cpu(), 1))
            val_true.append(y)

    logloss = log_loss(torch.cat(val_true), torch.cat(val_probs))
    scheduler.step()

    if logloss < best_logloss:
        best_logloss = logloss
        torch.save(model.state_dict(), "./working/best.pt")

# Generate predictions

        s = x[:, 64:128]
        t = x[:, 128:192]

                transforms.ToTensor(),
                transforms.Normalize(
                    mean=[0.485, 0.456, 0.406], std=[0.229, 0.224, 0.225]
                ),
            ]
        )

    def __getitem__(self, idx):
        img_id = self.ids[idx]
        img = Image.open(f"input/images/{img_id}.jpg").convert("RGB")
        transform = self.train_transform if self.is_train else self.val_transform
        return (
            (torch.FloatTensor(self.tab_data[idx]), transform(img)),

class FusionModel(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self):

            nn.Linear(192, 512),
            nn.BatchNorm1d(512),
            nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Dropout(0.4),
            nn.Linear(512, 256),
        )

            nn.Linear(2048 + 256, 1024),
            nn.BatchNorm1d(1024),
            nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Dropout(0.5),
            nn.Linear(1024, 512),
            nn.BatchNorm1d(512),
            nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Dropout(0.4),
            nn.Linear(512, 99),
        )

    def forward(self, tab, img):
        img_feats = self.img_backbone(img)
        tab_feats = self.tab_branch(tab)
        return self.fusion(torch.cat([img_feats, tab_feats], dim=1))

class SEBlock(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, channels, reduction=16):
        super().__init__()
        self.avg_pool = nn.AdaptiveAvgPool1d(1)
        self.fc = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(channels, channels // reduction),
            nn.GELU(),
            nn.Linear(channels // reduction, channels),
            nn.Sigmoid(),
        )

    def forward(self, x):
        b, c = x.size()
        y = self.avg_pool(x.unsqueeze(2)).view(b, c)
        y = self.fc(y)
        return x * y


class LeafClassifier(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, num_classes):
        super().__init__()
        self.margin_net = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(64, 512),
            nn.BatchNorm1d(512),
            nn.GELU(),
            SEBlock(512),
            nn.Dropout(0.4),
        )
        self.shape_net = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(64, 512),
            nn.BatchNorm1d(512),
            nn.GELU(),
            SEBlock(512),
            nn.Dropout(0.4),
        )
        self.texture_net = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(64, 512),
            nn.BatchNorm1d(512),
            nn.GELU(),
            SEBlock(512),
            nn.Dropout(0.4),
        )
        self.image_net = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(2048, 512),
            nn.BatchNorm1d(512),
            nn.GELU(),
            SEBlock(512),
            nn.Dropout(0.4),
        )

        self.pos_embed = nn.Parameter(torch.randn(4, 512))
        self.transformer = nn.TransformerEncoder(
            nn.TransformerEncoderLayer(
                d_model=512, nhead=8, dim_feedforward=2048, dropout=0.1
            ),
            num_layers=3,
        )

        self.classifier = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(512 * 4, 2048),
            nn.BatchNorm1d(2048),
            nn.GELU(),
            nn.Dropout(0.5),
            nn.Linear(2048, 1024),
            nn.BatchNorm1d(1024),
            nn.GELU(),
            nn.Dropout(0.3),
            nn.Linear(1024, num_classes),
        )

    def forward(self, m, s, t, i):
        m = self.margin_net(m)
        s = self.shape_net(s)
        t = self.texture_net(t)
        i = self.image_net(i)

        features = torch.stack([m, s, t, i], dim=1) + self.pos_embed.unsqueeze(0)
        features = features.permute(1, 0, 2)
        transformed = self.transformer(features)
        transformed = (
            transformed.permute(1, 0, 2).contiguous().view(transformed.size(1), -1)
        )
        return self.classifier(transformed)

        self.is_train = is_train

        self.train_transform = transforms.Compose(
            [
                transforms.Resize(IMG_SIZE),
                transforms.RandomHorizontalFlip(),
                transforms.RandomRotation(15),
                transforms.ColorJitter(brightness=0.2, contrast=0.2),

                transforms.ToTensor(),
                transforms.Normalize(
                    mean=[0.485, 0.456, 0.406], std=[0.229, 0.224, 0.225]
                ),
            ]
        )

        self.val_transform = transforms.Compose(
            [
                transforms.Resize(IMG_SIZE),
                transforms.CenterCrop(IMG_SIZE),
                transforms.ToTensor(),
                transforms.Normalize(
                    mean=[0.485, 0.456, 0.406], std=[0.229, 0.224, 0.225]
                ),
            ]
        )

    def __getitem__(self, idx):
        img_id = self.ids[idx]
        img = Image.open(f"input/images/{img_id}.jpg").convert("RGB")
        transform = self.train_transform if self.is_train else self.val_transform
        img_tensor = transform(img)
        tab_tensor = torch.FloatTensor(self.tab_data[idx])

        if self.labels is not None:
            label_tensor = torch.LongTensor([self.labels[idx]])
            return (tab_tensor, img_tensor), label_tensor
        else:
            return (tab_tensor, img_tensor)

    def __len__(self):
        return len(self.ids)

val_dataset = LeafDataset(train_tab[val_indices], val_ids, y[val_indices], False)

class FusionModel(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__()
        self.img_backbone = models.efficientnet_b5(pretrained=True)
        for param in self.img_backbone.parameters():
            param.requires_grad = False
        for block in self.img_backbone.features[-3:]:
            for param in block.parameters():
                param.requires_grad = True
        self.img_backbone.classifier = nn.Identity()

        self.tab_branch = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(192, 512),
            nn.BatchNorm1d(512),
            nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Dropout(0.4),
            nn.Linear(512, 256),
        )

        self.fusion = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(2048 + 256, 1024),
            nn.BatchNorm1d(1024),
            nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Dropout(0.5),
            nn.Linear(1024, 512),
            nn.BatchNorm1d(512),
            nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Dropout(0.4),
            nn.Linear(512, 99),
        )

    def forward(self, tab, img):
        img_feats = self.img_backbone(img)
        tab_feats = self.tab_branch(tab)
        return self.fusion(torch.cat([img_feats, tab_feats], dim=1))


model = FusionModel().to(device)
optimizer = optim.AdamW(
    [
        {"params": model.img_backbone.parameters(), "lr": 1e-4},
        {"params": model.tab_branch.parameters()},

    ],
    lr=1e-3,

)

    with torch.no_grad():
        for (tab, img), labels in val_loader:

                labels
            )
            val_probs.append(torch.softmax(outputs, dim=1).cpu())

    val_loss /= len(val_dataset)
    val_probs = torch.cat(val_probs).numpy()
    val_true = torch.cat(val_true).numpy()
    current_logloss = log_loss(val_true, val_probs)
    scheduler.step()

    if current_logloss < best_loss:
        best_loss = current_logloss
        torch.save(model.state_dict(), "best_model.pth")
        print(f"Epoch {epoch+1}: New best logloss {current_logloss:.4f}")
    else:
        print(f"Epoch {epoch+1}: Current logloss {current_logloss:.4f}")

# Generate final predictions

model.eval()
test_probs = []
with torch.no_grad():

class SEBlock(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, channels, reduction=16):
        super().__init__()
        self.avg_pool = nn.AdaptiveAvgPool1d(1)
        self.fc = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(channels, channels // reduction),
            nn.GELU(),
            nn.Linear(channels // reduction, channels),
            nn.Sigmoid(),
        )

    def forward(self, x):
        b, c = x.size()
        y = self.avg_pool(x.unsqueeze(2)).view(b, c)
        y = self.fc(y)
        return x * y


class LeafClassifier(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, num_classes):
        super().__init__()
        self.margin_net = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(64, 512),
            nn.BatchNorm1d(512),
            nn.GELU(),
            SEBlock(512),
            nn.Dropout(0.4),
        )
        self.shape_net = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(64, 512),
            nn.BatchNorm1d(512),
            nn.GELU(),
            SEBlock(512),
            nn.Dropout(0.4),
        )
        self.texture_net = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(64, 512),
            nn.BatchNorm1d(512),
            nn.GELU(),
            SEBlock(512),
            nn.Dropout(0.4),
        )
        self.image_net = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(2048, 512),
            nn.BatchNorm1d(512),
            nn.GELU(),
            SEBlock(512),
            nn.Dropout(0.4),
        )

        self.pos_embed = nn.Parameter(torch.randn(4, 512))
        self.transformer = nn.TransformerEncoder(
            nn.TransformerEncoderLayer(
                d_model=512, nhead=8, dim_feedforward=2048, dropout=0.1
            ),
            num_layers=3,
        )

        self.classifier = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(512 * 4, 2048),
            nn.BatchNorm1d(2048),
            nn.GELU(),
            nn.Dropout(0.5),
            nn.Linear(2048, 1024),
            nn.BatchNorm1d(1024),
            nn.GELU(),
            nn.Dropout(0.3),
            nn.Linear(1024, num_classes),
        )

    def forward(self, m, s, t, i):
        m = self.margin_net(m)
        s = self.shape_net(s)
        t = self.texture_net(t)
        i = self.image_net(i)

        features = torch.stack([m, s, t, i], dim=1) + self.pos_embed.unsqueeze(0)
        features = features.permute(1, 0, 2)
        transformed = self.transformer(features)
        transformed = (
            transformed.permute(1, 0, 2).contiguous().view(transformed.size(1), -1)
        )
        return self.classifier(transformed)

        img_features = self.image_fc(self.cnn(img))

        return self.classifier(torch.cat([img_features, tab_features], 1))

            features.append(feat)

class SEBlock(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, channels, reduction=16):
        super().__init__()
        self.avg_pool = nn.AdaptiveAvgPool1d(1)
        self.fc = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(channels, channels // reduction),
            nn.GELU(),
            nn.Linear(channels // reduction, channels),
            nn.Sigmoid(),
        )

    def forward(self, x):
        b, c = x.size()
        y = self.avg_pool(x.unsqueeze(2)).view(b, c)
        y = self.fc(y)
        return x * y


class LeafClassifier(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, num_classes):
        super().__init__()
        self.margin_net = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(64, 512),
            nn.BatchNorm1d(512),
            nn.GELU(),
            SEBlock(512),
            nn.Dropout(0.4),
        )
        self.shape_net = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(64, 512),
            nn.BatchNorm1d(512),
            nn.GELU(),
            SEBlock(512),
            nn.Dropout(0.4),
        )
        self.texture_net = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(64, 512),
            nn.BatchNorm1d(512),
            nn.GELU(),
            SEBlock(512),
            nn.Dropout(0.4),
        )
        self.image_net = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(2560, 512),  # Updated input dim for EfficientNet
            nn.BatchNorm1d(512),
            nn.GELU(),
            SEBlock(512),
            nn.Dropout(0.4),
        )

        self.pos_embed = nn.Parameter(torch.randn(4, 512))
        self.transformer = nn.TransformerEncoder(
            nn.TransformerEncoderLayer(
                d_model=512, nhead=8, dim_feedforward=2048, dropout=0.1
            ),
            num_layers=3,
        )

        self.classifier = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(512 * 4, 2048),
            nn.BatchNorm1d(2048),
            nn.GELU(),
            nn.Dropout(0.5),
            nn.Linear(2048, 1024),
            nn.BatchNorm1d(1024),
            nn.GELU(),
            nn.Dropout(0.3),
            nn.Linear(1024, num_classes),
        )

    def forward(self, m, s, t, i):
        m = self.margin_net(m)
        s = self.shape_net(s)
        t = self.texture_net(t)
        i = self.image_net(i)

        features = torch.stack([m, s, t, i], dim=1) + self.pos_embed.unsqueeze(0)
        features = features.permute(1, 0, 2)
        transformed = self.transformer(features)
        transformed = (
            transformed.permute(1, 0, 2).contiguous().view(transformed.size(1), -1)
        )
        return self.classifier(transformed)

    model.eval()

            nn.Linear(64, 256), nn.BatchNorm1d(256), nn.GELU(), nn.Dropout(0.4)
        )
        self.classifier = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(256 * 6, 512),
            nn.BatchNorm1d(512),
            nn.GELU(),
            nn.Dropout(0.5),
            nn.Linear(512, num_classes),
        )

    def forward(self, x):
        margin = self.margin_branch(x[:, :64])
        shape = self.shape_branch(x[:, 64:128])
        texture = self.texture_branch(x[:, 128:192])

        # Compute all pairwise interactions
        margin_shape = margin * shape
        margin_texture = margin * texture
        shape_texture = shape * texture

        combined = torch.cat(
            [margin, shape, texture, margin_shape, margin_texture, shape_texture], dim=1
        )

        return self.classifier(combined)

        self.transform = transform

        self.has_labels = "species" in df.columns

        if self.has_labels:

    def __len__(self):

    def __getitem__(self, idx):
        img_id = self.df.iloc[idx]["id"]
        try:
            img = Image.open(f"{self.img_dir}/{img_id}.jpg").convert("RGB")
        except FileNotFoundError:
            img = Image.new("RGB", (380, 380), (255, 255, 255))

        if self.transform:
            img = self.transform(img)

        return (img, self.labels[idx]) if self.has_labels else img

)

)

    for inputs, labels in train_loader:

        optimizer.zero_grad(set_to_none=True)
        outputs = model(inputs)
        loss = criterion(outputs, labels)
        loss.backward()
        optimizer.step()
        train_loss += loss.item() * inputs.size(0)

    model.eval()
    val_loss = 0.0
    with torch.no_grad():
        for inputs, labels in val_loader:

    train_loss /= len(train_loader.dataset)

        self.tab_fc = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(192, 256), nn.ReLU(), nn.Dropout(0.3), nn.Linear(256, 64)
        )

        )

        image = Image.open(f"{self.images_dir}/{img_id}.jpg").convert("L")
        image = image_transform(image)
        features = torch.FloatTensor(self.features[idx])

        if self.labels is not None:

        )

            nn.Flatten(),
            nn.Linear(128, 256),
            nn.GELU(),

        )
        self.classifier = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(512 + 256, 512),
            nn.BatchNorm1d(512),
            nn.GELU(),
            nn.Dropout(0.5),
            nn.Linear(512, num_classes),
        )

    def forward(self, x_tab, x_img):

        return self.classifier(torch.cat([tab, img], dim=1))

        loss.backward()
        torch.nn.utils.clip_grad_norm_(model.parameters(), 1.0)
        optimizer.step()
        train_loss += loss.item()

    # Validation
    model.eval()
    val_loss, probs, true = 0, [], []
    with torch.no_grad():
        for features, images, labels in val_loader:

                features.to(device),
                images.to(device),
                labels.to(device),
            )
            outputs = model(features, images)
            val_loss += criterion(outputs, labels).item()
            probs.append(torch.softmax(outputs, 1).cpu())
            true.append(labels.cpu())

    val_loss /= len(val_loader)
    val_logloss = log_loss(torch.cat(true), torch.cat(probs))
    scheduler.step(val_logloss)

    print(
        f"Epoch {epoch+1:03d} | Train Loss: {train_loss/len(train_loader):.4f} | Val LogLoss: {val_logloss:.4f}"
    )

    # Early stopping
    if val_logloss < best_loss:
        best_loss = val_logloss
        epochs_no_improve = 0
        torch.save(model.state_dict(), "./working/best_model.pt")
    else:
        epochs_no_improve += 1
        if epochs_no_improve >= patience:
            print(f"Early stopping at epoch {epoch+1}")
            break

model.eval()

        )

            nn.Linear(64, 128), nn.BatchNorm1d(128), nn.GELU(), nn.Dropout(0.3)

        attended = self.transformer(modalities).permute(1, 0, 2)
        combined = attended.reshape(attended.size(0), -1)

        return self.classifier(combined)

            val_loss += criterion(outputs, y_batch).item()
            val_probs.append(torch.softmax(outputs, 1).cpu())
            val_true.append(y_batch.cpu())

    val_probs = torch.cat(val_probs).numpy()
    val_true = torch.cat(val_true).numpy()
    current_logloss = log_loss(val_true, val_probs)

            normalize = transforms.Normalize(

                transforms.Resize((128, 128)),

                transforms.ToTensor(),

            ]

        )

# Enhanced model architecture
class MultimodalLeafClassifier(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, num_classes):
        super().__init__()
        # Feature branches
        self.margin_net = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(64, 128), nn.BatchNorm1d(128), nn.GELU()
        )
        self.shape_net = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(64, 128), nn.BatchNorm1d(128), nn.GELU()
        )
        self.texture_net = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(64, 128), nn.BatchNorm1d(128), nn.GELU()
        )

        # Image CNN
        self.image_net = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Conv2d(1, 32, 3, padding=1),
            nn.GELU(),
            nn.MaxPool2d(2),
            nn.Conv2d(32, 64, 3, padding=1),
            nn.GELU(),
            nn.MaxPool2d(2),
            nn.Conv2d(64, 128, 3, padding=1),
            nn.GELU(),
            nn.AdaptiveAvgPool2d(1),
            nn.Flatten(),
            nn.Linear(128, 128),
        )

        # Transformer integration
        self.transformer = nn.TransformerEncoder(
            nn.TransformerEncoderLayer(128, 8, 512, dropout=0.1), num_layers=3
        )

        # Classifier
        self.classifier = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(512, 512), nn.GELU(), nn.Dropout(0.5), nn.Linear(512, num_classes)
        )

    def forward(self, features, image):
        margin = self.margin_net(features[:, :64])
        shape = self.shape_net(features[:, 64:128])
        texture = self.texture_net(features[:, 128:192])
        img_feat = self.image_net(image)

        # Combine features with transformer
        combined = torch.stack([margin, shape, texture, img_feat], dim=1)
        transformed = self.transformer(combined.permute(1, 0, 2))
        return self.classifier(transformed.permute(1, 0, 2).flatten(1))


# Training setup

    val_logloss = log_loss(torch.cat(val_true).numpy(), torch.cat(val_preds).numpy())
    scheduler.step(val_logloss)
    print(f"Epoch {epoch+1}: Val LogLoss {val_logloss:.4f}")

    # Save best model
    if val_logloss < best_logloss:
        best_logloss = val_logloss
        torch.save(model.state_dict(), "./working/best_model.pt")

# Generate final predictions
model.load_state_dict(torch.load("./working/best_model.pt"))
model.eval()
test_preds = []
with torch.no_grad():

test_df[tabular_cols] = scaler.transform(test_df[tabular_cols])

le = LabelEncoder().fit(sample_sub.columns[1:])

        transforms.ColorJitter(0.1, 0.1, 0.1),
        transforms.ToTensor(),
        transforms.Normalize([0.485, 0.456, 0.406], [0.229, 0.224, 0.225]),
    ]
)


class LeafDataset(Dataset):
    def __init__(self, df, img_dir, transform=None, is_test=False):
        self.df = df
        self.img_dir = img_dir
        self.transform = transform
        self.is_test = is_test

    def __len__(self):
        return len(self.df)

    def __getitem__(self, idx):
        img_id = self.df["id"].iloc[idx]
        img_path = os.path.join(self.img_dir, f"{img_id}.jpg")
        image = Image.open(img_path).convert("RGB")
        tabular = self.df[tabular_cols].iloc[idx].values.astype(np.float32)

        if self.is_test:
            resize = transforms.Resize(256)
            five_crop = transforms.FiveCrop(224)
            image = resize(image)
            crops = five_crop(image)
            augmented_images = []
            for crop in crops:
                augmented_images.append(crop)
                augmented_images.append(transforms.functional.hflip(crop))
            to_tensor = transforms.ToTensor()
            normalize = transforms.Normalize(
                [0.485, 0.456, 0.406], [0.229, 0.224, 0.225]
            )
            return [normalize(to_tensor(img)) for img in augmented_images], tabular
        else:
            if self.transform:
                image = self.transform(image)
            return (image, tabular, self.df["species"].iloc[idx])


train_dataset = LeafDataset(X_train, "input/images/", train_transform)
