margin = [f"margin{i}" for i in range(1, 65)]
shape = [f"shape{i}" for i in range(1, 65)]
texture = [f"texture{i}" for i in range(1, 65)]


def process_features(df):
    scaler = StandardScaler()
    return np.hstack(
        [
            scaler.fit_transform(df[margin]),
            scaler.fit_transform(df[shape]),
            scaler.fit_transform(df[texture]),
        ]
    )


X = process_features(train)
y = LabelEncoder().fit_transform(train["species"])
X_test = process_features(test)


class LeafClassifier(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__()
        self.branch1 = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(64, 128), nn.BatchNorm1d(128), nn.ReLU(), nn.Dropout(0.3)
        )
        self.branch2 = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(64, 128), nn.BatchNorm1d(128), nn.ReLU(), nn.Dropout(0.3)
        )
        self.branch3 = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(64, 128), nn.BatchNorm1d(128), nn.ReLU(), nn.Dropout(0.3)
        )
        self.combined = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(384, 256),
            nn.BatchNorm1d(256),
            nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Dropout(0.5),
            nn.Linear(256, 99),
        )

    def forward(self, x):
        x1 = self.branch1(x[:, :64])
        x2 = self.branch2(x[:, 64:128])
        x3 = self.branch3(x[:, 128:192])
        return self.combined(torch.cat([x1, x2, x3], dim=1))

        model.train()
        for inputs, targets in train_loader:

            optimizer.zero_grad()
            outputs = model(inputs)

            loss.backward()

        model.eval()
        with torch.no_grad():

            val_outputs = model(val_inputs)

        encoder_layer = nn.TransformerEncoderLayer(
            d_model=feat_dim,
            nhead=8,
            dim_feedforward=512,
            dropout=0.2,
            batch_first=True,
        )
        self.transformer = nn.TransformerEncoder(encoder_layer, num_layers=4)
        self.norm = nn.LayerNorm(feat_dim * 4)

    def forward(self, margin, shape, texture, img_proj):
        features = torch.stack([margin, shape, texture, img_proj], dim=1)
        fused = self.transformer(features)
        return self.norm(fused.view(fused.size(0), -1))

        super().__init__()
        self.margin = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(64, 256),

        s = self.shape(tabular[:, 64:128])
        t = self.texture(tabular[:, 128:192])
        img_features = self.image(image)
        img_proj = self.img_proj(img_features)

        fused = self.fusion(m, s, t, img_proj)
        combined = torch.cat([fused, img_features], dim=1)

import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
from sklearn.model_selection import StratifiedKFold
from sklearn.preprocessing import LabelEncoder, StandardScaler
from sklearn.metrics import log_loss
import torch
import torch.nn as nn
import torch.optim as optim
from torch.utils.data import DataLoader, TensorDataset

# Load and preprocess data
train = pd.read_csv("input/train.csv")
test = pd.read_csv("input/test.csv")

margin = [f"margin{i}" for i in range(1, 65)]
shape = [f"shape{i}" for i in range(1, 65)]
texture = [f"texture{i}" for i in range(1, 65)]


def process_features(df):
    scaler = StandardScaler()
    return np.hstack(
        [
            scaler.fit_transform(df[margin]),
            scaler.fit_transform(df[shape]),
            scaler.fit_transform(df[texture]),
        ]
    )


X = process_features(train)
y = LabelEncoder().fit_transform(train["species"])
X_test = process_features(test)


class EnhancedLeafClassifier(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__()
        self.branch1 = self._create_branch()
        self.branch2 = self._create_branch()
        self.branch3 = self._create_branch()

        self.combined = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(384, 512),
            nn.BatchNorm1d(512),
            nn.GELU(),
            nn.Dropout(0.6),
            nn.Linear(512, 256),
            nn.LayerNorm(256),
            nn.GELU(),
            nn.Dropout(0.5),
            nn.Linear(256, 99),
        )

    def _create_branch(self):
        return nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(64, 256),
            nn.BatchNorm1d(256),
            nn.GELU(),
            nn.Dropout(0.4),
            nn.Linear(256, 128),
            nn.BatchNorm1d(128),
            nn.GELU(),
            nn.Dropout(0.3),
        )

    def forward(self, x):
        x1 = self.branch1(x[:, :64])
        x2 = self.branch2(x[:, 64:128])
        x3 = self.branch3(x[:, 128:192])
        return self.combined(torch.cat([x1, x2, x3], dim=1))


device = torch.device("cuda" if torch.cuda.is_available() else "cpu")
epochs = 250
batch_size = 32
n_splits = 5

skf = StratifiedKFold(n_splits=n_splits, shuffle=True, random_state=42)
test_probs = []
val_scores = []

for fold, (train_idx, val_idx) in enumerate(skf.split(X, y)):
    X_train, X_val = X[train_idx], X[val_idx]
    y_train, y_val = y[train_idx], y[val_idx]

    train_ds = TensorDataset(torch.FloatTensor(X_train), torch.LongTensor(y_train))
    train_loader = DataLoader(
        train_ds,
        batch_size=batch_size,
        shuffle=True,
        num_workers=4,
        pin_memory=True,
        persistent_workers=True,
    )

    model = EnhancedLeafClassifier().to(device)
    optimizer = optim.AdamW(model.parameters(), lr=1e-3, weight_decay=1e-4)
    scheduler = optim.lr_scheduler.ReduceLROnPlateau(optimizer, patience=5, factor=0.2)
    criterion = nn.CrossEntropyLoss(label_smoothing=0.1)

    best_loss = np.inf
    patience = 0

    for epoch in range(epochs):
        model.train()
        for inputs, targets in train_loader:
            inputs, targets = inputs.to(device), targets.to(device)
            optimizer.zero_grad(set_to_none=True)
            outputs = model(inputs)
            loss = criterion(outputs, targets)
            loss.backward()
            nn.utils.clip_grad_norm_(model.parameters(), 1.0)
            optimizer.step()

        model.eval()
        with torch.no_grad():
            val_inputs = torch.FloatTensor(X_val).to(device)
            val_outputs = model(val_inputs)
            val_loss = criterion(val_outputs, torch.LongTensor(y_val).to(device)).item()

        scheduler.step(val_loss)
        if val_loss < best_loss:
            best_loss = val_loss
            patience = 0
            torch.save(model.state_dict(), f"working/best_fold{fold}.pt")
        else:
            patience += 1
            if patience >= 12:
                break

    model.load_state_dict(torch.load(f"working/best_fold{fold}.pt"))
    model.eval()

    with torch.no_grad():
        val_preds = (
            torch.softmax(model(torch.FloatTensor(X_val).to(device)), dim=1)
            .cpu()
            .numpy()
        )
        val_score = log_loss(y_val, val_preds)
        val_scores.append(val_score)
        print(f"Fold {fold} Val Log Loss: {val_score:.4f}")

        test_outputs = (
            torch.softmax(model(torch.FloatTensor(X_test).to(device)), dim=1)
            .cpu()
            .numpy()
        )
        test_probs.append(test_outputs)

final_probs = np.mean(test_probs, axis=0)
submission = pd.DataFrame(
    final_probs, columns=LabelEncoder().fit(train["species"]).classes_
)
submission.insert(0, "id", test["id"])
submission.to_csv("submission/submission.csv", index=False)

print(f"Mean Validation Log Loss: {np.mean(val_scores):.4f} ± {np.std(val_scores):.4f}")

texture = [f"texture{i}" for i in range(1, 65)]


def process_features(df):
    scaler = StandardScaler()
    return np.hstack(
        [
            scaler.fit_transform(df[margin]),
            scaler.fit_transform(df[shape]),
            scaler.fit_transform(df[texture]),
        ]
    )


X = process_features(train)
y = LabelEncoder().fit_transform(train["species"])
X_test = process_features(test)


class AttentionEnhancedClassifier(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__()
        self.branch1 = self._create_branch()
        self.branch2 = self._create_branch()
        self.branch3 = self._create_branch()

        # Attention layers
        self.attn1 = nn.Linear(128, 1)
        self.attn2 = nn.Linear(128, 1)
        self.attn3 = nn.Linear(128, 1)
        self.softmax = nn.Softmax(dim=1)

        self.combined = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(384, 512),
            nn.BatchNorm1d(512),
            nn.GELU(),
            nn.Dropout(0.6),
            nn.Linear(512, 256),
            nn.LayerNorm(256),
            nn.GELU(),
            nn.Dropout(0.5),
            nn.Linear(256, 99),
        )

    def _create_branch(self):
        return nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(64, 256),
            nn.BatchNorm1d(256),
            nn.GELU(),
            nn.Dropout(0.4),
            nn.Linear(256, 128),
            nn.BatchNorm1d(128),
            nn.GELU(),
            nn.Dropout(0.3),
        )

    def forward(self, x):
        x1 = self.branch1(x[:, :64])
        x2 = self.branch2(x[:, 64:128])
        x3 = self.branch3(x[:, 128:192])

        # Compute attention scores
        a1 = self.attn1(x1)
        a2 = self.attn2(x2)
        a3 = self.attn3(x3)
        attn_weights = self.softmax(torch.cat([a1, a2, a3], dim=1))

        # Apply attention-weighted concatenation
        x_combined = torch.cat(
            [
                x1 * attn_weights[:, 0].unsqueeze(1),
                x2 * attn_weights[:, 1].unsqueeze(1),
                x3 * attn_weights[:, 2].unsqueeze(1),
            ],
            dim=1,
        )

        return self.combined(x_combined)


device = torch.device("cuda" if torch.cuda.is_available() else "cpu")

batch_size = 32

skf = StratifiedKFold(n_splits=n_splits, shuffle=True, random_state=42)

    scheduler = optim.lr_scheduler.ReduceLROnPlateau(optimizer, patience=5, factor=0.2)
    criterion = nn.CrossEntropyLoss(label_smoothing=0.1)

    best_loss = np.inf
    patience = 0

    for epoch in range(epochs):
        model.train()
        for inputs, targets in train_loader:
            inputs, targets = inputs.to(device), targets.to(device)
            optimizer.zero_grad(set_to_none=True)
            outputs = model(inputs)
            loss = criterion(outputs, targets)
            loss.backward()
            nn.utils.clip_grad_norm_(model.parameters(), 1.0)
            optimizer.step()

        model.eval()
        with torch.no_grad():
            val_inputs = torch.FloatTensor(X_val).to(device)
            val_outputs = model(val_inputs)
            val_loss = criterion(val_outputs, torch.LongTensor(y_val).to(device)).item()

        scheduler.step(val_loss)
        if val_loss < best_loss:
            best_loss = val_loss
            patience = 0
            torch.save(model.state_dict(), f"working/best_fold{fold}.pt")
        else:
            patience += 1
            if patience >= 12:
                break

    model.load_state_dict(torch.load(f"working/best_fold{fold}.pt"))
    model.eval()

    with torch.no_grad():
        val_preds = (
            torch.softmax(model(torch.FloatTensor(X_val).to(device)), dim=1)
            .cpu()
            .numpy()
        )
        val_score = log_loss(y_val, val_preds)
        val_scores.append(val_score)
        print(f"Fold {fold} Val Log Loss: {val_score:.4f}")

        test_outputs = (
            torch.softmax(model(torch.FloatTensor(X_test).to(device)), dim=1)
            .cpu()
            .numpy()
        )
        test_probs.append(test_outputs)

final_probs = np.mean(test_probs, axis=0)

)

class SAM(optim.Optimizer):
    def __init__(self, params, base_optimizer, rho=0.05, **kwargs):
        defaults = dict(rho=rho, **kwargs)
        super(SAM, self).__init__(params, defaults)
        self.base_optimizer = base_optimizer(self.param_groups, **kwargs)
        self.param_groups = self.base_optimizer.param_groups

    @torch.no_grad()
    def step(self, closure=None):
        if closure is None:
            raise ValueError("SAM requires closure")

        closure = torch.enable_grad()(closure)
        loss = closure()
        loss.backward(retain_graph=True)

        grad_norm = self._grad_norm()
        for group in self.param_groups:
            scale = group["rho"] / (grad_norm + 1e-12)
            for p in group["params"]:
                if p.grad is None:
                    continue
                e_w = p.grad * scale
                p.add_(e_w)
                self.state[p]["e_w"] = e_w

        closure().backward()
        self.base_optimizer.step()

        for group in self.param_groups:
            for p in group["params"]:
                if p.grad is None:
                    continue
                p.sub_(self.state[p]["e_w"])

        self.base_optimizer.step()
        self.zero_grad()

    def _grad_norm(self):
        return torch.norm(
            torch.stack(
                [
                    p.grad.norm(p=2)
                    for group in self.param_groups
                    for p in group["params"]
                    if p.grad is not None
                ]
            ),
            p=2,
        )

class ContextAwareAttentionClassifier(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__()
        self.branch1 = self._create_branch()
        self.branch2 = self._create_branch()
        self.branch3 = self._create_branch()

        # Unified attention mechanism
        self.attn_layer = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(128 * 3, 64), nn.GELU(), nn.Dropout(0.2), nn.Linear(64, 3)
        )
        self.softmax = nn.Softmax(dim=1)

        self.combined = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(384, 512),
            nn.BatchNorm1d(512),
            nn.GELU(),
            nn.Dropout(0.6),
            nn.Linear(512, 256),
            nn.LayerNorm(256),
            nn.GELU(),
            nn.Dropout(0.5),
            nn.Linear(256, 99),
        )

    def _create_branch(self):
        return nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(64, 256),
            nn.BatchNorm1d(256),
            nn.GELU(),
            nn.Dropout(0.4),
            nn.Linear(256, 128),
            nn.BatchNorm1d(128),
            nn.GELU(),
            nn.Dropout(0.3),
        )

    def forward(self, x):
        x1 = self.branch1(x[:, :64])
        x2 = self.branch2(x[:, 64:128])
        x3 = self.branch3(x[:, 128:192])

        # Context-aware attention scoring
        combined_features = torch.cat([x1, x2, x3], dim=1)
        attn_scores = self.attn_layer(combined_features)
        attn_weights = self.softmax(attn_scores)

        x_combined = torch.cat(
            [
                x1 * attn_weights[:, 0].unsqueeze(1),
                x2 * attn_weights[:, 1].unsqueeze(1),
                x3 * attn_weights[:, 2].unsqueeze(1),
            ],
            dim=1,
        )

        return self.combined(x_combined)

    pca_features = []

        pca = PCA(n_components=n_components, random_state=42).fit(group_data)
        pca_features.append(pca.transform(group_data))
    return np.hstack(pca_features)

class CrossAttention(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, embed_dim, num_heads):
        super().__init__()
        self.mha = nn.MultiheadAttention(embed_dim, num_heads, batch_first=True)
        self.norm = nn.LayerNorm(embed_dim)

    def forward(self, queries, keys_values):
        attn_output, _ = self.mha(queries, keys_values, keys_values)
        return self.norm(queries + attn_output)


class LeafClassifier(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, num_classes):
        super().__init__()
        # Image branch
        self.cnn = models.efficientnet_b3(pretrained=True)
        self.cnn.features[0][0] = nn.Conv2d(
            1, 40, kernel_size=3, stride=2, padding=1, bias=False
        )
        self.cnn.classifier = nn.Identity()
        self.img_proj = nn.Linear(1536, 512)

        # Tabular branch
        self.tab_encoder = nn.TransformerEncoder(
            nn.TransformerEncoderLayer(
                d_model=96, nhead=8, dim_feedforward=384, dropout=0.2
            ),
            num_layers=2,
        )
        self.tab_proj = nn.Linear(96, 512)

        # Cross-attention fusion
        self.cross_attn1 = CrossAttention(512, 8)
        self.cross_attn2 = CrossAttention(512, 8)

        # Classifier
        self.classifier = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(1024, 1024),
            nn.BatchNorm1d(1024),
            nn.GELU(),
            nn.Dropout(0.5),
            nn.Linear(1024, num_classes),
        )

    def forward(self, x_tab, x_img):
        # Image features
        img_feat = self.cnn(x_img)
        img_feat = self.img_proj(img_feat).unsqueeze(1)

        # Tabular features
        tab_feat = self.tab_encoder(x_tab.unsqueeze(1))
        tab_feat = self.tab_proj(tab_feat)

        # Cross-modal attention
        img_attended = self.cross_attn1(img_feat, tab_feat)
        tab_attended = self.cross_attn2(tab_feat, img_feat)

        # Concatenate and classify
        fused = torch.cat([img_attended.squeeze(1), tab_attended.squeeze(1)], dim=1)
        return self.classifier(fused)

class SAM(optim.Optimizer):
    def __init__(self, params, base_optimizer, rho=0.05, **kwargs):
        defaults = dict(rho=rho, **kwargs)
        super(SAM, self).__init__(params, defaults)
        self.base_optimizer = base_optimizer(self.param_groups, **kwargs)
        self.param_groups = self.base_optimizer.param_groups

    @torch.no_grad()
    def step(self, closure=None):
        if closure is None:
            raise ValueError("SAM requires closure")

        closure = torch.enable_grad()(closure)
        loss = closure()
        loss.backward(retain_graph=True)

        grad_norm = self._grad_norm()
        for group in self.param_groups:
            scale = group["rho"] / (grad_norm + 1e-12)
            for p in group["params"]:
                if p.grad is None:
                    continue
                e_w = p.grad * scale
                p.add_(e_w)
                self.state[p]["e_w"] = e_w

        closure().backward()
        self.base_optimizer.step()

        for group in self.param_groups:
            for p in group["params"]:
                if p.grad is None:
                    continue
                p.sub_(self.state[p]["e_w"])

        self.base_optimizer.step()
        self.zero_grad()

    def _grad_norm(self):
        return torch.norm(
            torch.stack(
                [
                    p.grad.norm(p=2)
                    for group in self.param_groups
                    for p in group["params"]
                    if p.grad is not None
                ]
            ),
            p=2,
        )

            nn.Linear(1024, 99),
        )

    def forward(self, x_feat, x_img):
        feat = self.feat_net(x_feat)
        img_feat = self.effnet(x_img)
        combined = torch.cat([feat, img_feat], dim=1)
        return self.classifier(combined)

        # Generate permutation indices
        perm = torch.randperm(lbl.size(0), device=device)

        # Sample mixing coefficients
        lam = torch.distributions.beta.Beta(0.4, 0.4).sample((lbl.size(0),)).to(device)
        lam_img = lam.view(-1, 1, 1, 1)
        lam_feat = lam.view(-1, 1)

        # Mix features and images
        mixed_feat = lam_feat * feat + (1 - lam_feat) * feat[perm]
        mixed_img = lam_img * img + (1 - lam_img) * img[perm]
        mixed_labels = lam_feat * one_hot + (1 - lam_feat) * one_hot[perm]

            optimizer.zero_grad()
            outputs = model(mixed_feat, mixed_img)

def process_features(df):
    scaler = StandardScaler()
    return np.hstack(
        [
            scaler.fit_transform(df[margin]),
            scaler.fit_transform(df[shape]),
            scaler.fit_transform(df[texture]),
        ]
    )

class ContextAwareAttentionClassifier(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__()
        self.branch1 = self._create_branch()
        self.branch2 = self._create_branch()
        self.branch3 = self._create_branch()

        self.attn_layer = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(128 * 3, 64), nn.GELU(), nn.Dropout(0.2), nn.Linear(64, 3)
        )
        self.softmax = nn.Softmax(dim=1)

        self.combined = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(384, 512),
            nn.BatchNorm1d(512),
            nn.GELU(),
            nn.Dropout(0.6),
            nn.Linear(512, 256),
            nn.LayerNorm(256),
            nn.GELU(),
            nn.Dropout(0.5),
            nn.Linear(256, 99),
        )

    def _create_branch(self):
        return nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(64, 256),
            nn.BatchNorm1d(256),
            nn.GELU(),
            nn.Dropout(0.4),
            nn.Linear(256, 128),
            nn.BatchNorm1d(128),
            nn.GELU(),
            nn.Dropout(0.3),
        )

    def forward(self, x):
        x1 = self.branch1(x[:, :64])
        x2 = self.branch2(x[:, 64:128])
        x3 = self.branch3(x[:, 128:192])

        combined = torch.cat([x1, x2, x3], dim=1)
        attn_scores = self.attn_layer(combined)
        attn_weights = self.softmax(attn_scores)

        x_combined = torch.cat(
            [
                x1 * attn_weights[:, 0].unsqueeze(1),
                x2 * attn_weights[:, 1].unsqueeze(1),
                x3 * attn_weights[:, 2].unsqueeze(1),
            ],
            dim=1,
        )

        return self.combined(x_combined)


device = torch.device("cuda" if torch.cuda.is_available() else "cpu")
epochs = 250
batch_size = 32
n_splits = 5

skf = StratifiedKFold(n_splits=n_splits, shuffle=True, random_state=42)

for fold, (train_idx, val_idx) in enumerate(skf.split(X, y)):  # Fixed variable name
    X_train, X_val = X[train_idx], X[val_idx]
    y_train, y_val = y[train_idx], y[val_idx]

    train_ds = TensorDataset(torch.FloatTensor(X_train), torch.LongTensor(y_train))
    train_loader = DataLoader(
        train_ds, batch_size=batch_size, shuffle=True, num_workers=4, pin_memory=True
    )

    model = ContextAwareAttentionClassifier().to(device)
    optimizer = optim.AdamW(model.parameters(), lr=1e-3, weight_decay=1e-4)
    scheduler = optim.lr_scheduler.CosineAnnealingWarmRestarts(
        optimizer, T_0=20, eta_min=1e-5
    )
    criterion = nn.CrossEntropyLoss(label_smoothing=0.1)

    best_loss = np.inf
    patience = 0

    for epoch in range(epochs):
        model.train()
        for inputs, targets in train_loader:
            inputs, targets = inputs.to(device), targets.to(device)
            optimizer.zero_grad(set_to_none=True)
            outputs = model(inputs)
            loss = criterion(outputs, targets)
            loss.backward()
            nn.utils.clip_grad_norm_(model.parameters(), 1.0)
            optimizer.step()

        model.eval()
        with torch.no_grad():
            val_inputs = torch.FloatTensor(X_val).to(device)
            val_outputs = model(val_inputs)
            val_loss = criterion(val_outputs, torch.LongTensor(y_val).to(device)).item()

        scheduler.step()
        if val_loss < best_loss:
            best_loss = val_loss
            patience = 0
            torch.save(model.state_dict(), f"working/best_fold{fold}.pt")
        else:
            patience += 1
            if patience >= 12:
                break

    model.load_state_dict(torch.load(f"working/best_fold{fold}.pt"))
    model.eval()

    with torch.no_grad():
        # Validation predictions
        val_preds = (
            torch.softmax(model(torch.FloatTensor(X_val).to(device)), dim=1)
            .cpu()
            .numpy()
        )
        val_score = log_loss(y_val, val_preds)
        val_scores.append(val_score)
        print(f"Fold {fold} Val Log Loss: {val_score:.4f}")

        # Test predictions
        test_outputs = (
            torch.softmax(model(torch.FloatTensor(X_test).to(device)), dim=1)
            .cpu()
            .numpy()
        )
        test_probs.append(test_outputs)

# Generate submission

class CrossAttention(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, embed_dim, num_heads):
        super().__init__()
        self.mha = nn.MultiheadAttention(embed_dim, num_heads, batch_first=True)
        self.norm = nn.LayerNorm(embed_dim)

    def forward(self, queries, keys_values):
        attn_output, _ = self.mha(queries, keys_values, keys_values)
        return self.norm(queries + attn_output)


class LeafClassifier(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, num_classes):
        super().__init__()
        self.cnn = models.efficientnet_b3(pretrained=True)
        self.cnn.features[0][0] = nn.Conv2d(
            1, 40, kernel_size=3, stride=2, padding=1, bias=False
        )
        self.cnn.classifier = nn.Identity()
        self.img_proj = nn.Linear(1536, 512)

        self.tab_encoder = nn.TransformerEncoder(
            nn.TransformerEncoderLayer(
                d_model=96, nhead=8, dim_feedforward=384, dropout=0.2
            ),
            num_layers=2,
        )
        self.tab_proj = nn.Linear(96, 512)

        self.cross_attn1 = CrossAttention(512, 8)
        self.cross_attn2 = CrossAttention(512, 8)

        self.classifier = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(1024, 1024),
            nn.BatchNorm1d(1024),
            nn.GELU(),
            nn.Dropout(0.5),
            nn.Linear(1024, num_classes),
        )

    def forward(self, x_tab, x_img):
        img_feat = self.cnn(x_img)
        img_feat = self.img_proj(img_feat).unsqueeze(1)

        tab_feat = self.tab_encoder(x_tab.unsqueeze(1))
        tab_feat = self.tab_proj(tab_feat)

        img_attended = self.cross_attn1(img_feat, tab_feat)
        tab_attended = self.cross_attn2(tab_feat, img_feat)

        fused = torch.cat([img_attended.squeeze(1), tab_attended.squeeze(1)], dim=1)
        return self.classifier(fused)

class SAM(optim.Optimizer):
    def __init__(self, params, base_optimizer, rho=0.05, **kwargs):
        defaults = dict(rho=rho, **kwargs)
        super(SAM, self).__init__(params, defaults)
        self.base_optimizer = base_optimizer(self.param_groups, **kwargs)
        self.param_groups = self.base_optimizer.param_groups

    @torch.no_grad()
    def step(self, closure=None):
        if closure is None:
            raise ValueError("SAM requires closure")

        closure = torch.enable_grad()(closure)
        loss = closure()
        loss.backward(retain_graph=True)

        grad_norm = self._grad_norm()
        for group in self.param_groups:
            scale = group["rho"] / (grad_norm + 1e-12)
            for p in group["params"]:
                if p.grad is None:
                    continue
                e_w = p.grad * scale
                p.add_(e_w)
                self.state[p]["e_w"] = e_w

        closure().backward()
        self.base_optimizer.step()

        for group in self.param_groups:
            for p in group["params"]:
                if p.grad is None:
                    continue
                p.sub_(self.state[p]["e_w"])

        self.base_optimizer.step()
        self.zero_grad()

    def _grad_norm(self):
        return torch.norm(
            torch.stack(
                [
                    p.grad.norm(p=2)
                    for group in self.param_groups
                    for p in group["params"]
                    if p.grad is not None
                ]
            ),
            p=2,
        )

        self.classifier = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(2048 + 1280, 1024),
            nn.GELU(),
            nn.Dropout(0.5),
            nn.Linear(1024, 99),
        )

    def forward(self, x_feat, x_img):
        feat = self.feat_net(x_feat)
        img_feat = self.effnet(x_img)
        combined = torch.cat([feat, img_feat], dim=1)
        return self.classifier(combined)

        feat, img, lbl = feat.to(device), img.to(device), lbl.to(device)
        one_hot = torch.nn.functional.one_hot(lbl, num_classes=99).float()
        perm = torch.randperm(lbl.size(0), device=device)

        # Hybrid augmentation: 50% Mixup, 50% CutMix
        if random.random() < 0.5:
            # CutMix implementation
            lam = np.random.beta(1.0, 1.0)
            H, W = img.shape[2], img.shape[3]
            cut_rat = np.sqrt(1.0 - lam)
            cut_w, cut_h = int(W * cut_rat), int(H * cut_rat)
            cx, cy = np.random.randint(W), np.random.randint(H)
            bbx1 = np.clip(cx - cut_w // 2, 0, W)
            bby1 = np.clip(cy - cut_h // 2, 0, H)
            bbx2 = np.clip(cx + cut_w // 2, 0, W)
            bby2 = np.clip(cy + cut_h // 2, 0, H)
            lam = 1 - ((bbx2 - bbx1) * (bby2 - bby1) / (H * W))

            mixed_img = img.clone()
            mixed_img[:, :, bby1:bby2, bbx1:bbx2] = img[perm, :, bby1:bby2, bbx1:bbx2]
            mixed_feat = lam * feat + (1 - lam) * feat[perm]
            mixed_labels = lam * one_hot + (1 - lam) * one_hot[perm]
        else:
            # Mixup implementation
            lam = (
                torch.distributions.beta.Beta(0.4, 0.4)
                .sample((lbl.size(0),))
                .to(device)
            )
            lam_img = lam.view(-1, 1, 1, 1)
            lam_feat = lam.view(-1, 1)
            mixed_feat = lam_feat * feat + (1 - lam_feat) * feat[perm]
            mixed_img = lam_img * img + (1 - lam_img) * img[perm]
            mixed_labels = lam_feat * one_hot + (1 - lam_feat) * one_hot[perm]

        def closure():
            optimizer.zero_grad()
            outputs = model(mixed_feat, mixed_img)
            loss = criterion(torch.log_softmax(outputs, dim=1), mixed_labels)
            loss.backward(retain_graph=True)
            return loss

        optimizer.step(closure)
        scheduler.step()

    val_probs = torch.cat(val_probs).numpy()
    val_true = torch.cat(val_true).numpy()
    current_logloss = log_loss(val_true, val_probs)
    print(f"Epoch {epoch+1}: Val LogLoss {current_logloss:.4f}")

    if current_logloss < best_logloss:
        best_logloss = current_logloss
        torch.save(model.state_dict(), "working/best_model.pth")

def process_features(df):
    scaler = StandardScaler()
    return np.hstack(
        [
            scaler.fit_transform(df[margin]),
            scaler.fit_transform(df[shape]),
            scaler.fit_transform(df[texture]),
        ]
    )


X = process_features(train)

class EnhancedFeatureAttention(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__()
        self.branch1 = self._create_branch()
        self.branch2 = self._create_branch()
        self.branch3 = self._create_branch()

        # Enhanced attention layer with per-feature weights
        self.attn_layer = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(128 * 3, 256), nn.GELU(), nn.Dropout(0.3), nn.Linear(256, 3 * 128)
        )
        self.sigmoid = nn.Sigmoid()

        self.combined = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(384, 512),
            nn.BatchNorm1d(512),
            nn.GELU(),
            nn.Dropout(0.6),
            nn.Linear(512, 256),
            nn.LayerNorm(256),
            nn.GELU(),
            nn.Dropout(0.5),
            nn.Linear(256, 99),
        )

    def _create_branch(self):
        return nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(64, 256),
            nn.BatchNorm1d(256),
            nn.GELU(),
            nn.Dropout(0.4),
            nn.Linear(256, 128),
            nn.BatchNorm1d(128),
            nn.GELU(),
            nn.Dropout(0.3),
        )

    def forward(self, x):
        x1 = self.branch1(x[:, :64])
        x2 = self.branch2(x[:, 64:128])
        x3 = self.branch3(x[:, 128:192])

        combined = torch.cat([x1, x2, x3], dim=1)
        attn_scores = self.attn_layer(combined)
        attn_scores = attn_scores.view(-1, 3, 128)
        attn_weights = self.sigmoid(attn_scores)

        x1_attn = x1 * attn_weights[:, 0, :]
        x2_attn = x2 * attn_weights[:, 1, :]
        x3_attn = x3 * attn_weights[:, 2, :]

        x_combined = torch.cat([x1_attn, x2_attn, x3_attn], dim=1)
        return self.combined(x_combined)


device = torch.device("cuda" if torch.cuda.is_available() else "cpu")

batch_size = 32

for fold, (train_idx, val_idx) in enumerate(skf.split(X, y)):
    X_train, X_val = X[train_idx], X[val_idx]
    y_train, y_val = y[train_idx], y[val_idx]

    train_ds = TensorDataset(torch.FloatTensor(X_train), torch.LongTensor(y_train))
    train_loader = DataLoader(
        train_ds, batch_size=batch_size, shuffle=True, num_workers=4, pin_memory=True
    )

    model = EnhancedFeatureAttention().to(device)
    optimizer = optim.AdamW(model.parameters(), lr=1e-3, weight_decay=1e-4)
    scheduler = optim.lr_scheduler.CosineAnnealingWarmRestarts(
        optimizer, T_0=20, eta_min=1e-5
    )
    criterion = nn.CrossEntropyLoss(label_smoothing=0.1)

    best_loss = np.inf
    patience = 0

    for epoch in range(epochs):
        model.train()
        for inputs, targets in train_loader:
            inputs, targets = inputs.to(device), targets.to(device)
            optimizer.zero_grad(set_to_none=True)
            outputs = model(inputs)
            loss = criterion(outputs, targets)
            loss.backward()
            nn.utils.clip_grad_norm_(model.parameters(), 1.0)
            optimizer.step()

        model.eval()
        with torch.no_grad():
            val_inputs = torch.FloatTensor(X_val).to(device)
            val_outputs = model(val_inputs)
            val_loss = criterion(val_outputs, torch.LongTensor(y_val).to(device)).item()

        scheduler.step()
        if val_loss < best_loss:
            best_loss = val_loss
            patience = 0
            torch.save(model.state_dict(), f"working/best_fold{fold}.pt")
        else:
            patience += 1
            if patience >= 12:
                break

    model.load_state_dict(torch.load(f"working/best_fold{fold}.pt"))
    model.eval()

    with torch.no_grad():
        val_preds = (
            torch.softmax(model(torch.FloatTensor(X_val).to(device)), dim=1)
            .cpu()
            .numpy()
        )
        val_score = log_loss(y_val, val_preds)
        val_scores.append(val_score)
        print(f"Fold {fold} Val Log Loss: {val_score:.4f}")

        test_outputs = (
            torch.softmax(model(torch.FloatTensor(X_test).to(device)), dim=1)
            .cpu()
            .numpy()
        )
        test_probs.append(test_outputs)

final_probs = np.mean(test_probs, axis=0)

class CrossAttention(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, embed_dim, num_heads):
        super().__init__()
        self.mha = nn.MultiheadAttention(embed_dim, num_heads, batch_first=True)
        self.norm = nn.LayerNorm(embed_dim)

    def forward(self, queries, keys_values):
        attn_output, _ = self.mha(queries, keys_values, keys_values)
        return self.norm(queries + attn_output)


class LeafClassifier(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, num_classes):
        super().__init__()
        self.cnn = models.efficientnet_b3(pretrained=True)
        self.cnn.features[0][0] = nn.Conv2d(
            1, 40, kernel_size=3, stride=2, padding=1, bias=False
        )
        self.cnn.classifier = nn.Identity()
        self.img_proj = nn.Linear(1536, 512)

        self.tab_encoder = nn.TransformerEncoder(
            nn.TransformerEncoderLayer(
                d_model=96, nhead=8, dim_feedforward=384, dropout=0.2
            ),
            num_layers=2,
        )
        self.tab_proj = nn.Linear(96, 512)

        self.cross_attn1 = CrossAttention(512, 8)
        self.cross_attn2 = CrossAttention(512, 8)

        self.classifier = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(1024, 1024),
            nn.BatchNorm1d(1024),
            nn.GELU(),
            nn.Dropout(0.5),
            nn.Linear(1024, num_classes),
        )

    def forward(self, x_tab, x_img):
        img_feat = self.cnn(x_img)
        img_feat = self.img_proj(img_feat).unsqueeze(1)

        tab_feat = self.tab_encoder(x_tab.unsqueeze(1))
        tab_feat = self.tab_proj(tab_feat)

        img_attended = self.cross_attn1(img_feat, tab_feat)
        tab_attended = self.cross_attn2(tab_feat, img_feat)

        fused = torch.cat([img_attended.squeeze(1), tab_attended.squeeze(1)], dim=1)
        return self.classifier(fused)

class SAM(optim.Optimizer):
    def __init__(self, params, base_optimizer, rho=0.05, **kwargs):
        defaults = dict(rho=rho, **kwargs)
        super(SAM, self).__init__(params, defaults)
        self.base_optimizer = base_optimizer(self.param_groups, **kwargs)
        self.param_groups = self.base_optimizer.param_groups

    @torch.no_grad()
    def step(self, closure=None):
        if closure is None:
            raise ValueError("SAM requires closure")

        closure = torch.enable_grad()(closure)
        loss = closure()
        loss.backward(retain_graph=True)

        grad_norm = self._grad_norm()
        for group in self.param_groups:
            scale = group["rho"] / (grad_norm + 1e-12)
            for p in group["params"]:
                if p.grad is None:
                    continue
                e_w = p.grad * scale
                p.add_(e_w)
                self.state[p]["e_w"] = e_w

        closure().backward()
        self.base_optimizer.step()

        for group in self.param_groups:
            for p in group["params"]:
                if p.grad is None:
                    continue
                p.sub_(self.state[p]["e_w"])

        self.base_optimizer.step()
        self.zero_grad()

    def _grad_norm(self):
        return torch.norm(
            torch.stack(
                [
                    p.grad.norm(p=2)
                    for group in self.param_groups
                    for p in group["params"]
                    if p.grad is not None
                ]
            ),
            p=2,
        )

        features = torch.FloatTensor(self.df.iloc[idx][feature_cols])
        label = self.labels[idx] if self.labels is not None else -1
        return (features, img), label

        )

    def forward(self, x_feat, x_img):
        feat = self.feat_net(x_feat)
        img_feat = self.effnet(x_img)
        combined = torch.cat([feat, img_feat], dim=1)

        if random.random() < 0.5:
            lam = np.random.beta(1.0, 1.0)
            H, W = img.shape[2], img.shape[3]
            cut_rat = np.sqrt(1.0 - lam)
            cut_w, cut_h = int(W * cut_rat), int(H * cut_rat)
            cx, cy = np.random.randint(W), np.random.randint(H)
            bbx1 = np.clip(cx - cut_w // 2, 0, W)
            bby1 = np.clip(cy - cut_h // 2, 0, H)
            bbx2 = np.clip(cx + cut_w // 2, 0, W)
            bby2 = np.clip(cy + cut_h // 2, 0, H)
            lam = 1 - ((bbx2 - bbx1) * (bby2 - bby1) / (H * W))

class SAM(optim.Optimizer):
    def __init__(self, params, base_optimizer, rho=0.05, **kwargs):
        defaults = dict(rho=rho, **kwargs)
        super(SAM, self).__init__(params, defaults)
        self.base_optimizer = base_optimizer
        self.param_groups = self.base_optimizer.param_groups

    @torch.no_grad()
    def first_step(self, zero_grad=False):
        grad_norm = self._grad_norm()
        for group in self.param_groups:
            scale = group["rho"] / (grad_norm + 1e-12)
            for p in group["params"]:
                if p.grad is None:
                    continue
                e_w = p.grad * scale.to(p)
                p.add_(e_w)
                self.state[p]["e_w"] = e_w
        if zero_grad:
            self.zero_grad()

    @torch.no_grad()
    def second_step(self, zero_grad=False):
        for group in self.param_groups:
            for p in group["params"]:
                if p.grad is None:
                    continue
                p.sub_(self.state[p]["e_w"])
        self.base_optimizer.step()
        if zero_grad:
            self.zero_grad()

    def _grad_norm(self):
        shared_device = self.param_groups[0]["params"][0].device
        norm = torch.norm(
            torch.stack(
                [
                    p.grad.norm(p=2).to(shared_device)
                    for group in self.param_groups
                    for p in group["params"]
                    if p.grad is not None
                ]
            ),
            p=2,
        )
        return norm

    def step(self, closure=None):
        raise NotImplementedError("SAM doesn't work like other optimizers")

    def __init__(self, input_size, num_classes):
        super().__init__()

            nn.Linear(64, 256), nn.GELU(), nn.BatchNorm1d(256), nn.Dropout(0.4)
        )
        self.shape_branch = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(64, 256), nn.GELU(), nn.BatchNorm1d(256), nn.Dropout(0.4)
        )
        self.texture_branch = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(64, 256), nn.GELU(), nn.BatchNorm1d(256), nn.Dropout(0.4)
        )

        self.transformer = nn.TransformerEncoder(
            nn.TransformerEncoderLayer(
                d_model=256,
                nhead=8,
                dim_feedforward=1024,
                dropout=0.2,
                activation="gelu",
                batch_first=False,
            ),
            num_layers=3,
        )
        self.final_proj = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(768, 512),
            nn.GELU(),
            nn.BatchNorm1d(512),
            nn.Dropout(0.5),
            nn.Linear(512, num_classes),
        )

    def forward(self, x):
        margin = self.margin_branch(x[:, :64])
        shape = self.shape_branch(x[:, 64:128])
        texture = self.texture_branch(x[:, 128:])
        features = torch.stack([margin, shape, texture], dim=0)
        transformed = self.transformer(features)
        aggregated = transformed.permute(1, 0, 2).flatten(1)
        return self.final_proj(aggregated)

import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
from sklearn.model_selection import StratifiedKFold
from sklearn.preprocessing import LabelEncoder, StandardScaler
from sklearn.metrics import log_loss
import torch
import torch.nn as nn
import torch.optim as optim
from torch.utils.data import DataLoader, TensorDataset
import os

os.makedirs("submission", exist_ok=True)

# Data loading and preprocessing
train = pd.read_csv("input/train.csv")
test = pd.read_csv("input/test.csv")

margin = [f"margin{i}" for i in range(1, 65)]
shape = [f"shape{i}" for i in range(1, 65)]
texture = [f"texture{i}" for i in range(1, 65)]


def process_features(df):
    scaler = StandardScaler()
    return np.hstack(
        [
            scaler.fit_transform(df[margin]),
            scaler.fit_transform(df[shape]),
            scaler.fit_transform(df[texture]),
        ]
    )


X = process_features(train)
y = LabelEncoder().fit_transform(train["species"])
X_test = process_features(test)


class SELayer(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, channels, reduction=16):
        super().__init__()
        self.avg_pool = nn.AdaptiveAvgPool1d(1)
        self.fc = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(channels, channels // reduction),
            nn.GELU(),
            nn.Linear(channels // reduction, channels),
            nn.Sigmoid(),
        )

    def forward(self, x):
        b, c, _ = x.shape
        y = self.avg_pool(x).view(b, c)
        y = self.fc(y).view(b, c, 1)
        return x * y


class ConvFeatureExtractor(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__()
        self.branch1 = self._create_branch()
        self.branch2 = self._create_branch()
        self.branch3 = self._create_branch()

        self.attn_layer = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(128 * 3, 256), nn.GELU(), nn.Dropout(0.3), nn.Linear(256, 3 * 128)
        )
        self.sigmoid = nn.Sigmoid()

        self.combined = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(384, 512),
            nn.BatchNorm1d(512),
            nn.GELU(),
            nn.Dropout(0.6),
            nn.Linear(512, 256),
            nn.LayerNorm(256),
            nn.GELU(),
            nn.Dropout(0.5),
            nn.Linear(256, 99),
        )

    def _create_branch(self):
        return nn.Sequential(
            nn.Unflatten(1, (1, 64)),
            nn.Conv1d(1, 128, kernel_size=3, padding=1),
            nn.BatchNorm1d(128),
            SELayer(128),
            nn.GELU(),
            nn.Dropout(0.3),
            nn.Conv1d(128, 256, kernel_size=3, padding=1),
            nn.BatchNorm1d(256),
            SELayer(256),
            nn.GELU(),
            nn.AdaptiveAvgPool1d(1),
            nn.Flatten(),
            nn.Linear(256, 128),
            nn.BatchNorm1d(128),
            nn.GELU(),
            nn.Dropout(0.3),
        )

    def forward(self, x):
        x1 = self.branch1(x[:, :64])
        x2 = self.branch2(x[:, 64:128])
        x3 = self.branch3(x[:, 128:192])

        combined = torch.cat([x1, x2, x3], dim=1)
        attn_scores = self.attn_layer(combined)
        attn_scores = attn_scores.view(-1, 3, 128)
        attn_weights = self.sigmoid(attn_scores)

        x1_attn = x1 * attn_weights[:, 0, :]
        x2_attn = x2 * attn_weights[:, 1, :]
        x3_attn = x3 * attn_weights[:, 2, :]

        x_combined = torch.cat([x1_attn, x2_attn, x3_attn], dim=1)
        return self.combined(x_combined)


device = torch.device("cuda" if torch.cuda.is_available() else "cpu")
epochs = 200
batch_size = 32
n_splits = 5

skf = StratifiedKFold(n_splits=n_splits, shuffle=True, random_state=42)
test_probs = []
val_scores = []

for fold, (train_idx, val_idx) in enumerate(skf.split(X, y)):
    X_train, X_val = X[train_idx], X[val_idx]
    y_train, y_val = y[train_idx], y[val_idx]

    train_ds = TensorDataset(torch.FloatTensor(X_train), torch.LongTensor(y_train))
    train_loader = DataLoader(
        train_ds, batch_size=batch_size, shuffle=True, num_workers=4, pin_memory=True
    )

    model = ConvFeatureExtractor().to(device)
    optimizer = optim.AdamW(model.parameters(), lr=1e-3, weight_decay=1e-4)
    scheduler = optim.lr_scheduler.CosineAnnealingWarmRestarts(
        optimizer, T_0=20, eta_min=1e-5
    )
    criterion = nn.CrossEntropyLoss(label_smoothing=0.1)

    best_loss = np.inf
    patience = 0

    for epoch in range(epochs):
        model.train()
        for inputs, targets in train_loader:
            inputs, targets = inputs.to(device), targets.to(device)
            optimizer.zero_grad(set_to_none=True)
            outputs = model(inputs)
            loss = criterion(outputs, targets)
            loss.backward()
            nn.utils.clip_grad_norm_(model.parameters(), 1.0)
            optimizer.step()

        model.eval()
        with torch.no_grad():
            val_inputs = torch.FloatTensor(X_val).to(device)
            val_outputs = model(val_inputs)
            val_loss = criterion(val_outputs, torch.LongTensor(y_val).to(device)).item()

        scheduler.step()
        if val_loss < best_loss:
            best_loss = val_loss
            patience = 0
            torch.save(model.state_dict(), f"working/best_fold{fold}.pt")
        else:
            patience += 1
            if patience >= 10:
                break

    model.load_state_dict(torch.load(f"working/best_fold{fold}.pt"))
    model.eval()

    with torch.no_grad():
        val_preds = (
            torch.softmax(model(torch.FloatTensor(X_val).to(device)), dim=1)
            .cpu()
            .numpy()
        )
        val_score = log_loss(y_val, val_preds)
        val_scores.append(val_score)
        print(f"Fold {fold} Val Log Loss: {val_score:.4f}")

        test_outputs = (
            torch.softmax(model(torch.FloatTensor(X_test).to(device)), dim=1)
            .cpu()
            .numpy()
        )
        test_probs.append(test_outputs)

final_probs = np.mean(test_probs, axis=0)
submission = pd.DataFrame(
    final_probs, columns=LabelEncoder().fit(train["species"]).classes_
)
submission.insert(0, "id", test["id"])
submission.to_csv("submission/submission.csv", index=False)

print(f"Mean Validation Log Loss: {np.mean(val_scores):.4f} ± {np.std(val_scores):.4f}")

class SAM(optim.Optimizer):
    def __init__(self, params, base_optimizer, rho=0.05, **kwargs):

        self.param_groups = self.base_optimizer.param_groups

    @torch.no_grad()
    def step(self, closure=None):
        if closure is None:
            raise ValueError("SAM requires closure")

        closure = torch.enable_grad()(closure)
        loss = closure()
        loss.backward(retain_graph=True)

        grad_norm = self._grad_norm()
        for group in self.param_groups:
            scale = group["rho"] / (grad_norm + 1e-12)

                p.add_(e_w)
                self.state[p]["e_w"] = e_w

        closure().backward()
        self.base_optimizer.step()

        for group in self.param_groups:
            for p in group["params"]:
                if p.grad is None:
                    continue
                p.sub_(self.state[p]["e_w"])

        self.base_optimizer.step()
        self.zero_grad()

    def _grad_norm(self):
        return torch.norm(
            torch.stack(
                [
                    p.grad.norm(p=2)
                    for group in self.param_groups
                    for p in group["params"]
                    if p.grad is not None
                ]
            ),
            p=2,
        )

        transforms.ToTensor(),
        transforms.Normalize([0.485, 0.456, 0.406], [0.229, 0.224, 0.225]),
    ]

class LeafDataset(Dataset):
    def __init__(self, df, transform=None):
        self.df = df.reset_index(drop=True)
        self.transform = transform or base_transform
        self.labels = df["label"].values if "label" in df else None

    def __len__(self):
        return len(self.df)

    def __getitem__(self, idx):
        img_id = self.df.iloc[idx]["id"]
        try:
            img = Image.open(f"input/images/{img_id}.jpg").convert("L")
        except:
            img = Image.new("L", (224, 224), 255)

        img = self.transform(img)
        features = torch.FloatTensor(self.df.iloc[idx][feature_cols])
        label = self.labels[idx] if self.labels is not None else -1
        return (features, img), label


class EnhancedLeafClassifier(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__()
        self.feat_net = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(192, 1024),
            nn.LayerNorm(1024),
            nn.GELU(),
            nn.Dropout(0.3),
            nn.Linear(1024, 2048),
            nn.LayerNorm(2048),
        )
        self.effnet = models.efficientnet_v2_m(pretrained=True)
        self.effnet.classifier = nn.Identity()
        self.classifier = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(2048 + 1280, 1024),
            nn.GELU(),
            nn.Dropout(0.5),
            nn.Linear(1024, 99),
        )

    def forward(self, x_feat, x_img):
        feat = self.feat_net(x_feat)
        img_feat = self.effnet(x_img)
        combined = torch.cat([feat, img_feat], dim=1)
        return self.classifier(combined)


device = torch.device("cuda" if torch.cuda.is_available() else "cpu")

        perm = torch.randperm(lbl.size(0), device=device)

        if random.random() < 0.5:
            lam = np.random.beta(1.0, 1.0)
            H, W = img.shape[2], img.shape[3]
            cut_rat = np.sqrt(1.0 - lam)
            cut_w, cut_h = int(W * cut_rat), int(H * cut_rat)
            cx, cy = np.random.randint(W), np.random.randint(H)
            bbx1 = np.clip(cx - cut_w // 2, 0, W)
            bby1 = np.clip(cy - cut_h // 2, 0, H)
            bbx2 = np.clip(cx + cut_w // 2, 0, W)
            bby2 = np.clip(cy + cut_h // 2, 0, H)
            lam = 1 - ((bbx2 - bbx1) * (bby2 - bby1) / (H * W))

            mixed_img = img.clone()
            mixed_img[:, :, bby1:bby2, bbx1:bbx2] = img[perm, :, bby1:bby2, bbx1:bbx2]
            mixed_feat = lam * feat + (1 - lam) * feat[perm]

class SAM(optim.Optimizer):
    def __init__(self, params, base_optimizer, rho=0.05, **kwargs):
        defaults = dict(rho=rho, **kwargs)
        super(SAM, self).__init__(params, defaults)
        self.base_optimizer = base_optimizer(self.param_groups, **kwargs)

    @torch.no_grad()
    def first_step(self, zero_grad=False):
        grad_norm = self._grad_norm()
        for group in self.param_groups:
            scale = group["rho"] / (grad_norm + 1e-12)
            for p in group["params"]:
                if p.grad is None:
                    continue
                e_w = p.grad * scale.to(p)
                p.add_(e_w)
                self.state[p]["e_w"] = e_w
        if zero_grad:
            self.zero_grad()

    @torch.no_grad()
    def second_step(self, zero_grad=False):
        for group in self.param_groups:
            for p in group["params"]:
                if p.grad is None:
                    continue
                p.sub_(self.state[p]["e_w"])
        self.base_optimizer.step()
        if zero_grad:
            self.zero_grad()

    def _grad_norm(self):
        shared_device = self.param_groups[0]["params"][0].device
        norm = torch.norm(
            torch.stack(
                [
                    p.grad.norm(p=2).to(shared_device)
                    for group in self.param_groups
                    for p in group["params"]
                    if p.grad is not None
                ]
            ),
            p=2,
        )
        return norm

    def step(self, closure=None):
        raise NotImplementedError("SAM doesn't work like other optimizers")

        )

            nn.Linear(64, 256), nn.GELU(), nn.BatchNorm1d(256), nn.Dropout(0.4)
        )
        self.texture_branch = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(64, 256), nn.GELU(), nn.BatchNorm1d(256), nn.Dropout(0.4)
        )

        self.transformer = nn.TransformerEncoder(
            nn.TransformerEncoderLayer(
                d_model=256,
                nhead=8,
                dim_feedforward=1024,
                dropout=0.2,
                activation="gelu",
                batch_first=False,
            ),
            num_layers=3,

        self.final_proj = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(768, 512),
            nn.GELU(),
            nn.BatchNorm1d(512),
            nn.Dropout(0.5),
            nn.Linear(512, num_classes),

    def forward(self, x):
        margin = self.margin_branch(x[:, :64])
        shape = self.shape_branch(x[:, 64:128])
        texture = self.texture_branch(x[:, 128:])
        features = torch.stack([margin, shape, texture], dim=0)
        transformed = self.transformer(features)

import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
from sklearn.model_selection import StratifiedKFold
from sklearn.preprocessing import LabelEncoder, StandardScaler
from sklearn.metrics import log_loss
import torch
import torch.nn as nn
import torch.optim as optim
from torch.utils.data import DataLoader, TensorDataset
import os

os.makedirs("submission", exist_ok=True)

# Data loading and preprocessing
train = pd.read_csv("input/train.csv")
test = pd.read_csv("input/test.csv")

margin = [f"margin{i}" for i in range(1, 65)]
shape = [f"shape{i}" for i in range(1, 65)]
texture = [f"texture{i}" for i in range(1, 65)]


def process_features(df):
    scaler = StandardScaler()
    return np.hstack(
        [
            scaler.fit_transform(df[margin]),
            scaler.fit_transform(df[shape]),
            scaler.fit_transform(df[texture]),
        ]
    )


X = process_features(train)
y = LabelEncoder().fit_transform(train["species"])
X_test = process_features(test)


class SELayer(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, channels, reduction=16):
        super().__init__()
        self.avg_pool = nn.AdaptiveAvgPool1d(1)
        self.fc = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(channels, channels // reduction),
            nn.GELU(),
            nn.Linear(channels // reduction, channels),
            nn.Sigmoid(),
        )

    def forward(self, x):
        b, c, _ = x.shape
        y = self.avg_pool(x).view(b, c)
        y = self.fc(y).view(b, c, 1)
        return x * y


class ConvFeatureExtractor(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__()
        self.branch1 = self._create_branch()
        self.branch2 = self._create_branch()
        self.branch3 = self._create_branch()

        self.attn_layer = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(128 * 3, 256), nn.GELU(), nn.Dropout(0.3), nn.Linear(256, 3 * 128)
        )
        self.sigmoid = nn.Sigmoid()

        self.combined = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(384, 512),
            nn.BatchNorm1d(512),
            nn.GELU(),
            nn.Dropout(0.6),
            nn.Linear(512, 256),
            nn.LayerNorm(256),
            nn.GELU(),
            nn.Dropout(0.5),
            nn.Linear(256, 99),
        )

    def _create_branch(self):
        return nn.Sequential(
            nn.Unflatten(1, (1, 64)),
            nn.Conv1d(1, 128, kernel_size=3, padding=1),
            nn.BatchNorm1d(128),
            SELayer(128),
            nn.GELU(),
            nn.Dropout(0.3),
            nn.Conv1d(128, 256, kernel_size=3, padding=1),
            nn.BatchNorm1d(256),
            SELayer(256),
            nn.GELU(),
            nn.AdaptiveAvgPool1d(1),
            nn.Flatten(),
            nn.Linear(256, 128),
            nn.BatchNorm1d(128),
            nn.GELU(),
            nn.Dropout(0.3),
        )

    def forward(self, x):
        x1 = self.branch1(x[:, :64])
        x2 = self.branch2(x[:, 64:128])
        x3 = self.branch3(x[:, 128:192])

        combined = torch.cat([x1, x2, x3], dim=1)
        attn_scores = self.attn_layer(combined)
        attn_weights = self.sigmoid(attn_scores.view(-1, 3, 128))

        x1_attn = x1 * attn_weights[:, 0, :]
        x2_attn = x2 * attn_weights[:, 1, :]
        x3_attn = x3 * attn_weights[:, 2, :]

        x_combined = torch.cat([x1_attn, x2_attn, x3_attn], dim=1)
        return self.combined(x_combined)


def mixup_data(x, y, alpha=0.4):
    if alpha > 0:
        lam = np.random.beta(alpha, alpha)
    else:
        lam = 1

    batch_size = x.size()[0]
    index = torch.randperm(batch_size).to(x.device)

    mixed_x = lam * x + (1 - lam) * x[index, :]
    y_a, y_b = y, y[index]
    return mixed_x, y_a, y_b, lam


device = torch.device("cuda" if torch.cuda.is_available() else "cpu")
epochs = 200
batch_size = 32
n_splits = 5

skf = StratifiedKFold(n_splits=n_splits, shuffle=True, random_state=42)
test_probs = []
val_scores = []

for fold, (train_idx, val_idx) in enumerate(skf.split(X, y)):
    X_train, X_val = X[train_idx], X[val_idx]
    y_train, y_val = y[train_idx], y[val_idx]

    train_ds = TensorDataset(torch.FloatTensor(X_train), torch.LongTensor(y_train))
    train_loader = DataLoader(
        train_ds, batch_size=batch_size, shuffle=True, num_workers=4, pin_memory=True
    )

    model = ConvFeatureExtractor().to(device)
    optimizer = optim.AdamW(model.parameters(), lr=1e-3, weight_decay=1e-4)
    scheduler = optim.lr_scheduler.CosineAnnealingWarmRestarts(
        optimizer, T_0=20, eta_min=1e-5
    )
    criterion = nn.CrossEntropyLoss(label_smoothing=0.1)

    best_loss = np.inf
    patience = 0

    for epoch in range(epochs):
        model.train()
        for inputs, targets in train_loader:
            inputs, targets = inputs.to(device), targets.to(device)

            # Apply Mixup
            mixed_inputs, y_a, y_b, lam = mixup_data(inputs, targets)

            optimizer.zero_grad(set_to_none=True)
            outputs = model(mixed_inputs)
            loss = lam * criterion(outputs, y_a) + (1 - lam) * criterion(outputs, y_b)

            loss.backward()
            nn.utils.clip_grad_norm_(model.parameters(), 1.0)
            optimizer.step()

        model.eval()
        with torch.no_grad():
            val_inputs = torch.FloatTensor(X_val).to(device)
            val_outputs = model(val_inputs)
            val_loss = criterion(val_outputs, torch.LongTensor(y_val).to(device)).item()

        scheduler.step()
        if val_loss < best_loss:
            best_loss = val_loss
            patience = 0
            torch.save(model.state_dict(), f"working/best_fold{fold}.pt")
        else:
            patience += 1
            if patience >= 10:
                break

    model.load_state_dict(torch.load(f"working/best_fold{fold}.pt"))
    model.eval()

    with torch.no_grad():
        val_preds = (
            torch.softmax(model(torch.FloatTensor(X_val).to(device)), dim=1)
            .cpu()
            .numpy()
        )
        val_score = log_loss(y_val, val_preds)
        val_scores.append(val_score)
        print(f"Fold {fold} Val Log Loss: {val_score:.4f}")

        test_outputs = (
            torch.softmax(model(torch.FloatTensor(X_test).to(device)), dim=1)
            .cpu()
            .numpy()
        )
        test_probs.append(test_outputs)

final_probs = np.mean(test_probs, axis=0)
submission = pd.DataFrame(
    final_probs, columns=LabelEncoder().fit(train["species"]).classes_
)
submission.insert(0, "id", test["id"])
submission.to_csv("submission/submission.csv", index=False)

class LabelSmoothingCE(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, smoothing=0.1):
        super().__init__()
        self.confidence = 1.0 - smoothing
        self.smoothing = smoothing
        self.n_classes = 99

    def forward(self, pred, target):
        log_probs = torch.nn.functional.log_softmax(pred, dim=-1)
        with torch.no_grad():
            true_dist = torch.zeros_like(log_probs)
            true_dist.fill_(self.smoothing / (self.n_classes - 1))
            true_dist.scatter_(1, target.unsqueeze(1), self.confidence)
        return torch.mean(-torch.sum(true_dist * log_probs, dim=-1))

    def forward(self, x):

        shape = self.shape_net(base_features[:, 64:128])
        texture = self.texture_net(base_features[:, 128:192])
        img = self.img_net(img_features)
        combined = torch.cat([margin, shape, texture, img], dim=1)
        return self.classifier(combined)

class LabelSmoothingCrossEntropy(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, smoothing=0.1):
        super().__init__()
        self.smoothing = smoothing
        self.confidence = 1.0 - smoothing

    def forward(self, x, target):
        log_probs = torch.log_softmax(x, dim=-1)
        nll_loss = -log_probs.gather(dim=-1, index=target.unsqueeze(1))
        nll_loss = nll_loss.squeeze(1)
        smooth_loss = -log_probs.mean(dim=-1)
        loss = self.confidence * nll_loss + self.smoothing * smooth_loss
        return loss.mean()

class MultiModalClassifier(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, num_classes):
        super().__init__()
        # Tabular branches
        self.margin_net = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(64, 256),
            nn.BatchNorm1d(256),
            nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Dropout(0.3),
            nn.Linear(256, 128),
            nn.BatchNorm1d(128),
            nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Dropout(0.3),
        )
        self.shape_net = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(64, 256),
            nn.BatchNorm1d(256),
            nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Dropout(0.3),
            nn.Linear(256, 128),
            nn.BatchNorm1d(128),
            nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Dropout(0.3),
        )
        self.texture_net = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(64, 256),
            nn.BatchNorm1d(256),
            nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Dropout(0.3),
            nn.Linear(256, 128),
            nn.BatchNorm1d(128),
            nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Dropout(0.3),
        )

        # Image branch
        self.image_net = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Conv2d(1, 32, 3, padding=1),
            nn.BatchNorm2d(32),
            nn.ReLU(),
            nn.MaxPool2d(2),
            nn.Conv2d(32, 64, 3, padding=1),
            nn.BatchNorm2d(64),
            nn.ReLU(),
            nn.MaxPool2d(2),
            nn.Conv2d(64, 128, 3, padding=1),
            nn.BatchNorm2d(128),
            nn.ReLU(),
            nn.AdaptiveAvgPool2d(1),
            nn.Flatten(),
            nn.Linear(128, 128),
            nn.BatchNorm1d(128),
            nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Dropout(0.3),
        )

        # Attention-based fusion
        self.attention = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(128 * 4, 256), nn.ReLU(), nn.Linear(256, 4), nn.Softmax(dim=1)
        )
        self.classifier = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(128 * 4, 256),
            nn.BatchNorm1d(256),
            nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Dropout(0.5),
            nn.Linear(256, num_classes),
        )

    def forward(self, tabular, image):
        margin = self.margin_net(tabular[:, :64])
        shape = self.shape_net(tabular[:, 64:128])
        texture = self.texture_net(tabular[:, 128:192])
        img_feat = self.image_net(image)

        combined = torch.cat([margin, shape, texture, img_feat], dim=1)
        attn_weights = self.attention(combined)
        weighted = combined * attn_weights
        return self.classifier(weighted)

from sklearn.model_selection import StratifiedKFold

os.makedirs("submission", exist_ok=True)

# Data loading and preprocessing
train = pd.read_csv("input/train.csv")
test = pd.read_csv("input/test.csv")

margin = [f"margin{i}" for i in range(1, 65)]
shape = [f"shape{i}" for i in range(1, 65)]
texture = [f"texture{i}" for i in range(1, 65)]


def process_features(df):
    scaler = StandardScaler()
    return np.hstack(
        [
            scaler.fit_transform(df[margin]),
            scaler.fit_transform(df[shape]),
            scaler.fit_transform(df[texture]),
        ]
    )


X = process_features(train)
y = LabelEncoder().fit_transform(train["species"])
X_test = process_features(test)


class SELayer(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, channels, reduction=16):
        super().__init__()
        self.avg_pool = nn.AdaptiveAvgPool1d(1)
        self.fc = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(channels, channels // reduction),
            nn.GELU(),
            nn.Linear(channels // reduction, channels),
            nn.Sigmoid(),
        )

    def forward(self, x):
        b, c, _ = x.shape
        y = self.avg_pool(x).view(b, c)
        y = self.fc(y).view(b, c, 1)
        return x * y


class ConvFeatureExtractor(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__()
        self.branch1 = self._create_branch()
        self.branch2 = self._create_branch()
        self.branch3 = self._create_branch()

        # Multi-head attention instead of linear attention
        self.attn = nn.MultiheadAttention(
            embed_dim=128, num_heads=8, dropout=0.3, batch_first=True
        )
        self.attn_norm = nn.LayerNorm(128)
        self.ffn = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(128, 256), nn.GELU(), nn.Dropout(0.3), nn.Linear(256, 128)
        )
        self.ffn_norm = nn.LayerNorm(128)

        self.combined = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(384, 512),
            nn.BatchNorm1d(512),
            nn.GELU(),
            nn.Dropout(0.6),
            nn.Linear(512, 256),
            nn.LayerNorm(256),
            nn.GELU(),
            nn.Dropout(0.5),
            nn.Linear(256, 99),
        )

    def _create_branch(self):
        return nn.Sequential(
            nn.Unflatten(1, (1, 64)),
            nn.Conv1d(1, 128, kernel_size=3, padding=1),
            nn.BatchNorm1d(128),
            SELayer(128),
            nn.GELU(),
            nn.Dropout(0.3),
            nn.Conv1d(128, 256, kernel_size=3, padding=1),
            nn.BatchNorm1d(256),
            SELayer(256),
            nn.GELU(),
            nn.AdaptiveAvgPool1d(1),
            nn.Flatten(),
            nn.Linear(256, 128),
            nn.BatchNorm1d(128),
            nn.GELU(),
            nn.Dropout(0.3),
        )

    def forward(self, x):
        x1 = self.branch1(x[:, :64])
        x2 = self.branch2(x[:, 64:128])
        x3 = self.branch3(x[:, 128:192])

        # Stack branches as tokens and apply transformer attention
        tokens = torch.stack([x1, x2, x3], dim=1)  # [B, 3, 128]
        attn_out, _ = self.attn(tokens, tokens, tokens)
        attn_out = self.attn_norm(attn_out + tokens)

        ffn_out = self.ffn(attn_out)
        ffn_out = self.ffn_norm(ffn_out + attn_out)

        x_combined = ffn_out.view(ffn_out.size(0), -1)  # [B, 3*128]
        return self.combined(x_combined)


def mixup_data(x, y, alpha=0.4):
    if alpha > 0:
        lam = np.random.beta(alpha, alpha)
    else:
        lam = 1

    batch_size = x.size()[0]
    index = torch.randperm(batch_size).to(x.device)

    mixed_x = lam * x + (1 - lam) * x[index, :]
    y_a, y_b = y, y[index]
    return mixed_x, y_a, y_b, lam


device = torch.device("cuda" if torch.cuda.is_available() else "cpu")
epochs = 200
batch_size = 32
n_splits = 5

skf = StratifiedKFold(n_splits=n_splits, shuffle=True, random_state=42)
test_probs = []
val_scores = []

for fold, (train_idx, val_idx) in enumerate(skf.split(X, y)):
    X_train, X_val = X[train_idx], X[val_idx]
    y_train, y_val = y[train_idx], y[val_idx]

    train_ds = TensorDataset(torch.FloatTensor(X_train), torch.LongTensor(y_train))
    train_loader = DataLoader(
        train_ds, batch_size=batch_size, shuffle=True, num_workers=4, pin_memory=True
    )

    model = ConvFeatureExtractor().to(device)
    optimizer = optim.AdamW(model.parameters(), lr=1e-3, weight_decay=1e-4)
    scheduler = optim.lr_scheduler.CosineAnnealingWarmRestarts(
        optimizer, T_0=20, eta_min=1e-5
    )
    criterion = nn.CrossEntropyLoss(label_smoothing=0.1)

    best_loss = np.inf
    patience = 0

    for epoch in range(epochs):
        model.train()
        for inputs, targets in train_loader:
            inputs, targets = inputs.to(device), targets.to(device)

            mixed_inputs, y_a, y_b, lam = mixup_data(inputs, targets)

            optimizer.zero_grad(set_to_none=True)
            outputs = model(mixed_inputs)
            loss = lam * criterion(outputs, y_a) + (1 - lam) * criterion(outputs, y_b)

            loss.backward()
            nn.utils.clip_grad_norm_(model.parameters(), 1.0)
            optimizer.step()

        model.eval()
        with torch.no_grad():
            val_inputs = torch.FloatTensor(X_val).to(device)
            val_outputs = model(val_inputs)
            val_loss = criterion(val_outputs, torch.LongTensor(y_val).to(device)).item()

        scheduler.step()
        if val_loss < best_loss:
            best_loss = val_loss
            patience = 0
            torch.save(model.state_dict(), f"working/best_fold{fold}.pt")
        else:
            patience += 1
            if patience >= 10:
                break

    model.load_state_dict(torch.load(f"working/best_fold{fold}.pt"))
    model.eval()

    with torch.no_grad():
        val_preds = (
            torch.softmax(model(torch.FloatTensor(X_val).to(device)), dim=1)
            .cpu()
            .numpy()
        )

class LabelSmoothingCE(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, smoothing=0.1):
        super().__init__()
        self.confidence = 1.0 - smoothing
        self.smoothing = smoothing
        self.n_classes = 99

    def forward(self, pred, target):
        log_probs = torch.nn.functional.log_softmax(pred, dim=-1)
        with torch.no_grad():
            true_dist = torch.zeros_like(log_probs)
            true_dist.fill_(self.smoothing / (self.n_classes - 1))
            true_dist.scatter_(1, target.unsqueeze(1), self.confidence)
        return torch.mean(-torch.sum(true_dist * log_probs, dim=-1))

class LabelSmoothingCrossEntropy(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, smoothing=0.1):
        super().__init__()
        self.smoothing = smoothing
        self.confidence = 1.0 - smoothing

    def forward(self, x, target):
        log_probs = torch.log_softmax(x, dim=-1)
        nll_loss = -log_probs.gather(dim=-1, index=target.unsqueeze(1))
        nll_loss = nll_loss.squeeze(1)
        smooth_loss = -log_probs.mean(dim=-1)
        loss = self.confidence * nll_loss + self.smoothing * smooth_loss
        return loss.mean()

class MultiModalClassifier(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, num_classes):
        super().__init__()
        # Tabular branches
        self.margin_net = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(64, 256),
            nn.BatchNorm1d(256),
            nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Dropout(0.3),
            nn.Linear(256, 128),
            nn.BatchNorm1d(128),
            nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Dropout(0.3),
        )

        self.shape_net = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(64, 256),
            nn.BatchNorm1d(256),
            nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Dropout(0.3),
            nn.Linear(256, 128),
            nn.BatchNorm1d(128),
            nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Dropout(0.3),
        )

        self.texture_net = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(64, 256),
            nn.BatchNorm1d(256),
            nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Dropout(0.3),
            nn.Linear(256, 128),
            nn.BatchNorm1d(128),
            nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Dropout(0.3),
        )

        # Image branch
        self.image_net = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Conv2d(1, 32, 3, padding=1),
            nn.BatchNorm2d(32),
            nn.ReLU(),
            nn.MaxPool2d(2),
            nn.Conv2d(32, 64, 3, padding=1),
            nn.BatchNorm2d(64),
            nn.ReLU(),
            nn.MaxPool2d(2),
            nn.Conv2d(64, 128, 3, padding=1),
            nn.BatchNorm2d(128),
            nn.ReLU(),
            nn.AdaptiveAvgPool2d(1),
            nn.Flatten(),
            nn.Linear(128, 128),
            nn.BatchNorm1d(128),
            nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Dropout(0.3),
        )

        # Attention-based fusion (fixed dimensions)
        self.attention = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(512, 256), nn.ReLU(), nn.Linear(256, 4), nn.Softmax(dim=1)
        )

        self.classifier = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(512, 256),
            nn.BatchNorm1d(256),
            nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Dropout(0.5),
            nn.Linear(256, num_classes),
        )

    def forward(self, tabular, image):
        margin = self.margin_net(tabular[:, :64])
        shape = self.shape_net(tabular[:, 64:128])
        texture = self.texture_net(tabular[:, 128:192])
        img_feat = self.image_net(image)

        combined = torch.cat([margin, shape, texture, img_feat], dim=1)
        attn_weights = self.attention(combined)

        # Expand attention weights to match feature dimensions
        attn_weights_expanded = attn_weights.repeat_interleave(128, dim=1)
        weighted = combined * attn_weights_expanded

        return self.classifier(weighted)

        mixed_tab = lam * tab + (1 - lam) * tab[idx]
        mixed_img = lam * img + (1 - lam) * img[idx]
        y_a, y_b = y, y[idx]

        optimizer.zero_grad()
        outputs = model(mixed_tab, mixed_img)
        loss = lam * criterion(outputs, y_a) + (1 - lam) * criterion(outputs, y_b)
        loss.backward()
        optimizer.step()
        train_loss += loss.item()

    model.eval()
    val_loss, val_probs, val_true = 0, [], []

    else:
        epochs_no_improve += 1

            break

class ResidualBranch(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, input_dim, hidden_dim, dropout_rate=0.3):
        super().__init__()
        self.block = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(input_dim, hidden_dim),
            nn.BatchNorm1d(hidden_dim),
            nn.GELU(),
            nn.Dropout(dropout_rate),
            nn.Linear(hidden_dim, hidden_dim),
            nn.BatchNorm1d(hidden_dim),
        )
        self.shortcut = nn.Linear(input_dim, hidden_dim)
        self.dropout = nn.Dropout(p=dropout_rate)

    def forward(self, x):
        residual = self.shortcut(x)
        x = self.block(x) + residual
        return self.dropout(nn.functional.gelu(x))

class LabelSmoothingCE(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, smoothing=0.1):
        super().__init__()
        self.confidence = 1.0 - smoothing
        self.smoothing = smoothing
        self.n_classes = 99

    def forward(self, pred, target):
        log_probs = torch.nn.functional.log_softmax(pred, dim=-1)
        with torch.no_grad():
            true_dist = torch.zeros_like(log_probs)
            true_dist.fill_(self.smoothing / (self.n_classes - 1))
            true_dist.scatter_(1, target.unsqueeze(1), self.confidence)
        return torch.mean(-torch.sum(true_dist * log_probs, dim=-1))

        )

        )
        self.img_net = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(2048, 512),
            nn.BatchNorm1d(512),
            nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Dropout(0.5),
            nn.Linear(512, 256),
        )
        self.classifier = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(128 * 3 + 256, 512),
            nn.BatchNorm1d(512),
            nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Dropout(0.7),
            nn.Linear(512, 99),
        )

    def forward(self, x):
        base_features = x[:, :192]
        img_features = x[:, 192:]
        margin = self.margin_net(base_features[:, :64])
        shape = self.shape_net(base_features[:, 64:128])
        texture = self.texture_net(base_features[:, 128:192])
        img = self.img_net(img_features)
        combined = torch.cat([margin, shape, texture, img], dim=1)
        return self.classifier(combined)

import pandas as pd
from sklearn.model_selection import StratifiedKFold

from sklearn.metrics import log_loss
