# Load and preprocess data
train = pd.read_csv("input/train.csv")
test = pd.read_csv("input/test.csv")

margin = [f"margin{i}" for i in range(1, 65)]
shape = [f"shape{i}" for i in range(1, 65)]
texture = [f"texture{i}" for i in range(1, 65)]


def process_features(df):
    scaler = StandardScaler()
    return np.hstack(
        [
            scaler.fit_transform(df[margin]),
            scaler.fit_transform(df[shape]),
            scaler.fit_transform(df[texture]),
        ]
    )


X = process_features(train)
y = LabelEncoder().fit_transform(train["species"])
X_test = process_features(test)


class ResidualBranch(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, input_dim, hidden_dim, dropout_rate=0.3):
        super().__init__()
        self.block = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(input_dim, hidden_dim),
            nn.BatchNorm1d(hidden_dim),
            nn.GELU(),
            nn.AlphaDropout(dropout_rate),
            nn.Linear(hidden_dim, hidden_dim),
            nn.BatchNorm1d(hidden_dim),
        )
        self.shortcut = nn.Linear(input_dim, hidden_dim)
        self.dropout = nn.AlphaDropout(p=dropout_rate)

    def forward(self, x):
        residual = self.shortcut(x)
        x = self.block(x) + residual
        return self.dropout(nn.functional.gelu(x))


class LeafClassifier(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__()
        self.branch1 = ResidualBranch(64, 256)
        self.branch2 = ResidualBranch(64, 256)
        self.branch3 = ResidualBranch(64, 256)

        self.transformer = nn.TransformerEncoder(
            nn.TransformerEncoderLayer(
                d_model=256,
                nhead=8,
                dim_feedforward=1024,
                dropout=0.1,
                activation="gelu",
                batch_first=True,
            ),
            num_layers=2,
        )

        self.head = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(256 * 3, 512),
            nn.BatchNorm1d(512),
            nn.GELU(),
            nn.AlphaDropout(0.5),
            nn.Linear(512, 99),
        )

    def forward(self, x):
        x1 = self.branch1(x[:, :64])
        x2 = self.branch2(x[:, 64:128])
        x3 = self.branch3(x[:, 128:192])

        features = torch.stack([x1, x2, x3], dim=1)
        features = self.transformer(features)
        return self.head(features.flatten(1))


device = torch.device("cuda" if torch.cuda.is_available() else "cpu")
epochs = 300
batch_size = 32
n_splits = 5

skf = StratifiedKFold(n_splits=n_splits, shuffle=True, random_state=42)
test_probs = []
val_scores = []

for fold, (train_idx, val_idx) in enumerate(skf.split(X, y)):
    X_train, X_val = X[train_idx], X[val_idx]
    y_train, y_val = y[train_idx], y[val_idx]

    train_ds = TensorDataset(torch.FloatTensor(X_train), torch.LongTensor(y_train))
    train_loader = DataLoader(
        train_ds,
        batch_size=batch_size,
        shuffle=True,
        num_workers=4,
        pin_memory=True,
        drop_last=True,
    )

    model = LeafClassifier().to(device)
    optimizer = optim.AdamW(model.parameters(), lr=1e-3, weight_decay=1e-4)
    criterion = nn.CrossEntropyLoss()

    total_steps = epochs * len(train_loader)
    scheduler = optim.lr_scheduler.OneCycleLR(
        optimizer,
        max_lr=1e-3,
        total_steps=total_steps,
        pct_start=0.1,
        anneal_strategy="cos",
    )

    best_loss = np.inf
    patience = 0

    for epoch in range(epochs):
        model.train()
        for inputs, targets in train_loader:
            inputs, targets = inputs.to(device), targets.to(device)
            optimizer.zero_grad()
            outputs = model(inputs)
            loss = criterion(outputs, targets)
            loss.backward()
            optimizer.step()
            scheduler.step()

        model.eval()
        with torch.no_grad():
            val_inputs = torch.FloatTensor(X_val).to(device)
            val_outputs = model(val_inputs)
            val_loss = criterion(val_outputs, torch.LongTensor(y_val).to(device)).item()

        if val_loss < best_loss:
            best_loss = val_loss
            patience = 0
            torch.save(model.state_dict(), f"working/best_fold{fold}.pt")
        else:
            patience += 1
            if patience >= 15:
                break

    model.load_state_dict(torch.load(f"working/best_fold{fold}.pt"))
    model.eval()

    with torch.no_grad():
        val_preds = (
            torch.softmax(model(torch.FloatTensor(X_val).to(device)), 1).cpu().numpy()
        )
        val_score = log_loss(y_val, val_preds)
        val_scores.append(val_score)
        print(f"Fold {fold} Val Log Loss: {val_score:.4f}")

        test_outputs = (
            torch.softmax(model(torch.FloatTensor(X_test).to(device)), 1).cpu().numpy()
        )
        test_probs.append(test_outputs)

final_probs = np.mean(test_probs, axis=0)

class CrossAttention(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, embed_dim, num_heads):
        super().__init__()
        self.mha = nn.MultiheadAttention(embed_dim, num_heads, batch_first=True)
        self.norm = nn.LayerNorm(embed_dim)

    def forward(self, queries, keys_values):
        attn_output, _ = self.mha(queries, keys_values, keys_values)
        return self.norm(queries + attn_output)


class TabularEncoder(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, input_dim, hidden_dim=512, output_dim=512, dropout=0.2):
        super().__init__()
        self.block1 = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(input_dim, hidden_dim),
            nn.BatchNorm1d(hidden_dim),
            nn.GELU(),
            nn.Dropout(dropout),
        )
        self.block2 = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(hidden_dim, hidden_dim),
            nn.BatchNorm1d(hidden_dim),
            nn.GELU(),
            nn.Dropout(dropout),
        )
        self.residual = nn.Linear(input_dim, output_dim)
        self.output_proj = nn.Linear(hidden_dim, output_dim)

    def forward(self, x):
        identity = self.residual(x)
        x = self.block1(x)
        x = self.block2(x)
        x = self.output_proj(x)
        return x + identity


class LeafClassifier(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, num_classes):
        super().__init__()
        self.cnn = models.efficientnet_b3(pretrained=True)
        self.cnn.features[0][0] = nn.Conv2d(
            1, 40, kernel_size=3, stride=2, padding=1, bias=False
        )
        self.cnn.classifier = nn.Identity()
        self.img_proj = nn.Linear(1536, 512)

        self.tab_encoder = TabularEncoder(input_dim=192)
        self.tab_proj = nn.Identity()

        self.cross_attn1 = CrossAttention(512, 8)
        self.cross_attn2 = CrossAttention(512, 8)

        self.classifier = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(1024, 1024),
            nn.BatchNorm1d(1024),
            nn.GELU(),
            nn.Dropout(0.5),
            nn.Linear(1024, num_classes),
        )

    def forward(self, x_tab, x_img):
        img_feat = self.cnn(x_img)
        img_feat = self.img_proj(img_feat).unsqueeze(1)

        tab_feat = self.tab_encoder(x_tab).unsqueeze(1)
        tab_feat = self.tab_proj(tab_feat)

        img_attended = self.cross_attn1(img_feat, tab_feat)
        tab_attended = self.cross_attn2(tab_feat, img_feat)

        fused = torch.cat([img_attended.squeeze(1), tab_attended.squeeze(1)], dim=1)
        return self.classifier(fused)

    def forward(self, queries, keys_values):
        attn_output, _ = self.mha(queries, keys_values, keys_values)
        gate_input = torch.cat([queries, attn_output], dim=-1)
        gate = self.gate(gate_input)
        gated_output = gate * attn_output + (1 - gate) * queries
        return self.norm(gated_output)


class DepthwiseSeparableConv(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, in_channels, out_channels, kernel_size=3):
        super().__init__()
        self.depthwise = nn.Conv2d(
            in_channels,
            in_channels,
            kernel_size=kernel_size,
            padding=kernel_size // 2,
            groups=in_channels,
        )
        self.pointwise = nn.Conv2d(in_channels, out_channels, kernel_size=1)

    def forward(self, x):
        return self.pointwise(self.depthwise(x))


class EnhancedLeafClassifier(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, num_classes):
        super().__init__()
        # Image pathway
        self.cnn = models.efficientnet_b3(pretrained=True)
        self.cnn.features[0][0] = nn.Conv2d(
            1, 40, kernel_size=3, stride=2, padding=1, bias=False
        )
        self.cnn.classifier = nn.Identity()
        self.img_proj = nn.Sequential(
            DepthwiseSeparableConv(1536, 512), nn.AdaptiveAvgPool2d(1), nn.Flatten()
        )

        # Tabular pathway
        self.tab_encoder = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(192, 1024),
            nn.BatchNorm1d(1024),
            nn.GELU(),
            nn.Dropout(0.3),
            nn.Linear(1024, 512),
        )

        # Multi-level attention fusion
        self.cross_attn1 = GatedCrossAttention(512, 8)
        self.cross_attn2 = GatedCrossAttention(512, 8)
        self.final_attn = GatedCrossAttention(512, 8)

        # Classifier
        self.classifier = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(1024, 2048),
            nn.BatchNorm1d(2048),
            nn.GELU(),
            nn.Dropout(0.5),
            nn.Linear(2048, num_classes),
        )

    def forward(self, x_tab, x_img):
        # Image processing
        img_feat = self.cnn.features(x_img)
        img_feat = self.img_proj(img_feat).unsqueeze(1)

        # Tabular processing
        tab_feat = self.tab_encoder(x_tab).unsqueeze(1)

        # First attention stage
        img_att1 = self.cross_attn1(img_feat, tab_feat)
        tab_att1 = self.cross_attn1(tab_feat, img_feat)

        # Second attention stage with residual
        img_att2 = self.cross_attn2(img_att1, tab_att1) + img_att1
        tab_att2 = self.cross_attn2(tab_att1, img_att1) + tab_att1

        # Final attention fusion
        fused = self.final_attn(
            torch.cat([img_att2, tab_att2], dim=1),
            torch.cat([img_att2, tab_att2], dim=1),
        )
        fused = fused.mean(dim=1)

        return self.classifier(fused)


device = torch.device("cuda" if torch.cuda.is_available() else "cpu")
model = EnhancedLeafClassifier(len(le.classes_)).to(device)

import pandas as pd

train_df, val_df = train_test_split(
    train_df, test_size=0.2, stratify=train_df["species"], random_state=42
)

scaler = StandardScaler()
X_train_base = scaler.fit_transform(train_df[feature_cols].values)
X_val_base = scaler.transform(val_df[feature_cols].values)
X_test_base = scaler.transform(test_df[feature_cols].values)

# Encode labels
species_order = sample_sub.columns[1:].tolist()
le = LabelEncoder().fit(species_order)

y_val = le.transform(val_df["species"])

# Image transforms with augmentation
train_transform = transforms.Compose(
    [
        transforms.Resize((256, 256)),
        transforms.RandomCrop(224),
        transforms.RandomHorizontalFlip(),
        transforms.RandomRotation(20),
        transforms.ColorJitter(brightness=0.2, contrast=0.2),
        transforms.Grayscale(num_output_channels=3),
        transforms.ToTensor(),
        transforms.Normalize(mean=[0.485, 0.456, 0.406], std=[0.229, 0.224, 0.225]),
    ]
)

val_transform = transforms.Compose(
    [
        transforms.Resize((224, 224)),
        transforms.Grayscale(num_output_channels=3),
        transforms.ToTensor(),
        transforms.Normalize(mean=[0.485, 0.456, 0.406], std=[0.229, 0.224, 0.225]),

)


# Custom dataset
class LeafDataset(Dataset):
    def __init__(self, df, features, transform=None):
        self.df = df.reset_index(drop=True)
        self.features = features.astype(np.float32)
        self.transform = transform
        self.ids = df["id"].values
        self.has_labels = "species" in df.columns

    def __len__(self):
        return len(self.df)

    def __getitem__(self, idx):
        img_id = self.ids[idx]
        img = Image.open(f"input/images/{img_id}.jpg")
        features = torch.FloatTensor(self.features[idx])

        if self.transform:
            img = self.transform(img)

        if self.has_labels:
            label = le.transform([self.df.iloc[idx]["species"]])[0]
            return features, img, label
        return features, img


# Create datasets and loaders
train_dataset = LeafDataset(train_df, X_train_base, train_transform)

)

)
test_loader = DataLoader(
    test_dataset, batch_size=batch_size, shuffle=False, num_workers=4, pin_memory=True
)


# Model architecture
class LeafClassifier(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__()
        self.resnet = models.resnet18(pretrained=True)
        self.resnet.fc = nn.Identity()

        # Feature processors
        self.margin_net = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(64, 256), nn.BatchNorm1d(256), nn.GELU(), nn.Dropout(0.3)
        )
        self.shape_net = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(64, 256), nn.BatchNorm1d(256), nn.GELU(), nn.Dropout(0.3)
        )
        self.texture_net = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(64, 256), nn.BatchNorm1d(256), nn.GELU(), nn.Dropout(0.3)
        )

        # Classifier
        self.head = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(512 + 768, 1024),
            nn.BatchNorm1d(1024),
            nn.GELU(),
            nn.Dropout(0.5),
            nn.Linear(1024, 99),
        )

    def forward(self, x_feat, x_img):
        img_features = self.resnet(x_img)
        margin = self.margin_net(x_feat[:, :64])
        shape = self.shape_net(x_feat[:, 64:128])
        texture = self.texture_net(x_feat[:, 128:192])
        combined = torch.cat([img_features, margin, shape, texture], dim=1)
        return self.head(combined)


device = torch.device("cuda" if torch.cuda.is_available() else "cpu")
model = LeafClassifier().to(device)

# Optimizer with differential learning rates
optimizer = optim.AdamW(
    [
        {"params": model.resnet.parameters(), "lr": 1e-5},
        {"params": model.margin_net.parameters(), "lr": 3e-4},
        {"params": model.shape_net.parameters(), "lr": 3e-4},
        {"params": model.texture_net.parameters(), "lr": 3e-4},
        {"params": model.head.parameters(), "lr": 3e-4},
    ],
    weight_decay=1e-5,
)

criterion = nn.CrossEntropyLoss()
scheduler = optim.lr_scheduler.ReduceLROnPlateau(optimizer, "min", patience=2)

# Training loop
best_logloss = float("inf")
patience = 5
no_improve = 0

for epoch in range(50):
    model.train()
    for features, images, labels in train_loader:
        features, images, labels = (
            features.to(device),
            images.to(device),
            labels.to(device),
        )
        optimizer.zero_grad()
        outputs = model(features, images)
        loss = criterion(outputs, labels)
        loss.backward()
        torch.nn.utils.clip_grad_norm_(model.parameters(), 1.0)
        optimizer.step()

    # Validation
    model.eval()
    val_probs, val_true = [], []
    with torch.no_grad():
        for features, images, labels in val_loader:
            features, images = features.to(device), images.to(device)
            outputs = model(features, images)
            val_probs.append(torch.softmax(outputs, 1).cpu())
            val_true.append(labels)

    val_probs = torch.cat(val_probs).numpy()
    val_true = torch.cat(val_true).numpy()
    current_logloss = log_loss(val_true, val_probs, labels=np.arange(99))
    scheduler.step(current_logloss)

    print(f"Epoch {epoch+1}: Val LogLoss: {current_logloss:.4f}")

    # Early stopping
    if current_logloss < best_logloss:
        best_logloss = current_logloss
        no_improve = 0
        torch.save(model.state_dict(), "best_model.pth")
    else:
        no_improve += 1
        if no_improve >= patience:
            break

# Load best model
model.load_state_dict(torch.load("best_model.pth"))
model.eval()

# Generate test predictions
test_probs = []
with torch.no_grad():
    for features, images in test_loader:
        features, images = features.to(device), images.to(device)
        outputs = model(features, images)
        test_probs.append(torch.softmax(outputs, 1).cpu().numpy())

test_probs = np.concatenate(test_probs)

# Create submission
submission = sample_sub.copy()
submission.iloc[:, 1:] = test_probs
submission.to_csv("submission/submission.csv", index=False)

import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
from sklearn.model_selection import StratifiedKFold
from sklearn.preprocessing import LabelEncoder, StandardScaler
from sklearn.metrics import log_loss
import torch
import torch.nn as nn
import torch.optim as optim
from torch.utils.data import DataLoader, Dataset
import cv2
from PIL import Image
from torchvision import transforms

torch.manual_seed(42)
np.random.seed(42)

# Load and preprocess data
train = pd.read_csv("input/train.csv")
test = pd.read_csv("input/test.csv")

margin = [f"margin{i}" for i in range(1, 65)]
shape = [f"shape{i}" for i in range(1, 65)]
texture = [f"texture{i}" for i in range(1, 65)]


def process_features(train_df, test_df):
    margin_scaler = StandardScaler().fit(train_df[margin])
    shape_scaler = StandardScaler().fit(train_df[shape])
    texture_scaler = StandardScaler().fit(train_df[texture])

    train_processed = np.hstack(
        [
            margin_scaler.transform(train_df[margin]),
            shape_scaler.transform(train_df[shape]),
            texture_scaler.transform(train_df[texture]),
        ]
    )

    test_processed = np.hstack(
        [
            margin_scaler.transform(test_df[margin]),
            shape_scaler.transform(test_df[shape]),
            texture_scaler.transform(test_df[texture]),
        ]
    )

    return train_processed, test_processed


X, X_test = process_features(train, test)
y = LabelEncoder().fit_transform(train["species"])


# Image processing
def load_images(df):
    images = []
    for id in df["id"]:
        img = cv2.imread(f"input/images/{id}.jpg", cv2.IMREAD_GRAYSCALE)
        img = cv2.resize(img, (64, 64))
        images.append(img)
    return np.array(images)


train_images = load_images(train)
test_images = load_images(test)

# Data augmentation
train_transform = transforms.Compose(
    [
        transforms.ToPILImage(),
        transforms.RandomHorizontalFlip(),
        transforms.RandomVerticalFlip(),
        transforms.RandomRotation(30),
        transforms.ToTensor(),
        transforms.Normalize([0.5], [0.5]),
    ]
)

val_transform = transforms.Compose(
    [transforms.ToPILImage(), transforms.ToTensor(), transforms.Normalize([0.5], [0.5])]
)


class LeafDataset(Dataset):
    def __init__(self, features, images, labels=None, transform=None):
        self.features = features.astype(np.float32)
        self.images = images
        self.labels = labels
        self.transform = transform

    def __len__(self):
        return len(self.features)

    def __getitem__(self, idx):
        img = self.images[idx]
        if self.transform:
            img = self.transform(img)
        else:
            img = torch.tensor(img, dtype=torch.float32).unsqueeze(0) / 255.0

        if self.labels is not None:
            return self.features[idx], img, self.labels[idx]
        return self.features[idx], img


# Model architecture
class ResidualBranch(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, in_dim, hidden_dim):
        super().__init__()
        self.block = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(in_dim, hidden_dim),
            nn.BatchNorm1d(hidden_dim),
            nn.GELU(),
            nn.AlphaDropout(0.3),
            nn.Linear(hidden_dim, hidden_dim),
            nn.BatchNorm1d(hidden_dim),
        )
        self.shortcut = nn.Linear(in_dim, hidden_dim)
        self.dropout = nn.AlphaDropout(0.3)

    def forward(self, x):
        return self.dropout(nn.functional.gelu(self.block(x) + self.shortcut(x)))


class LeafClassifier(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__()
        self.branches = nn.ModuleList([ResidualBranch(64, 256) for _ in range(3)])

        self.cnn = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Conv2d(1, 32, 3, padding=1),
            nn.BatchNorm2d(32),
            nn.GELU(),
            nn.MaxPool2d(2),
            nn.Conv2d(32, 64, 3, padding=1),
            nn.BatchNorm2d(64),
            nn.GELU(),
            nn.AdaptiveAvgPool2d(1),
            nn.Flatten(),
            nn.Linear(64, 256),
            nn.GELU(),
            nn.AlphaDropout(0.3),
        )

        self.transformer = nn.TransformerEncoder(
            nn.TransformerEncoderLayer(
                d_model=256,
                nhead=8,
                dim_feedforward=1024,
                dropout=0.1,
                activation="gelu",
                batch_first=True,
            ),
            num_layers=2,
        )

        self.head = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(256 * 4, 512),
            nn.BatchNorm1d(512),
            nn.GELU(),
            nn.AlphaDropout(0.5),
            nn.Linear(512, 99),
        )

    def forward(self, x_tab, x_img):
        features = [
            branch(x_tab[:, i * 64 : (i + 1) * 64])
            for i, branch in enumerate(self.branches)
        ]
        img_feat = self.cnn(x_img)
        combined = torch.stack(features + [img_feat], dim=1)
        return self.head(self.transformer(combined).flatten(1))


device = torch.device("cuda" if torch.cuda.is_available() else "cpu")
n_splits = 5
skf = StratifiedKFold(n_splits=n_splits, shuffle=True, random_state=42)
test_probs = []
val_scores = []

for fold, (train_idx, val_idx) in enumerate(skf.split(X, y)):
    X_train, X_val = X[train_idx], X[val_idx]
    y_train, y_val = y[train_idx], y[val_idx]
    img_train, img_val = train_images[train_idx], train_images[val_idx]

    train_ds = LeafDataset(X_train, img_train, y_train, train_transform)
    val_ds = LeafDataset(X_val, img_val, y_val, val_transform)
    test_ds = LeafDataset(X_test, test_images, transform=val_transform)

    model = LeafClassifier().to(device)
    optimizer = optim.AdamW(model.parameters(), lr=1e-3, weight_decay=1e-4)
    criterion = nn.CrossEntropyLoss()
    scheduler = optim.lr_scheduler.OneCycleLR(
        optimizer,
        max_lr=1e-3,
        total_steps=300 * len(DataLoader(train_ds, batch_size=32)),
        pct_start=0.1,
    )

    best_loss = np.inf
    for epoch in range(300):
        model.train()
        for tab, img, y_batch in DataLoader(train_ds, batch_size=32, shuffle=True):
            tab, img, y_batch = tab.to(device), img.to(device), y_batch.to(device)
            optimizer.zero_grad()
            loss = criterion(model(tab, img), y_batch)
            loss.backward()
            optimizer.step()
            scheduler.step()

        model.eval()
        val_loss = 0
        with torch.no_grad():
            for tab, img, y_batch in DataLoader(val_ds, batch_size=64):
                tab, img, y_batch = tab.to(device), img.to(device), y_batch.to(device)
                val_loss += criterion(model(tab, img), y_batch).item() * len(y_batch)
        val_loss /= len(val_ds)

        if val_loss < best_loss:
            best_loss = val_loss
            torch.save(model.state_dict(), f"working/best_fold{fold}.pt")
        else:
            if epoch > 50:
                break

    model.load_state_dict(torch.load(f"working/best_fold{fold}.pt"))
    model.eval()

    with torch.no_grad():
        val_preds = torch.cat(
            [
                model(tab.to(device), img.to(device))
                for tab, img, _ in DataLoader(val_ds, batch_size=64)
            ]
        )
        val_score = log_loss(y_val, torch.softmax(val_preds, 1).cpu().numpy())
        val_scores.append(val_score)

        test_preds = torch.cat(
            [
                model(tab.to(device), img.to(device))
                for tab, img in DataLoader(test_ds, batch_size=64)
            ]
        )
        test_probs.append(torch.softmax(test_preds, 1).cpu().numpy())

final_probs = np.mean(test_probs, axis=0)
submission = pd.DataFrame(
    final_probs, columns=LabelEncoder().fit(train["species"]).classes_
)
submission.insert(0, "id", test["id"])
submission.to_csv("submission/submission.csv", index=False)

print(f"Validation Log Loss: {np.mean(val_scores):.4f} ± {np.std(val_scores):.4f}")

class ResidualBranch(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, in_dim, hidden_dim):
        super().__init__()
        self.block = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(in_dim, hidden_dim),
            nn.BatchNorm1d(hidden_dim),
            nn.GELU(),
            nn.AlphaDropout(0.3),
            nn.Linear(hidden_dim, hidden_dim),
            nn.BatchNorm1d(hidden_dim),
        )
        self.shortcut = nn.Linear(in_dim, hidden_dim)
        self.dropout = nn.AlphaDropout(0.3)

    def forward(self, x):
        return self.dropout(nn.functional.gelu(self.block(x) + self.shortcut(x)))

            nn.Linear(64, 256),
            nn.GELU(),
            nn.AlphaDropout(0.3),
        )

        self.transformer = nn.TransformerEncoder(
            nn.TransformerEncoderLayer(
                d_model=256,
                nhead=8,
                dim_feedforward=1024,
                dropout=0.1,
                activation="gelu",
                batch_first=True,
            ),
            num_layers=2,
        )

        self.head = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(256 * 4, 512),
            nn.BatchNorm1d(512),
            nn.GELU(),
            nn.AlphaDropout(0.5),
            nn.Linear(512, 99),
        )

    def forward(self, x_tab, x_img):
        features = [
            branch(x_tab[:, i * 64 : (i + 1) * 64])
            for i, branch in enumerate(self.branches)
        ]
        img_feat = self.cnn(x_img)
        combined = torch.stack(features + [img_feat], dim=1)
        return self.head(self.transformer(combined).flatten(1))


device = torch.device("cuda" if torch.cuda.is_available() else "cpu")
n_splits = 5
skf = StratifiedKFold(n_splits=n_splits, shuffle=True, random_state=42)
test_probs = []
val_scores = []

for fold, (train_idx, val_idx) in enumerate(skf.split(train, y)):
    train_fold = train.iloc[train_idx]
    val_fold = train.iloc[val_idx]

    # Feature scaling per fold
    margin_scaler = StandardScaler().fit(train_fold[margin])

    texture_scaler = StandardScaler().fit(train_fold[texture])

    X_train = np.hstack(
        [
            margin_scaler.transform(train_fold[margin]),
            shape_scaler.transform(train_fold[shape]),
            texture_scaler.transform(train_fold[texture]),
        ]
    )
    X_val = np.hstack(
        [
            margin_scaler.transform(val_fold[margin]),
            shape_scaler.transform(val_fold[shape]),
            texture_scaler.transform(val_fold[texture]),
        ]
    )
    X_test_fold = np.hstack(
        [
            margin_scaler.transform(test[margin]),
            shape_scaler.transform(test[shape]),
            texture_scaler.transform(test[texture]),
        ]
    )

    # Create datasets
    train_ds = LeafDataset(
        X_train, train_images[train_idx], y[train_idx], train_transform
    )
    val_ds = LeafDataset(X_val, train_images[val_idx], y[val_idx], val_transform)
    test_ds = LeafDataset(X_test_fold, test_images, transform=val_transform)

    model = LeafClassifier().to(device)
    optimizer = optim.AdamW(model.parameters(), lr=1e-3, weight_decay=1e-4)
    criterion = nn.CrossEntropyLoss()
    scheduler = optim.lr_scheduler.OneCycleLR(
        optimizer,
        max_lr=1e-3,
        total_steps=300 * len(DataLoader(train_ds, batch_size=32)),
        pct_start=0.1,
    )

    best_loss = np.inf
    for epoch in range(300):
        model.train()
        for tab, img, y_batch in DataLoader(train_ds, batch_size=32, shuffle=True):
            tab, img, y_batch = tab.to(device), img.to(device), y_batch.to(device)
            optimizer.zero_grad()
            loss = criterion(model(tab, img), y_batch)
            loss.backward()
            optimizer.step()
            scheduler.step()

        model.eval()
        val_loss = 0
        with torch.no_grad():
            for tab, img, y_batch in DataLoader(val_ds, batch_size=64):
                tab, img, y_batch = tab.to(device), img.to(device), y_batch.to(device)
                val_loss += criterion(model(tab, img), y_batch).item() * len(y_batch)
        val_loss /= len(val_ds)

        if val_loss < best_loss:
            best_loss = val_loss
            torch.save(model.state_dict(), f"working/best_fold{fold}.pt")
        else:
            if epoch > 50:
                break

    model.load_state_dict(torch.load(f"working/best_fold{fold}.pt"))
    model.eval()

    with torch.no_grad():
        val_preds = torch.cat(
            [
                model(tab.to(device), img.to(device))
                for tab, img, _ in DataLoader(val_ds, batch_size=64)
            ]
        )
        val_score = log_loss(y[val_idx], torch.softmax(val_preds, 1).cpu().numpy())
        val_scores.append(val_score)

        test_preds = torch.cat(
            [
                model(tab.to(device), img.to(device))
                for tab, img in DataLoader(test_ds, batch_size=64)
            ]
        )
        test_probs.append(torch.softmax(test_preds, 1).cpu().numpy())

final_probs = np.mean(test_probs, axis=0)

)

submission.to_csv("submission/submission.csv", index=False)

class LeafClassifier(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, input_size, num_classes):
        super().__init__()
        self.margin_proj = nn.Linear(16, 256)
        self.shape_proj = nn.Linear(16, 256)
        self.texture_proj = nn.Linear(16, 256)
        self.pos_embed = nn.Parameter(torch.randn(12, 256))

        self.transformer_layers = nn.ModuleList(
            [
                nn.TransformerEncoderLayer(
                    d_model=256,
                    nhead=8,
                    dim_feedforward=1024,
                    dropout=0.2,
                    activation="gelu",
                    batch_first=False,
                )
                for _ in range(3)
            ]
        )
        self.stochastic_depth_prob = 0.2

        self.final_proj = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(3072, 512),
            nn.GELU(),
            nn.LayerNorm(512),
            nn.Dropout(0.5),
            nn.Linear(512, num_classes),
        )

    def forward(self, x):
        # Split features into 16-dim segments
        margin = x[:, :64].view(-1, 4, 16)
        shape = x[:, 64:128].view(-1, 4, 16)
        texture = x[:, 128:192].view(-1, 4, 16)

        # Project each segment
        margin_tokens = self.margin_proj(margin)
        shape_tokens = self.shape_proj(shape)
        texture_tokens = self.texture_proj(texture)

        # Combine tokens and add positional embeddings
        tokens = torch.cat([margin_tokens, shape_tokens, texture_tokens], dim=1)
        tokens += self.pos_embed.unsqueeze(0)

        # Transformer processing
        tokens = tokens.permute(1, 0, 2)  # [seq_len, batch, dim]
        for layer in self.transformer_layers:
            if self.training and (torch.rand(1).item() < self.stochastic_depth_prob):
                continue
            tokens = layer(tokens)

        # Aggregate features
        tokens = tokens.permute(1, 0, 2).flatten(1)
        return self.final_proj(tokens)

class LeafDataset(Dataset):
    def __init__(self, df, features, transform=None):
        self.df = df.reset_index(drop=True)
        self.features = features.astype(np.float32)
        self.transform = transform
        self.ids = df["id"].values
        self.has_labels = "species" in df.columns

    def __len__(self):
        return len(self.df)

    def __getitem__(self, idx):
        img_id = self.ids[idx]
        img = Image.open(f"input/images/{img_id}.jpg")
        features = torch.FloatTensor(self.features[idx])

        if self.transform:
            img = self.transform(img)

        if self.has_labels:
            label = le.transform([self.df.iloc[idx]["species"]])[0]
            return features, img, label
        return features, img


class TTADataset(Dataset):
    def __init__(self, df, features, transform=None, tta_num=7):
        self.df = df.reset_index(drop=True)
        self.features = features.astype(np.float32)
        self.transform = transform
        self.ids = df["id"].values
        self.tta_num = tta_num

    def __len__(self):
        return len(self.df) * self.tta_num

    def __getitem__(self, idx):
        original_idx = idx // self.tta_num
        img_id = self.ids[original_idx]
        img = Image.open(f"input/images/{img_id}.jpg")
        features = torch.FloatTensor(self.features[original_idx])

        if self.transform:
            img = self.transform(img)

        return features, img

class LeafClassifier(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__()
        self.resnet = models.resnet50(pretrained=True)
        self.resnet.fc = nn.Identity()

        # Enhanced feature processing
        self.margin_net = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(64, 512), nn.BatchNorm1d(512), nn.GELU(), nn.Dropout(0.4)
        )
        self.shape_net = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(64, 512), nn.BatchNorm1d(512), nn.GELU(), nn.Dropout(0.4)
        )
        self.texture_net = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(64, 512), nn.BatchNorm1d(512), nn.GELU(), nn.Dropout(0.4)
        )

        # Attention-based fusion
        self.attention = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(2048 + 512 * 3, 512),
            nn.GELU(),
            nn.Linear(512, 3),
            nn.Softmax(dim=1),
        )

        # Modified head
        self.head = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(2048 + 512 * 3, 2048),
            nn.BatchNorm1d(2048),
            nn.GELU(),
            nn.Dropout(0.5),
            nn.Linear(2048, 99),
        )

    def forward(self, x_feat, x_img):
        img_features = self.resnet(x_img)
        margin = self.margin_net(x_feat[:, :64])
        shape = self.shape_net(x_feat[:, 64:128])
        texture = self.texture_net(x_feat[:, 128:192])

        # Concatenate features with attention weights
        combined = torch.cat([img_features, margin, shape, texture], dim=1)
        attn_weights = self.attention(combined)
        weighted_combined = (
            img_features * attn_weights[:, 0].unsqueeze(1)
            + margin * attn_weights[:, 1].unsqueeze(1)
            + shape * attn_weights[:, 2].unsqueeze(1)
            + texture * attn_weights[:, 3].unsqueeze(1)
        )

        return self.head(weighted_combined)

    current_logloss = log_loss(val_true, val_probs, labels=np.arange(99))

    print(

    if current_logloss < best_logloss:

class CrossFeatureAttention(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, embed_dim, num_heads):
        super().__init__()
        self.self_attn = nn.MultiheadAttention(embed_dim, num_heads, batch_first=True)
        self.cross_attn = nn.MultiheadAttention(embed_dim, num_heads, batch_first=True)
        self.norm1 = nn.LayerNorm(embed_dim)
        self.norm2 = nn.LayerNorm(embed_dim)
        self.dropout = nn.Dropout(0.1)

    def forward(self, query, key_value):
        # Self-attention within query features
        self_attn_out, _ = self.self_attn(query, query, query)
        query = self.norm1(query + self.dropout(self_attn_out))

        # Cross-attention with other features
        cross_attn_out, _ = self.cross_attn(query, key_value, key_value)
        return self.norm2(query + self.dropout(cross_attn_out))


class LeafClassifier(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, input_size, num_classes):
        super().__init__()
        # Feature projections
        self.margin_proj = nn.Sequential(

        )

        )
        self.texture_proj = nn.Sequential(

        )

        # Feature-specific transformers
        self.margin_transformer = nn.TransformerEncoder(
            nn.TransformerEncoderLayer(
                256, 8, 1024, dropout=0.1, activation="gelu", batch_first=True
            ),
            num_layers=2,
        )
        self.shape_transformer = nn.TransformerEncoder(
            nn.TransformerEncoderLayer(
                256, 8, 1024, dropout=0.1, activation="gelu", batch_first=True
            ),
            num_layers=2,
        )
        self.texture_transformer = nn.TransformerEncoder(
            nn.TransformerEncoderLayer(
                256, 8, 1024, dropout=0.1, activation="gelu", batch_first=True
            ),
            num_layers=2,
        )

        # Cross-feature attention modules
        self.margin_cross = CrossFeatureAttention(256, 8)
        self.shape_cross = CrossFeatureAttention(256, 8)
        self.texture_cross = CrossFeatureAttention(256, 8)

        # Final classifier
        self.final = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(256 * 3, 512),
            nn.GELU(),
            nn.Dropout(0.5),
            nn.LayerNorm(512),
            nn.Linear(512, num_classes),
        )

    def forward(self, x):
        # Split and project features
        margin = self.margin_proj(x[:, :64])
        shape = self.shape_proj(x[:, 64:128])
        texture = self.texture_proj(x[:, 128:192])

        # Process through feature-specific transformers
        margin = self.margin_transformer(margin.unsqueeze(1))
        shape = self.shape_transformer(shape.unsqueeze(1))
        texture = self.texture_transformer(texture.unsqueeze(1))

        # Cross-feature attention
        margin = self.margin_cross(margin, torch.cat([shape, texture], dim=1))
        shape = self.shape_cross(shape, torch.cat([margin, texture], dim=1))
        texture = self.texture_cross(texture, torch.cat([margin, shape], dim=1))

        # Aggregate features
        features = torch.cat(
            [margin.mean(dim=1), shape.mean(dim=1), texture.mean(dim=1)], dim=1
        )

        return self.final(features)


# Training setup
device = torch.device("cuda" if torch.cuda.is_available() else "cpu")
model = LeafClassifier(X.shape[1], len(le.classes_)).to(device)
optimizer = optim.AdamW(model.parameters(), lr=2e-4, weight_decay=0.1)

        loss = criterion(outputs, y_batch)
        loss.backward()

        optimizer.step()
        scheduler.step()
        train_loss += loss.item() * X_batch.size(0)

    model.eval()

    with torch.no_grad():

            val_probs.append(torch.softmax(outputs, 1).cpu())
            val_true.append(y_batch.cpu())

    # Calculate metrics
    train_loss /= len(train_loader.dataset)
    val_loss /= len(val_loader.dataset)
    val_probs = torch.cat(val_probs).numpy()
    val_true = torch.cat(val_true).numpy()

    )

    # Early stopping
    if current_logloss < best_loss:
        best_loss = current_logloss
        epochs_no_improve = 0

import pandas as pd

class LeafDataset(Dataset):
    def __init__(self, df, features, transform=None):
        self.df = df.reset_index(drop=True)
        self.features = features.astype(np.float32)
        self.transform = transform
        self.ids = df["id"].values
        self.has_labels = "species" in df.columns

    def __len__(self):
        return len(self.df)

    def __getitem__(self, idx):
        img_id = self.ids[idx]
        img = Image.open(f"input/images/{img_id}.jpg")
        features = torch.FloatTensor(self.features[idx])

        if self.transform:
            img = self.transform(img)

        if self.has_labels:
            label = le.transform([self.df.iloc[idx]["species"]])[0]
            return features, img, label
        return features, img


class LeafClassifier(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__()
        self.resnet = models.resnet50(pretrained=True)
        self.resnet.fc = nn.Identity()

        # Project ResNet features to 512D
        self.img_proj = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(2048, 512), nn.BatchNorm1d(512), nn.GELU(), nn.Dropout(0.3)
        )

        # Feature processors
        self.margin_net = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(64, 512), nn.BatchNorm1d(512), nn.GELU(), nn.Dropout(0.3)
        )
        self.shape_net = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(64, 512), nn.BatchNorm1d(512), nn.GELU(), nn.Dropout(0.3)
        )
        self.texture_net = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(64, 512), nn.BatchNorm1d(512), nn.GELU(), nn.Dropout(0.3)
        )

        # Attention mechanism for 4 components
        self.attention = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(512 * 4, 256), nn.GELU(), nn.Linear(256, 4), nn.Softmax(dim=1)
        )

        # Classifier head
        self.head = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(512, 256),
            nn.BatchNorm1d(256),
            nn.GELU(),
            nn.Dropout(0.4),
            nn.Linear(256, 99),
        )

    def forward(self, x_feat, x_img):
        # Process image
        img_features = self.resnet(x_img)
        img_proj = self.img_proj(img_features)

        # Process tabular features
        margin = self.margin_net(x_feat[:, :64])
        shape = self.shape_net(x_feat[:, 64:128])
        texture = self.texture_net(x_feat[:, 128:192])

        # Concatenate all features
        combined = torch.cat([img_proj, margin, shape, texture], dim=1)

        # Compute attention weights
        attn_weights = self.attention(combined)

        # Weighted sum of features
        weighted = (
            img_proj * attn_weights[:, 0].unsqueeze(1)
            + margin * attn_weights[:, 1].unsqueeze(1)
            + shape * attn_weights[:, 2].unsqueeze(1)
            + texture * attn_weights[:, 3].unsqueeze(1)
        )

        return self.head(weighted)


device = torch.device("cuda" if torch.cuda.is_available() else "cpu")

    # Early stopping

        no_improve = 0

def load_images(df):

val_transform = transforms.Compose(

)


class LeafDataset(Dataset):
    def __init__(self, features, images, labels=None, transform=None):
        self.features = features.astype(np.float32)
        self.images = images
        self.labels = labels
        self.transform = transform

    def __len__(self):
        return len(self.features)

    def __getitem__(self, idx):
        img = self.images[idx]
        if self.transform:
            img = self.transform(img)
        else:
            img = torch.tensor(img, dtype=torch.float32).unsqueeze(0) / 255.0
        if self.labels is not None:
            return self.features[idx], img, self.labels[idx]
        return self.features[idx], img


class ResidualBranch(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, in_dim, hidden_dim):
        super().__init__()
        self.block = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(in_dim, hidden_dim),
            nn.BatchNorm1d(hidden_dim),
            nn.GELU(),
            nn.AlphaDropout(0.3),
            nn.Linear(hidden_dim, hidden_dim),
            nn.BatchNorm1d(hidden_dim),
        )
        self.shortcut = nn.Linear(in_dim, hidden_dim)
        self.dropout = nn.AlphaDropout(0.3)

    def forward(self, x):
        return self.dropout(nn.functional.gelu(self.block(x) + self.shortcut(x)))


class LeafClassifier(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__()
        self.branches = nn.ModuleList([ResidualBranch(64, 256) for _ in range(3)])
        self.cnn = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Conv2d(1, 32, 3, padding=1),
            nn.BatchNorm2d(32),
            nn.GELU(),
            nn.MaxPool2d(2),
            nn.Conv2d(32, 64, 3, padding=1),
            nn.BatchNorm2d(64),
            nn.GELU(),
            nn.AdaptiveAvgPool2d(1),
            nn.Flatten(),
            nn.Linear(64, 256),
            nn.GELU(),
            nn.AlphaDropout(0.3),
        )
        self.transformer = nn.TransformerEncoder(
            nn.TransformerEncoderLayer(
                d_model=256,
                nhead=8,
                dim_feedforward=1024,
                dropout=0.1,
                activation="gelu",
                batch_first=True,
            ),
            num_layers=2,
        )
        self.head = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(256 * 4, 512),
            nn.BatchNorm1d(512),
            nn.GELU(),
            nn.AlphaDropout(0.5),
            nn.Linear(512, 99),
        )

    def forward(self, x_tab, x_img):
        features = [
            branch(x_tab[:, i * 64 : (i + 1) * 64])
            for i, branch in enumerate(self.branches)
        ]
        img_feat = self.cnn(x_img)
        combined = torch.stack(features + [img_feat], dim=1)
        return self.head(self.transformer(combined).flatten(1))


device = torch.device("cuda" if torch.cuda.is_available() else "cpu")

    X_val = np.hstack(
        [

        ]
    )

    )

    train_ds = LeafDataset(

    )

    test_ds = LeafDataset(X_test_fold, test_images, transform=val_transform)

    model = LeafClassifier().to(device)
    optimizer = optim.AdamW(model.parameters(), lr=1e-3, weight_decay=1e-4)
    criterion = nn.CrossEntropyLoss()
    scheduler = optim.lr_scheduler.OneCycleLR(

            nn.Linear(64, 256), nn.BatchNorm1d(256), nn.SiLU(), nn.Dropout(0.3)
        )
        self.branch2 = nn.Sequential(

            nn.BatchNorm1d(512),

        attn_out, _ = self.attention(branches, branches, branches)
        combined = attn_out.flatten(start_dim=1)

class CrossFeatureAttention(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, embed_dim, num_heads):
        super().__init__()
        self.self_attn = nn.MultiheadAttention(embed_dim, num_heads, batch_first=True)
        self.cross_attn = nn.MultiheadAttention(embed_dim, num_heads, batch_first=True)
        self.norm1 = nn.LayerNorm(embed_dim)
        self.norm2 = nn.LayerNorm(embed_dim)
        self.dropout = nn.Dropout(0.1)

    def forward(self, query, key_value):
        # Self-attention within query features
        self_attn_out, _ = self.self_attn(query, query, query)
        query = self.norm1(query + self.dropout(self_attn_out))

        # Cross-attention with other features
        cross_attn_out, _ = self.cross_attn(query, key_value, key_value)
        return self.norm2(query + self.dropout(cross_attn_out))


class AttentionPooling(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, embed_dim):
        super().__init__()
        self.attn = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(embed_dim, 128), nn.GELU(), nn.Linear(128, 1)
        )

    def forward(self, x):
        attn_weights = torch.softmax(self.attn(x), dim=1)
        return torch.sum(attn_weights * x, dim=1)


class LeafClassifier(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, num_classes):
        super().__init__()
        # Feature projections (process each attribute individually)
        self.margin_proj = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(1, 256), nn.GELU(), nn.LayerNorm(256)
        )
        self.shape_proj = nn.Sequential(nn.Linear(1, 256), nn.GELU(), nn.LayerNorm(256))
        self.texture_proj = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(1, 256), nn.GELU(), nn.LayerNorm(256)
        )

        # Feature-specific transformers
        self.margin_transformer = nn.TransformerEncoder(
            nn.TransformerEncoderLayer(
                256, 8, 1024, dropout=0.1, activation="gelu", batch_first=True
            ),
            num_layers=2,
        )
        self.shape_transformer = nn.TransformerEncoder(
            nn.TransformerEncoderLayer(
                256, 8, 1024, dropout=0.1, activation="gelu", batch_first=True
            ),
            num_layers=2,
        )
        self.texture_transformer = nn.TransformerEncoder(
            nn.TransformerEncoderLayer(
                256, 8, 1024, dropout=0.1, activation="gelu", batch_first=True
            ),
            num_layers=2,
        )

        # Cross-feature attention modules
        self.margin_cross = CrossFeatureAttention(256, 8)
        self.shape_cross = CrossFeatureAttention(256, 8)
        self.texture_cross = CrossFeatureAttention(256, 8)

        # Attention pooling
        self.margin_pool = AttentionPooling(256)
        self.shape_pool = AttentionPooling(256)
        self.texture_pool = AttentionPooling(256)

        # Final classifier
        self.final = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(256 * 3, 512),
            nn.GELU(),
            nn.Dropout(0.5),
            nn.LayerNorm(512),
            nn.Linear(512, num_classes),
        )

    def forward(self, x):
        # Process margin features (batch_size, 64) -> (batch_size, 64, 256)
        margin = x[:, :64].unsqueeze(-1)  # Add channel dim
        margin = self.margin_proj(margin)
        margin = self.margin_transformer(margin)

        # Process shape features
        shape = x[:, 64:128].unsqueeze(-1)
        shape = self.shape_proj(shape)
        shape = self.shape_transformer(shape)

        # Process texture features
        texture = x[:, 128:192].unsqueeze(-1)
        texture = self.texture_proj(texture)
        texture = self.texture_transformer(texture)

        # Cross-feature attention
        margin = self.margin_cross(margin, torch.cat([shape, texture], dim=1))
        shape = self.shape_cross(shape, torch.cat([margin, texture], dim=1))
        texture = self.texture_cross(texture, torch.cat([margin, shape], dim=1))

        # Attention pooling
        margin_pooled = self.margin_pool(margin)
        shape_pooled = self.shape_pool(shape)
        texture_pooled = self.texture_pool(texture)

        # Concatenate features
        features = torch.cat([margin_pooled, shape_pooled, texture_pooled], dim=1)

        return self.final(features)

    if current_logloss < best_logloss:

class CrossFeatureAttention(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, embed_dim, num_heads):
        super().__init__()
        self.self_attn = nn.MultiheadAttention(embed_dim, num_heads, batch_first=True)
        self.cross_attn = nn.MultiheadAttention(embed_dim, num_heads, batch_first=True)
        self.norm1 = nn.LayerNorm(embed_dim)
        self.norm2 = nn.LayerNorm(embed_dim)
        self.dropout = nn.Dropout(0.1)

    def forward(self, query, key_value):
        self_attn_out, _ = self.self_attn(query, query, query)
        query = self.norm1(query + self.dropout(self_attn_out))
        cross_attn_out, _ = self.cross_attn(query, key_value, key_value)
        return self.norm2(query + self.dropout(cross_attn_out))


class AttentionPooling(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, embed_dim):
        super().__init__()
        self.attn = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(embed_dim, 128), nn.GELU(), nn.Linear(128, 1)
        )

    def forward(self, x):
        attn_weights = torch.softmax(self.attn(x), dim=1)
        return torch.sum(attn_weights * x, dim=1)


class FeatureGating(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, input_dim):
        super().__init__()
        self.gate_net = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(input_dim, 256), nn.GELU(), nn.Linear(256, 1)
        )

    def forward(self, features):
        # features: list of pooled feature tensors
        stacked = torch.stack(features, dim=1)  # [B, 3, D]
        gate_scores = self.gate_net(stacked).squeeze(-1)  # [B, 3]
        gate_weights = torch.softmax(gate_scores, dim=-1)
        return torch.sum(stacked * gate_weights.unsqueeze(-1), dim=1)


class LeafClassifier(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, num_classes):
        super().__init__()
        # Feature projections
        self.margin_proj = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(1, 256), nn.GELU(), nn.LayerNorm(256)
        )
        self.shape_proj = nn.Sequential(nn.Linear(1, 256), nn.GELU(), nn.LayerNorm(256))
        self.texture_proj = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(1, 256), nn.GELU(), nn.LayerNorm(256)
        )

        # Feature-specific transformers
        self.margin_transformer = nn.TransformerEncoder(
            nn.TransformerEncoderLayer(
                256, 8, 1024, dropout=0.1, activation="gelu", batch_first=True
            ),
            num_layers=2,
        )
        self.shape_transformer = nn.TransformerEncoder(
            nn.TransformerEncoderLayer(
                256, 8, 1024, dropout=0.1, activation="gelu", batch_first=True
            ),
            num_layers=2,
        )
        self.texture_transformer = nn.TransformerEncoder(
            nn.TransformerEncoderLayer(
                256, 8, 1024, dropout=0.1, activation="gelu", batch_first=True
            ),
            num_layers=2,
        )

        # Cross-feature attention
        self.margin_cross = CrossFeatureAttention(256, 8)
        self.shape_cross = CrossFeatureAttention(256, 8)
        self.texture_cross = CrossFeatureAttention(256, 8)

        # Attention pooling
        self.margin_pool = AttentionPooling(256)
        self.shape_pool = AttentionPooling(256)
        self.texture_pool = AttentionPooling(256)

        # Feature gating
        self.feature_gate = FeatureGating(256)

        # Final classifier
        self.final = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(256, 512),
            nn.GELU(),
            nn.Dropout(0.5),
            nn.LayerNorm(512),
            nn.Linear(512, num_classes),
        )

    def forward(self, x):
        # Process margin features
        margin = x[:, :64].unsqueeze(-1)
        margin = self.margin_proj(margin)
        margin = self.margin_transformer(margin)

        # Process shape features
        shape = x[:, 64:128].unsqueeze(-1)
        shape = self.shape_proj(shape)
        shape = self.shape_transformer(shape)

        # Process texture features
        texture = x[:, 128:192].unsqueeze(-1)
        texture = self.texture_proj(texture)
        texture = self.texture_transformer(texture)

        # Cross-feature attention
        margin = self.margin_cross(margin, torch.cat([shape, texture], dim=1))
        shape = self.shape_cross(shape, torch.cat([margin, texture], dim=1))
        texture = self.texture_cross(texture, torch.cat([margin, shape], dim=1))

        # Attention pooling
        margin_pooled = self.margin_pool(margin)
        shape_pooled = self.shape_pool(shape)
        texture_pooled = self.texture_pool(texture)

        # Feature gating
        combined = self.feature_gate([margin_pooled, shape_pooled, texture_pooled])

        return self.final(combined)


# Training setup

class EnhancedLeafClassifier(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__()
        self.branch1 = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(64, 512), nn.BatchNorm1d(512), nn.GELU(), nn.Dropout(0.4)
        )
        self.branch2 = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(64, 512), nn.BatchNorm1d(512), nn.GELU(), nn.Dropout(0.4)
        )
        self.branch3 = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(64, 512), nn.BatchNorm1d(512), nn.GELU(), nn.Dropout(0.4)
        )
        self.transformer = nn.TransformerEncoder(
            nn.TransformerEncoderLayer(
                d_model=512,
                nhead=8,
                dim_feedforward=2048,
                dropout=0.3,
                activation="gelu",
                batch_first=True,
            ),
            num_layers=4,
        )
        self.final = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(1536, 1024),
            nn.LayerNorm(1024),
            nn.GELU(),
            nn.Dropout(0.6),
            nn.Linear(1024, 99),
        )

    def forward(self, x):
        x1 = self.branch1(x[:, :64])
        x2 = self.branch2(x[:, 64:128])
        x3 = self.branch3(x[:, 128:192])

        branches = torch.stack([x1, x2, x3], dim=1)
        transformed = self.transformer(branches)
        combined = transformed.flatten(start_dim=1)
        return self.final(combined)


device = torch.device("cuda")

batch_size = 64
n_splits = 5

    train_ds = TensorDataset(torch.FloatTensor(X_train), torch.LongTensor(y_train))

    scheduler = optim.lr_scheduler.CosineAnnealingWarmRestarts(
        optimizer, T_0=50, T_mult=2
    )
    criterion = nn.CrossEntropyLoss(label_smoothing=0.1)

    best_loss = np.inf
    for epoch in range(epochs):
        model.train()
        for inputs, targets in train_loader:
            inputs, targets = inputs.to(device), targets.to(device)
            optimizer.zero_grad()
            outputs = model(inputs)
            loss = criterion(outputs, targets)
            loss.backward()
            nn.utils.clip_grad_norm_(model.parameters(), 1.0)
            optimizer.step()
        scheduler.step()

        model.eval()
        with torch.no_grad():
            val_inputs = torch.FloatTensor(X_val).to(device)
            val_outputs = model(val_inputs)
            val_loss = criterion(val_outputs, torch.LongTensor(y_val).to(device)).item()

            if val_loss < best_loss:
                best_loss = val_loss

    model.load_state_dict(torch.load(f"working/best_fold{fold}.pt"))

    with torch.no_grad():

            torch.softmax(model(torch.FloatTensor(X_val).to(device)), 1).cpu().numpy()

        test_outputs = (
            torch.softmax(model(torch.FloatTensor(X_test).to(device)), 1).cpu().numpy()
        )
        test_probs.append(test_outputs)

class LabelSmoothingCE(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, epsilon=0.1):
        super().__init__()
        self.epsilon = epsilon

    def forward(self, logits, targets):
        n_classes = logits.size(-1)
        log_probs = -torch.nn.functional.log_softmax(logits, dim=-1)
        targets_one_hot = torch.zeros_like(logits).scatter_(1, targets.unsqueeze(1), 1)
        smoothed_targets = (
            targets_one_hot * (1 - self.epsilon) + self.epsilon / n_classes
        )
        return torch.mean(torch.sum(log_probs * smoothed_targets, dim=-1))

def mixup_data(features, images, labels, alpha=0.4):
    if alpha > 0:
        lam = np.random.beta(alpha, alpha)
    else:
        lam = 1

    batch_size = features.size()[0]
    index = torch.randperm(batch_size).to(device)

    mixed_features = lam * features + (1 - lam) * features[index, :]
    mixed_images = lam * images + (1 - lam) * images[index, :]
    labels_a, labels_b = labels, labels[index]
    return mixed_features, mixed_images, labels_a, labels_b, lam


def mixup_criterion(criterion, pred, labels_a, labels_b, lam):
    return lam * criterion(pred, labels_a) + (1 - lam) * criterion(pred, labels_b)

        outputs = model(features_repeated, images_reshaped)
        outputs = outputs.view(batch_size, num_augments, -1)

class LabelSmoothingCE(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, epsilon=0.1):
        super().__init__()
        self.epsilon = epsilon

    def forward(self, logits, targets):
        n_classes = logits.size(-1)
        log_probs = -torch.nn.functional.log_softmax(logits, dim=-1)
        targets_one_hot = torch.zeros_like(logits).scatter_(1, targets.unsqueeze(1), 1)
        smoothed_targets = (
            targets_one_hot * (1 - self.epsilon) + self.epsilon / n_classes
        )
        return torch.mean(torch.sum(log_probs * smoothed_targets, dim=-1))

        )
        self.texture_net = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(64, 512), nn.BatchNorm1d(512), nn.GELU(), nn.Dropout(0.4)
        )

        # Cross-modal attention gates
        self.attention = nn.ModuleDict(
            {
                "margin": self._make_attention_gate(),
                "shape": self._make_attention_gate(),
                "texture": self._make_attention_gate(),
            }
        )

        # Final classifier
        self.head = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(2048 + 512 * 3, 2048),
            nn.BatchNorm1d(2048),
            nn.GELU(),
            nn.Dropout(0.6),
            nn.Linear(2048, 1024),
            nn.BatchNorm1d(1024),
            nn.GELU(),
            nn.Dropout(0.5),
            nn.Linear(1024, 99),
        )

    def _make_attention_gate(self):
        return nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(2048 + 512, 256), nn.GELU(), nn.Linear(256, 1), nn.Sigmoid()
        )

    def forward(self, x_feat, x_img):
        img_features = self.resnet(x_img)
        margin = self.margin_net(x_feat[:, :64])
        shape = self.shape_net(x_feat[:, 64:128])
        texture = self.texture_net(x_feat[:, 128:192])

        # Compute attention weights
        margin_attn = self.attention["margin"](torch.cat([img_features, margin], 1))
        shape_attn = self.attention["shape"](torch.cat([img_features, shape], 1))
        texture_attn = self.attention["texture"](torch.cat([img_features, texture], 1))
        attn_weights = torch.softmax(
            torch.cat([margin_attn, shape_attn, texture_attn], 1), dim=1
        )

        # Apply attention
        attended_features = sum(
            [
                margin * attn_weights[:, 0:1],
                shape * attn_weights[:, 1:2],
                texture * attn_weights[:, 2:3],
            ]
        )

        combined = torch.cat([img_features, attended_features], 1)
        return self.head(combined)

            nn.Linear(64, 512), nn.BatchNorm1d(512), nn.GELU(), nn.Dropout(0.4)
        )
        self.texture_net = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(64, 512), nn.BatchNorm1d(512), nn.GELU(), nn.Dropout(0.4)
        )

        self.attention = nn.ModuleDict(
            {
                "margin": self._make_attention_gate(),
                "shape": self._make_attention_gate(),
                "texture": self._make_attention_gate(),
            }
        )

        # FIXED INPUT DIMENSION HERE
        self.head = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(2048 + 512, 2048),  # Was 3584, now 2560 (2048+512)
            nn.BatchNorm1d(2048),
            nn.GELU(),
            nn.Dropout(0.6),
            nn.Linear(2048, 1024),
            nn.BatchNorm1d(1024),
            nn.GELU(),
            nn.Dropout(0.5),
            nn.Linear(1024, 99),
        )

    def _make_attention_gate(self):
        return nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(2048 + 512, 256), nn.GELU(), nn.Linear(256, 1), nn.Sigmoid()
        )

    def forward(self, x_feat, x_img):
        img_features = self.resnet(x_img)
        margin = self.margin_net(x_feat[:, :64])
        shape = self.shape_net(x_feat[:, 64:128])
        texture = self.texture_net(x_feat[:, 128:192])

        margin_attn = self.attention["margin"](torch.cat([img_features, margin], 1))
        shape_attn = self.attention["shape"](torch.cat([img_features, shape], 1))
        texture_attn = self.attention["texture"](torch.cat([img_features, texture], 1))
        attn_weights = torch.softmax(
            torch.cat([margin_attn, shape_attn, texture_attn], 1), dim=1
        )

        attended_features = sum(
            [
                margin * attn_weights[:, 0:1],
                shape * attn_weights[:, 1:2],
                texture * attn_weights[:, 2:3],
            ]
        )

        combined = torch.cat([img_features, attended_features], 1)
        return self.head(combined)

import numpy as np

# Load data
train = pd.read_csv("input/train.csv")
test = pd.read_csv("input/test.csv")

margin = [f"margin{i}" for i in range(1, 65)]
shape = [f"shape{i}" for i in range(1, 65)]
texture = [f"texture{i}" for i in range(1, 65)]

# Proper feature scaling without data leakage
scaler_margin = StandardScaler().fit(train[margin])
scaler_shape = StandardScaler().fit(train[shape])
scaler_texture = StandardScaler().fit(train[texture])

X = np.hstack(
    [
        scaler_margin.transform(train[margin]),
        scaler_shape.transform(train[shape]),
        scaler_texture.transform(train[texture]),
    ]
)
X_test = np.hstack(
    [
        scaler_margin.transform(test[margin]),
        scaler_shape.transform(test[shape]),
        scaler_texture.transform(test[texture]),
    ]
)
y = LabelEncoder().fit_transform(train["species"])


class EnhancedLeafClassifier(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__()
        self.branch1 = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(64, 512), nn.BatchNorm1d(512), nn.GELU(), nn.Dropout(0.4)
        )
        self.branch2 = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(64, 512), nn.BatchNorm1d(512), nn.GELU(), nn.Dropout(0.4)
        )
        self.branch3 = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(64, 512), nn.BatchNorm1d(512), nn.GELU(), nn.Dropout(0.4)
        )
        self.transformer = nn.TransformerEncoder(
            nn.TransformerEncoderLayer(
                d_model=512,
                nhead=8,
                dim_feedforward=2048,
                dropout=0.3,
                activation="gelu",
                batch_first=True,
            ),
            num_layers=4,
        )
        self.final = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(1536, 1024),
            nn.LayerNorm(1024),
            nn.GELU(),
            nn.Dropout(0.6),
            nn.Linear(1024, 99),
        )

    def forward(self, x):
        x1 = self.branch1(x[:, :64])
        x2 = self.branch2(x[:, 64:128])
        x3 = self.branch3(x[:, 128:192])

        branches = torch.stack([x1, x2, x3], dim=1)
        transformed = self.transformer(branches)
        combined = transformed.flatten(start_dim=1)
        return self.final(combined)


device = torch.device("cuda")
epochs = 350
batch_size = 64
n_splits = 5

skf = StratifiedKFold(n_splits=n_splits, shuffle=True, random_state=42)

    X_train, X_val = X[train_idx], X[val_idx]

    optimizer = optim.AdamW(model.parameters(), lr=1.5e-3, weight_decay=1e-4)
    scheduler = optim.lr_scheduler.CosineAnnealingWarmRestarts(
        optimizer, T_0=50, T_mult=2
    )
    criterion = nn.CrossEntropyLoss(label_smoothing=0.1)

    best_loss = np.inf
    for epoch in range(epochs):
        model.train()
        for inputs, targets in train_loader:
            inputs, targets = inputs.to(device), targets.to(device)
            optimizer.zero_grad()
            outputs = model(inputs)
            loss = criterion(outputs, targets)
            loss.backward()
            nn.utils.clip_grad_norm_(model.parameters(), 1.0)
            optimizer.step()
        scheduler.step()

        model.eval()
        with torch.no_grad():
            val_inputs = torch.FloatTensor(X_val).to(device)
            val_outputs = model(val_inputs)
            val_loss = criterion(val_outputs, torch.LongTensor(y_val).to(device)).item()

            if val_loss < best_loss:
                best_loss = val_loss
                torch.save(model.state_dict(), f"working/best_fold{fold}.pt")

    model.load_state_dict(torch.load(f"working/best_fold{fold}.pt"))
    model.eval()

    with torch.no_grad():
        val_preds = (
            torch.softmax(model(torch.FloatTensor(X_val).to(device)), 1).cpu().numpy()
        )
        val_score = log_loss(y_val, val_preds)
        val_scores.append(val_score)

        test_outputs = (
            torch.softmax(model(torch.FloatTensor(X_test).to(device)), 1).cpu().numpy()
        )
        test_probs.append(test_outputs)

            margin * attn_weights[:, 0:1]
            + shape * attn_weights[:, 1:2]
            + texture * attn_weights[:, 2:3]
        )

class LabelSmoothingCE(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, epsilon=0.1):
        super().__init__()
        self.epsilon = epsilon

    def forward(self, logits, targets):
        n_classes = logits.size(-1)
        log_probs = -torch.nn.functional.log_softmax(logits, dim=-1)
        targets_one_hot = torch.zeros_like(logits).scatter_(1, targets.unsqueeze(1), 1)
        smoothed_targets = (
            targets_one_hot * (1 - self.epsilon) + self.epsilon / n_classes
        )
        return torch.mean(torch.sum(log_probs * smoothed_targets, dim=-1))

# Multi-modal model
class MultiModalNet(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, tab_size, num_classes):
        super().__init__()
        # Image branch
        self.cnn = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Conv2d(1, 32, 3, padding=1),
            nn.ReLU(),
            nn.MaxPool2d(2),
            nn.Conv2d(32, 64, 3, padding=1),
            nn.ReLU(),
            nn.MaxPool2d(2),
            nn.Conv2d(64, 128, 3, padding=1),
            nn.ReLU(),
            nn.MaxPool2d(2),
            nn.AdaptiveAvgPool2d(1),
            nn.Flatten(),
        )
        # Tabular branch
        self.dnn = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(tab_size, 512),
            nn.ReLU(),
            nn.BatchNorm1d(512),
            nn.Dropout(0.5),
            nn.Linear(512, 256),
            nn.ReLU(),
            nn.BatchNorm1d(256),
            nn.Dropout(0.3),
        )
        # Combined classifier
        self.classifier = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(128 + 256, 256),
            nn.ReLU(),
            nn.BatchNorm1d(256),
            nn.Dropout(0.3),
            nn.Linear(256, num_classes),
        )

    def forward(self, img, tab):
        img_feat = self.cnn(img)
        tab_feat = self.dnn(tab)
        return self.classifier(torch.cat([img_feat, tab_feat], 1))

import numpy as np

margin = [f"margin{i}" for i in range(1, 65)]
shape = [f"shape{i}" for i in range(1, 65)]

    [
        transforms.Resize((128, 128)),

    ]
)

test_transform = transforms.Compose(

        transforms.Resize((128, 128)),

class LeafDataset(Dataset):
    def __init__(self, df, img_dir, is_test=False, transform=None):
        self.df = df
        self.img_dir = img_dir
        self.transform = transform
        self.is_test = is_test

        if not is_test:
            self.labels = le.transform(df["species"])

    def __len__(self):
        return len(self.df)

    def __getitem__(self, idx):
        img_id = self.df.iloc[idx]["id"]
        img = Image.open(f"{self.img_dir}/{img_id}.jpg").convert("L")

        if self.transform:
            img = self.transform(img)

        feats = torch.FloatTensor(self.df.iloc[idx][features].values.astype(float))

        if self.is_test:
            return feats, img
        return feats, img, torch.tensor(self.labels[idx])


class MultimodalLeafNet(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__()
        # Feature processing
        self.tabular = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(192, 512), nn.BatchNorm1d(512), nn.SiLU(), nn.Dropout(0.5)
        )

        # Image processing
        self.cnn = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Conv2d(1, 64, 3, padding=1),
            nn.BatchNorm2d(64),
            nn.SiLU(),
            nn.MaxPool2d(2),
            nn.Conv2d(64, 128, 3, padding=1),
            nn.BatchNorm2d(128),
            nn.SiLU(),
            nn.MaxPool2d(2),
            nn.Conv2d(128, 256, 3, padding=1),
            nn.BatchNorm2d(256),
            nn.SiLU(),
            nn.AdaptiveAvgPool2d(1),
            nn.Flatten(),
            nn.Linear(256, 512),
            nn.BatchNorm1d(512),
            nn.SiLU(),
            nn.Dropout(0.5),
        )

        # Combined processing
        self.classifier = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(1024, 768),
            nn.LayerNorm(768),
            nn.SiLU(),
            nn.Dropout(0.6),
            nn.Linear(768, 99),
        )

    def forward(self, x_tab, x_img):
        x_tab = self.tabular(x_tab)
        x_img = self.cnn(x_img)
        x = torch.cat([x_tab, x_img], dim=1)
        return self.classifier(x)


device = torch.device("cuda")
epochs = 150
batch_size = 32
n_splits = 5

skf = StratifiedKFold(n_splits=n_splits, shuffle=True, random_state=42)

val_scores = []

for fold, (train_idx, val_idx) in enumerate(skf.split(train, y)):
    # Fold-specific scaling
    scaler = StandardScaler().fit(train.iloc[train_idx][features])

    # Create scaled datasets
    train_fold = train.iloc[train_idx].copy()
    val_fold = train.iloc[val_idx].copy()

    # Data loaders
    train_ds = LeafDataset(train_fold, "input/images", transform=train_transform)
    val_ds = LeafDataset(val_fold, "input/images", transform=test_transform)
    test_ds = LeafDataset(
        test_fold, "input/images", is_test=True, transform=test_transform
    )

    train_loader = DataLoader(

    )

    )
    test_loader = DataLoader(
        test_ds, batch_size=batch_size, num_workers=8, pin_memory=True
    )

    # Model setup
    model = MultimodalLeafNet().to(device)
    optimizer = optim.AdamW(model.parameters(), lr=1e-3, weight_decay=1e-4)
    scheduler = optim.lr_scheduler.CosineAnnealingWarmRestarts(optimizer, T_0=30)
    criterion = nn.CrossEntropyLoss(label_smoothing=0.2)

    # Training loop
    best_loss = np.inf
    for epoch in range(epochs):
        model.train()
        for tab, img, y in train_loader:
            tab, img, y = tab.to(device), img.to(device), y.to(device)
            optimizer.zero_grad()
            outputs = model(tab, img)
            loss = criterion(outputs, y)
            loss.backward()
            nn.utils.clip_grad_norm_(model.parameters(), 1.0)
            optimizer.step()
        scheduler.step()

        # Validation
        model.eval()
        val_loss = 0
        with torch.no_grad():
            for tab, img, y in val_loader:
                tab, img, y = tab.to(device), img.to(device), y.to(device)
                outputs = model(tab, img)
                val_loss += criterion(outputs, y).item() * len(y)
        val_loss /= len(val_ds)

        if val_loss < best_loss:
            best_loss = val_loss
            torch.save(model.state_dict(), f"working/best_fold{fold}.pt")

    # Load best model for fold
    model.load_state_dict(torch.load(f"working/best_fold{fold}.pt"))
    model.eval()

    # Validation metrics
    val_probs, val_true = [], []
    with torch.no_grad():
        for tab, img, y in val_loader:
            tab, img = tab.to(device), img.to(device)
            outputs = model(tab, img)
            val_probs.append(torch.softmax(outputs, 1).cpu().numpy())
            val_true.append(y.cpu().numpy())
    val_score = log_loss(np.concatenate(val_true), np.concatenate(val_probs))
    val_scores.append(val_score)
    print(f"Fold {fold} Val Log Loss: {val_score:.4f}")

    # Test predictions
    fold_probs = []
    with torch.no_grad():
        for tab, img in test_loader:
            tab, img = tab.to(device), img.to(device)
            outputs = model(tab, img)
            fold_probs.append(torch.softmax(outputs, 1).cpu().numpy())
    test_probs.append(np.concatenate(fold_probs))

# Ensemble and save

submission.to_csv("submission/submission.csv", index=False)

class LeafClassifier(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__()
        self.resnet = models.resnet50(pretrained=True)
        self.resnet.fc = nn.Identity()

        self.feature_nets = nn.ModuleList(
            [
                nn.Sequential(nn.Linear(64, 512), nn.BatchNorm1d(512), nn.GELU())
                for _ in range(3)
            ]
        )

        self.attention = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(2048 + 512 * 3, 512),
            nn.GELU(),
            nn.Linear(512, 3),
            nn.Softmax(dim=1),
        )

        self.head = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(2048 + 512, 1024),
            nn.BatchNorm1d(1024),
            nn.GELU(),
            nn.Dropout(0.5),
            nn.Linear(1024, 99),
        )

    def forward(self, x_feat, x_img):
        img_feat = self.resnet(x_img)
        features = [
            net(x_feat[:, i * 64 : (i + 1) * 64])
            for i, net in enumerate(self.feature_nets)
        ]

        attn_input = torch.cat([img_feat] + features, dim=1)
        weights = self.attention(attn_input)

        weighted_features = sum(
            f * weights[:, i].unsqueeze(1) for i, f in enumerate(features)
        )
        combined = torch.cat([img_feat, weighted_features], dim=1)
        return self.head(combined)

class LabelSmoothingCE(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, epsilon=0.1):
        super().__init__()
        self.epsilon = epsilon

    def forward(self, logits, targets):
        n_classes = logits.size(-1)
        log_probs = -torch.nn.functional.log_softmax(logits, dim=-1)
        targets_one_hot = torch.zeros_like(logits).scatter_(1, targets.unsqueeze(1), 1)
        smoothed_targets = (
            targets_one_hot * (1 - self.epsilon) + self.epsilon / n_classes
        )
        return torch.mean(torch.sum(log_probs * smoothed_targets, dim=-1))

class MultiModalNet(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, tab_size, num_classes):

        )

    def forward(self, img, tab):
        img_feat = self.cnn(img)
        tab_feat = self.dnn(tab)
        return self.classifier(torch.cat([img_feat, tab_feat], 1))

class LeafDataset(Dataset):
    def __init__(self, df, img_dir, is_test=False, transform=None):
        self.df = df
        self.img_dir = img_dir
        self.transform = transform
        self.is_test = is_test

        if not is_test:
            self.labels = le.transform(df["species"])

    def __len__(self):
        return len(self.df)

    def __getitem__(self, idx):
        img_id = str(int(self.df.iloc[idx]["id"]))  # Ensure integer ID
        img_path = f"{self.img_dir}/{img_id}.jpg"
        img = safe_image_open(img_path)

        if self.transform:
            img = self.transform(img)

        feats = torch.FloatTensor(self.df.iloc[idx][features].values.astype(float))

        if self.is_test:
            return feats, img
        return feats, img, torch.tensor(self.labels[idx])


# Keep original model architecture and training loop
class MultimodalLeafNet(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__()
        self.tabular = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(192, 512), nn.BatchNorm1d(512), nn.SiLU(), nn.Dropout(0.5)
        )
        self.cnn = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Conv2d(1, 64, 3, padding=1),
            nn.BatchNorm2d(64),
            nn.SiLU(),
            nn.MaxPool2d(2),
            nn.Conv2d(64, 128, 3, padding=1),
            nn.BatchNorm2d(128),
            nn.SiLU(),
            nn.MaxPool2d(2),
            nn.Conv2d(128, 256, 3, padding=1),
            nn.BatchNorm2d(256),
            nn.SiLU(),
            nn.AdaptiveAvgPool2d(1),
            nn.Flatten(),
            nn.Linear(256, 512),
            nn.BatchNorm1d(512),
            nn.SiLU(),
            nn.Dropout(0.5),
        )
        self.classifier = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(1024, 768),
            nn.LayerNorm(768),
            nn.SiLU(),
            nn.Dropout(0.6),
            nn.Linear(768, 99),
        )

    def forward(self, x_tab, x_img):
        x_tab = self.tabular(x_tab)
        x_img = self.cnn(x_img)
        x = torch.cat([x_tab, x_img], dim=1)
        return self.classifier(x)

        if val_loss < best_loss:

    # Validation metrics

    with torch.no_grad():

# Enhanced model architecture with feature concatenation
class EnhancedLeafClassifier(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, num_classes):
        super().__init__()
        self.img_backbone = models.efficientnet_b4(pretrained=True)
        self.img_backbone.features[0][0] = nn.Conv2d(
            1, 48, kernel_size=3, stride=2, padding=1, bias=False
        )

        self.tabular_processor = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(192, 1024),
            nn.BatchNorm1d(1024),
            nn.GELU(),
            nn.Dropout(0.4),
            nn.Linear(1024, 512),
        )

        self.img_processor = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(1792, 1024),
            nn.BatchNorm1d(1024),
            nn.GELU(),
            nn.Dropout(0.4),
            nn.Linear(1024, 512),
        )

        self.final_classifier = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(1024, 768),
            nn.BatchNorm1d(768),
            nn.GELU(),
            nn.Dropout(0.3),
            nn.Linear(768, num_classes),
        )

    def forward(self, x_tab, x_img):
        img_features = self.img_backbone.extract_features(x_img)
        img_features = torch.flatten(img_features, 1)
        img_emb = self.img_processor(img_features)

        tab_emb = self.tabular_processor(x_tab)

        combined = torch.cat([img_emb, tab_emb], dim=1)
        return self.final_classifier(combined)
