class LeafClassifier(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, num_classes, image_feature_dim, image_start, image_end):
        super().__init__()
        self.margin_net = self._create_branch(64)
        self.shape_net = self._create_branch(64)
        self.texture_net = self._create_branch(64)
        self.image_net = self._create_branch(image_feature_dim)
        self.image_start = image_start
        self.image_end = image_end
        self.attention = nn.MultiheadAttention(
            embed_dim=256, num_heads=8, batch_first=True
        )
        self.classifier = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(256, 512),
            nn.BatchNorm1d(512),
            nn.GELU(),
            nn.Dropout(0.5),
            nn.Linear(512, num_classes),
        )

    def _create_branch(self, in_dim):
        return nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(in_dim, 256), nn.BatchNorm1d(256), nn.GELU(), nn.Dropout(0.3)
        )

    def forward(self, x):
        margin = self.margin_net(x[:, :64])
        shape = self.shape_net(x[:, 64:128])
        texture = self.texture_net(x[:, 128:192])
        image = self.image_net(x[:, self.image_start : self.image_end])
        embeddings = torch.stack([margin, shape, texture, image], dim=1)
        attn_out, _ = self.attention(embeddings, embeddings, embeddings)
        return self.classifier(attn_out.mean(dim=1))

        self.classifier = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(1536, 1024),  # Changed from 1024 to 1536
            nn.LayerNorm(1024),
            nn.SiLU(),
            nn.Dropout(0.6),
            nn.Linear(1024, 99),
        )

    def forward(self, x_tab, x_img):
        # Process tabular data
        tab_features = self.tabular(x_tab)

        # Process image data
        img_features = self.cnn.features(x_img)
        img_features = self.img_proj(img_features)
        img_features = self.img_pool(img_features).squeeze(-1).squeeze(-1)

        # Concatenate features for gating
        combined = torch.cat([tab_features, img_features], dim=1)

        # Compute attention weights
        gate_weights = self.gate(combined).unsqueeze(-1)

        # Apply gated fusion
        fused_features = (
            gate_weights[:, 0] * tab_features + gate_weights[:, 1] * img_features
        )
        fused_features = torch.cat([fused_features, combined], dim=1)

        return self.classifier(fused_features)

            nn.Linear(tabular_dim, 256),

            nn.Linear(256, 128),

        tabular = x[:, :tabular_dim]
        image = x[:, tabular_dim:]
        tab_feat = self.tabular_branch(tabular)
        img_feat = self.image_branch(image)
        combined = torch.cat([tab_feat, img_feat], dim=1)

class LabelSmoothingCrossEntropy(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, smoothing=0.1):
        super().__init__()
        self.smoothing = smoothing
        self.confidence = 1.0 - smoothing

    def forward(self, x, target):
        log_probs = F.log_softmax(x, dim=-1)
        nll_loss = -log_probs.gather(dim=-1, index=target.unsqueeze(1)).squeeze(1)
        smooth_loss = -log_probs.mean(dim=-1)
        loss = self.confidence * nll_loss + self.smoothing * smooth_loss
        return loss.mean()

class LeafClassifier(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, num_classes, image_feature_dim, image_start, image_end):
        super().__init__()
        self.margin_net = self._create_branch(64)
        self.shape_net = self._create_branch(64)
        self.texture_net = self._create_branch(64)
        self.image_net = self._create_branch(image_feature_dim)
        self.image_start = image_start
        self.image_end = image_end
        self.attention = nn.MultiheadAttention(
            embed_dim=256, num_heads=8, batch_first=True
        )
        self.classifier = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(256, 512),
            nn.BatchNorm1d(512),
            nn.GELU(),
            nn.Dropout(0.5),
            nn.Linear(512, num_classes),
        )

    def _create_branch(self, in_dim):
        return nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(in_dim, 256), nn.BatchNorm1d(256), nn.GELU(), nn.Dropout(0.3)
        )

    def forward(self, x):
        margin = self.margin_net(x[:, :64])
        shape = self.shape_net(x[:, 64:128])
        texture = self.texture_net(x[:, 128:192])
        image = self.image_net(x[:, self.image_start : self.image_end])
        embeddings = torch.stack([margin, shape, texture, image], dim=1)
        attn_out, _ = self.attention(embeddings, embeddings, embeddings)
        return self.classifier(attn_out.mean(dim=1))

class FeatureFusionModel(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, tabular_dim, image_dim, num_classes):
        super().__init__()
        self.tabular_branch = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(tabular_dim, 512),
            nn.BatchNorm1d(512),
            nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Dropout(0.6),
            nn.Linear(512, 256),
        )
        self.image_branch = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(image_dim, 512),
            nn.BatchNorm1d(512),
            nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Dropout(0.6),
            nn.Linear(512, 256),
        )
        self.classifier = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(512, 256),
            nn.BatchNorm1d(256),
            nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Dropout(0.5),
            nn.Linear(256, num_classes),
        )

    def forward(self, x):
        tabular = x[:, :tabular_dim]
        image = x[:, tabular_dim:]
        tab_feat = self.tabular_branch(tabular)
        img_feat = self.image_branch(image)
        combined = torch.cat([tab_feat, img_feat], dim=1)
        return self.classifier(combined)

import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
from sklearn.model_selection import StratifiedKFold
from sklearn.preprocessing import LabelEncoder, StandardScaler
from sklearn.metrics import log_loss
import torch
import torch.nn as nn
import torch.optim as optim
from torch.utils.data import Dataset, DataLoader

# Load data
train = pd.read_csv("input/train.csv")
test = pd.read_csv("input/test.csv")

# Feature columns
margin = [f"margin{i}" for i in range(1, 65)]
shape = [f"shape{i}" for i in range(1, 65)]
texture = [f"texture{i}" for i in range(1, 65)]

# Feature scaling
scaler_dict = {}


def scale_features(df, fit=False):
    scaled = []
    for i, feat_type in enumerate([margin, shape, texture]):
        if fit:
            scaler = StandardScaler()
            scaler.fit(df[feat_type])
            scaler_dict[i] = scaler
        else:
            scaler = scaler_dict[i]
        scaled.append(scaler.transform(df[feat_type]))
    return np.hstack(scaled)


X_train = scale_features(train, fit=True)
X_test = scale_features(test)
y = LabelEncoder().fit_transform(train["species"])


# Dataset class with label smoothing
class LeafDataset(Dataset):
    def __init__(self, X, y, num_classes=99, smoothing=0.1):
        self.X = torch.FloatTensor(X)
        self.y = torch.LongTensor(y) if y is not None else None
        self.num_classes = num_classes
        self.smoothing = smoothing

    def __len__(self):
        return len(self.X)

    def __getitem__(self, idx):
        if self.y is not None:
            target = self.y[idx]
            one_hot = torch.zeros(self.num_classes)
            one_hot[target] = 1.0 - self.smoothing
            one_hot += self.smoothing / self.num_classes
            return self.X[idx], one_hot
        else:
            return self.X[idx]


# Enhanced model architecture
class MultimodalNet(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__()
        self.margin_net = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(64, 256),
            nn.GELU(),
            nn.Dropout(0.3),
            nn.Linear(256, 256),
            nn.GELU(),
            nn.Dropout(0.3),
        )
        self.shape_net = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(64, 256),
            nn.GELU(),
            nn.Dropout(0.3),
            nn.Linear(256, 256),
            nn.GELU(),
            nn.Dropout(0.3),
        )
        self.texture_net = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(64, 256),
            nn.GELU(),
            nn.Dropout(0.3),
            nn.Linear(256, 256),
            nn.GELU(),
            nn.Dropout(0.3),
        )

        self.fusion = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(256 * 3, 512),
            nn.GELU(),
            nn.Dropout(0.5),
            nn.Linear(512, 256),
            nn.GELU(),
            nn.Dropout(0.3),
        )
        self.classifier = nn.Linear(256, 99)

    def forward(self, x):
        m = self.margin_net(x[:, :64])
        s = self.shape_net(x[:, 64:128])
        t = self.texture_net(x[:, 128:192])
        combined = torch.cat([m, s, t], dim=1)
        fused = self.fusion(combined)
        return self.classifier(fused)


# Cross-validation
skf = StratifiedKFold(n_splits=5, shuffle=True, random_state=42)
test_probs = []
val_scores = []

for fold, (train_idx, val_idx) in enumerate(skf.split(X_train, y)):
    # Data preparation
    X_tr, X_val = X_train[train_idx], X_train[val_idx]
    y_tr, y_val = y[train_idx], y[val_idx]

    train_dataset = LeafDataset(X_tr, y_tr)
    train_loader = DataLoader(
        train_dataset, batch_size=64, shuffle=True, num_workers=4, pin_memory=True
    )
    val_dataset = LeafDataset(X_val, None)
    val_loader = DataLoader(val_dataset, batch_size=64)

    # Model setup
    model = MultimodalNet().cuda()
    optimizer = optim.AdamW(model.parameters(), lr=1e-3, weight_decay=0.01)
    scheduler = optim.lr_scheduler.CosineAnnealingWarmRestarts(optimizer, T_0=10)
    criterion = nn.KLDivLoss(reduction="batchmean")

    best_score = np.inf
    for epoch in range(100):
        model.train()
        total_loss = 0.0
        for batch_X, batch_y in train_loader:
            batch_X = batch_X.cuda()
            batch_y = batch_y.cuda()
            optimizer.zero_grad()
            outputs = model(batch_X)
            loss = criterion(torch.log_softmax(outputs, dim=1), batch_y)
            loss.backward()
            optimizer.step()
            total_loss += loss.item() * batch_X.size(0)
        scheduler.step()

        # Validation
        model.eval()
        val_preds = []
        with torch.no_grad():
            for batch_X in val_loader:
                batch_X = batch_X.cuda()
                outputs = model(batch_X)
                val_preds.append(torch.softmax(outputs, dim=1).cpu().numpy())
        val_preds = np.concatenate(val_preds)
        score = log_loss(y_val, val_preds)
        if score < best_score:
            best_score = score
            torch.save(model.state_dict(), f"working/best_{fold}.pt")

    # Test prediction
    model.load_state_dict(torch.load(f"working/best_{fold}.pt"))
    test_dataset = LeafDataset(X_test, None)
    test_loader = DataLoader(test_dataset, batch_size=64)
    test_preds = []
    with torch.no_grad():
        for batch_X in test_loader:
            batch_X = batch_X.cuda()
            outputs = model(batch_X)
            test_preds.append(torch.softmax(outputs, dim=1).cpu().numpy())
    test_preds = np.concatenate(test_preds)
    test_probs.append(test_preds)
    val_scores.append(best_score)

# Create submission
submission = pd.DataFrame(
    np.mean(test_probs, axis=0), columns=LabelEncoder().fit(train["species"]).classes_
)
submission.insert(0, "id", test["id"])
submission.to_csv("submission/submission.csv", index=False)

print(f"Validation LogLoss: {np.mean(val_scores):.4f} ± {np.std(val_scores):.4f}")

class LabelSmoothingCrossEntropy(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, smoothing=0.1):
        super().__init__()
        self.smoothing = smoothing
        self.confidence = 1.0 - smoothing

    def forward(self, x, target):
        log_probs = F.log_softmax(x, dim=-1)
        nll_loss = -log_probs.gather(dim=-1, index=target.unsqueeze(1)).squeeze(1)
        smooth_loss = -log_probs.mean(dim=-1)
        loss = self.confidence * nll_loss + self.smoothing * smooth_loss
        return loss.mean()

                    img_tensor = transform(img).unsqueeze(0).to(device)
                    feat = feature_extractor(img_tensor).squeeze().cpu().numpy()
                tta_features.append(feat)
            features.append(np.mean(tta_features, axis=0))
        else:
            with torch.no_grad():
                img_tensor = base_transform(img).unsqueeze(0).to(device)
                feat = feature_extractor(img_tensor).squeeze().cpu().numpy()
            features.append(feat)
    return np.array(features)

class LeafClassifier(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, num_classes, image_feature_dim, image_start, image_end):
        super().__init__()
        self.margin_net = self._create_branch(64)
        self.shape_net = self._create_branch(64)
        self.texture_net = self._create_branch(64)
        self.image_net = self._create_branch(image_feature_dim)
        self.image_start = image_start
        self.image_end = image_end
        self.attention = nn.MultiheadAttention(
            embed_dim=256, num_heads=8, batch_first=True
        )
        self.classifier = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(256, 512),
            nn.BatchNorm1d(512),
            nn.GELU(),
            nn.Dropout(0.5),
            nn.Linear(512, num_classes),
        )

    def _create_branch(self, in_dim):
        return nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(in_dim, 256), nn.BatchNorm1d(256), nn.GELU(), nn.Dropout(0.3)
        )

    def forward(self, x):
        margin = self.margin_net(x[:, :64])
        shape = self.shape_net(x[:, 64:128])
        texture = self.texture_net(x[:, 128:192])
        image = self.image_net(x[:, self.image_start : self.image_end])
        embeddings = torch.stack([margin, shape, texture, image], dim=1)
        attn_out, _ = self.attention(embeddings, embeddings, embeddings)
        return self.classifier(attn_out.mean(dim=1))

class LabelSmoothingCrossEntropy(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, smoothing=0.1):
        super().__init__()
        self.smoothing = smoothing

    def forward(self, logits, targets):
        num_classes = logits.size()[-1]
        log_preds = torch.nn.functional.log_softmax(logits, dim=-1)
        with torch.no_grad():
            targets = torch.zeros_like(log_preds).scatter_(1, targets.unsqueeze(1), 1)
            targets = (1 - self.smoothing) * targets + self.smoothing / (
                num_classes - 1
            ) * (1 - targets)
        return torch.mean(-torch.sum(targets * log_preds, dim=-1))

import pandas as pd

class LeafDataset(Dataset):
    def __init__(self, tabular_data, ids, labels=None, transform=None):
        self.tabular = tabular_data
        self.ids = ids
        self.labels = labels
        self.transform = transform

    def __len__(self):
        return len(self.ids)

    def __getitem__(self, idx):
        img = Image.open(f"input/images/{self.ids[idx]}.jpg").convert("RGB")
        if self.transform:
            img = self.transform(img)
        tab = torch.FloatTensor(self.tabular[idx])
        return (tab, img, self.labels[idx]) if self.labels is not None else (tab, img)


class LeafClassifier(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, num_classes):
        super().__init__()
        self.effnet = models.efficientnet_b4(pretrained=True)
        self.effnet.classifier = nn.Identity()  # Output: 1792 features

        # Tabular processing
        self.tab_net = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(192, 512),
            nn.BatchNorm1d(512),
            nn.GELU(),
            nn.Dropout(0.3),
            nn.Linear(512, 512),
            nn.BatchNorm1d(512),
            nn.GELU(),
            nn.Dropout(0.3),
        )

        # Combined classifier
        self.classifier = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(1792 + 512, 1024),
            nn.BatchNorm1d(1024),
            nn.GELU(),
            nn.Dropout(0.5),
            nn.Linear(1024, num_classes),
        )

    def forward(self, tab, img):
        img_feat = self.effnet(img)
        tab_feat = self.tab_net(tab)
        return self.classifier(torch.cat([img_feat, tab_feat], dim=1))


# Configuration
device = torch.device("cuda" if torch.cuda.is_available() else "cpu")

num_workers = 4

for grp in [(0, 64), (64, 128), (128, 192)]:

    train_df.iloc[:, grp[0] + 2 : grp[1] + 2] = scaler.fit_transform(

test_loader = DataLoader(test_ds, batch_size=batch_size * 2, num_workers=num_workers)

for epoch in range(40):

    for tab, img, y in train_loader:

def tta_transform(image):
    return [
        val_tfms(image),
        val_tfms(image.transpose(Image.FLIP_LEFT_RIGHT)),
        val_tfms(image.rotate(10)),
        val_tfms(image.rotate(-10)),

import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
from sklearn.model_selection import StratifiedKFold
from sklearn.preprocessing import LabelEncoder, StandardScaler
from sklearn.metrics import log_loss
import torch
import torch.nn as nn
import torch.optim as optim
from torch.utils.data import Dataset, DataLoader

# Load data
train = pd.read_csv("input/train.csv")
test = pd.read_csv("input/test.csv")

# Feature columns
margin = [f"margin{i}" for i in range(1, 65)]
shape = [f"shape{i}" for i in range(1, 65)]
texture = [f"texture{i}" for i in range(1, 65)]

# Feature scaling
scaler_dict = {}


def scale_features(df, fit=False):
    scaled = []
    for i, feat_type in enumerate([margin, shape, texture]):
        if fit:
            scaler = StandardScaler()
            scaler.fit(df[feat_type])
            scaler_dict[i] = scaler
        else:
            scaler = scaler_dict[i]
        scaled.append(scaler.transform(df[feat_type]))
    return np.hstack(scaled)


X_train = scale_features(train, fit=True)
X_test = scale_features(test)
y = LabelEncoder().fit_transform(train["species"])


class LeafDataset(Dataset):
    def __init__(self, X, y, num_classes=99, smoothing=0.1):
        self.X = torch.FloatTensor(X)
        self.y = torch.LongTensor(y) if y is not None else None
        self.num_classes = num_classes
        self.smoothing = smoothing

    def __len__(self):
        return len(self.X)

    def __getitem__(self, idx):
        if self.y is not None:
            target = self.y[idx]
            one_hot = torch.zeros(self.num_classes)
            one_hot[target] = 1.0 - self.smoothing
            one_hot += self.smoothing / self.num_classes
            return self.X[idx], one_hot
        else:
            return self.X[idx]


class MultimodalNet(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__()
        # Feature extraction branches
        self.margin_net = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(64, 256),
            nn.GELU(),
            nn.Dropout(0.3),
            nn.Linear(256, 256),
            nn.GELU(),
            nn.Dropout(0.3),
        )
        self.shape_net = self.margin_net = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(64, 256),
            nn.GELU(),
            nn.Dropout(0.3),
            nn.Linear(256, 256),
            nn.GELU(),
            nn.Dropout(0.3),
        )
        self.texture_net = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(64, 256),
            nn.GELU(),
            nn.Dropout(0.3),
            nn.Linear(256, 256),
            nn.GELU(),
            nn.Dropout(0.3),
        )

        # Attention-based feature fusion
        self.attention = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(256 * 3, 128), nn.GELU(), nn.Linear(128, 3), nn.Softmax(dim=1)
        )

        # Classification head
        self.fusion = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(256 * 3, 512),
            nn.GELU(),
            nn.Dropout(0.5),
            nn.Linear(512, 256),
            nn.GELU(),
            nn.Dropout(0.3),
        )
        self.classifier = nn.Linear(256, 99)

    def forward(self, x):
        # Extract features from each modality
        m = self.margin_net(x[:, :64])
        s = self.shape_net(x[:, 64:128])
        t = self.texture_net(x[:, 128:192])

        # Compute attention weights
        combined = torch.cat([m, s, t], dim=1)
        attn_weights = self.attention(combined)

        # Apply attention weighting
        weighted_m = m * attn_weights[:, 0].unsqueeze(1)
        weighted_s = s * attn_weights[:, 1].unsqueeze(1)
        weighted_t = t * attn_weights[:, 2].unsqueeze(1)

        # Concatenate weighted features
        fused_features = torch.cat([weighted_m, weighted_s, weighted_t], dim=1)

        # Final classification
        fused = self.fusion(fused_features)
        return self.classifier(fused)


# Cross-validation setup
skf = StratifiedKFold(n_splits=5, shuffle=True, random_state=42)
test_probs = []
val_scores = []

for fold, (train_idx, val_idx) in enumerate(skf.split(X_train, y)):
    X_tr, X_val = X_train[train_idx], X_train[val_idx]
    y_tr, y_val = y[train_idx], y[val_idx]

    train_dataset = LeafDataset(X_tr, y_tr)
    train_loader = DataLoader(
        train_dataset, batch_size=64, shuffle=True, num_workers=4, pin_memory=True
    )
    val_dataset = LeafDataset(X_val, None)
    val_loader = DataLoader(val_dataset, batch_size=64)

    model = MultimodalNet().cuda()
    optimizer = optim.AdamW(model.parameters(), lr=1e-3, weight_decay=0.01)
    scheduler = optim.lr_scheduler.CosineAnnealingWarmRestarts(optimizer, T_0=10)
    criterion = nn.KLDivLoss(reduction="batchmean")

    best_score = np.inf
    for epoch in range(100):
        model.train()
        total_loss = 0.0
        for batch_X, batch_y in train_loader:
            batch_X = batch_X.cuda()
            batch_y = batch_y.cuda()
            optimizer.zero_grad()
            outputs = model(batch_X)
            loss = criterion(torch.log_softmax(outputs, dim=1), batch_y)
            loss.backward()
            optimizer.step()
            total_loss += loss.item() * batch_X.size(0)
        scheduler.step()

        model.eval()
        val_preds = []
        with torch.no_grad():
            for batch_X in val_loader:
                batch_X = batch_X.cuda()
                outputs = model(batch_X)
                val_preds.append(torch.softmax(outputs, dim=1).cpu().numpy())
        val_preds = np.concatenate(val_preds)
        score = log_loss(y_val, val_preds)
        if score < best_score:
            best_score = score
            torch.save(model.state_dict(), f"working/best_{fold}.pt")

    # Test predictions
    model.load_state_dict(torch.load(f"working/best_{fold}.pt"))
    test_dataset = LeafDataset(X_test, None)
    test_loader = DataLoader(test_dataset, batch_size=64)
    test_preds = []
    with torch.no_grad():
        for batch_X in test_loader:
            batch_X = batch_X.cuda()
            outputs = model(batch_X)
            test_preds.append(torch.softmax(outputs, dim=1).cpu().numpy())
    test_probs.append(np.concatenate(test_preds))
    val_scores.append(best_score)

# Create submission
submission = pd.DataFrame(
    np.mean(test_probs, axis=0), columns=LabelEncoder().fit(train["species"]).classes_
)
submission.insert(0, "id", test["id"])
submission.to_csv("submission/submission.csv", index=False)

print(f"Validation LogLoss: {np.mean(val_scores):.4f} ± {np.std(val_scores):.4f}")

        transforms.ToTensor(),
        transforms.Normalize(mean=[0.485, 0.456, 0.406], std=[0.229, 0.224, 0.225]),
    ]
)
image_feature_extractor = models.resnet50(weights="IMAGENET1K_V2")
image_feature_extractor = nn.Sequential(*list(image_feature_extractor.children())[:-1])


class LabelSmoothingCrossEntropy(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, smoothing=0.1):
        super().__init__()
        self.smoothing = smoothing

    def forward(self, logits, targets):
        num_classes = logits.size()[-1]
        log_preds = torch.nn.functional.log_softmax(logits, dim=-1)
        with torch.no_grad():
            targets = torch.zeros_like(log_preds).scatter_(1, targets.unsqueeze(1), 1)
            targets = (1 - self.smoothing) * targets + self.smoothing / (
                num_classes - 1
            ) * (1 - targets)
        return torch.mean(-torch.sum(targets * log_preds, dim=-1))


def safe_open_image(img_id):
    int_id = int(float(img_id))
    for ext in [".jpg", ".jpeg", ".png"]:
        path = f"./input/images/{int_id}{ext}"

            return Image.open(path).convert("RGB")
    raise FileNotFoundError(f"No image found for ID {img_id}")


def extract_img_features(df):

    for idx, row in df.iterrows():
        img = safe_open_image(row["id"])
        img_t = preprocess(img).unsqueeze(0)
        with torch.no_grad():
            feat = image_feature_extractor(img_t).squeeze().flatten().numpy()
        features.append(feat)
    return np.array(features)

class FeatureFusionModel(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, tabular_dim, image_dim, num_classes):
        super().__init__()
        self.tabular_branch = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(tabular_dim, 512),
            nn.BatchNorm1d(512),
            nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Dropout(0.6),
            nn.Linear(512, 256),
        )
        self.image_branch = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(image_dim, 512),
            nn.BatchNorm1d(512),
            nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Dropout(0.6),
            nn.Linear(512, 256),
        )
        self.feature_gate = nn.Sequential(nn.Linear(512, 512), nn.Sigmoid())
        self.classifier = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(512, 256),
            nn.BatchNorm1d(256),
            nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Dropout(0.5),
            nn.Linear(256, num_classes),
        )

    def forward(self, x):
        tabular = x[:, :tabular_dim]
        image = x[:, tabular_dim:]
        tab_feat = self.tabular_branch(tabular)
        img_feat = self.image_branch(image)
        combined = torch.cat([tab_feat, img_feat], dim=1)
        gate_weights = self.feature_gate(combined)
        gated_features = combined * gate_weights
        return self.classifier(gated_features)

shape = [f"shape{i}" for i in range(1, 65)]
texture = [f"texture{i}" for i in range(1, 65)]

# Feature scaling
scaler_dict = {}


def scale_features(df, fit=False):
    scaled = []
    for i, feat_type in enumerate([margin, shape, texture]):
        if fit:
            scaler = StandardScaler()
            scaler.fit(df[feat_type])
            scaler_dict[i] = scaler
        else:
            scaler = scaler_dict[i]

X_train = scale_features(train, fit=True)

class LeafDataset(Dataset):
    def __init__(self, X, y, num_classes=99, smoothing=0.1):
        self.X = torch.FloatTensor(X)
        self.y = torch.LongTensor(y) if y is not None else None
        self.num_classes = num_classes
        self.smoothing = smoothing

    def __len__(self):
        return len(self.X)

    def __getitem__(self, idx):
        if self.y is not None:
            target = self.y[idx]
            one_hot = torch.zeros(self.num_classes)
            one_hot[target] = 1.0 - self.smoothing
            one_hot += self.smoothing / self.num_classes
            return self.X[idx], one_hot
        else:
            return self.X[idx]


class EnhancedMultimodalNet(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__()
        # Enhanced feature extraction branches with distinct parameters
        self.margin_net = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(64, 512),
            nn.GELU(),
            nn.Dropout(0.3),
            nn.Linear(512, 512),
            nn.GELU(),
            nn.Dropout(0.3),
            nn.Linear(512, 256),
            nn.GELU(),
            nn.Dropout(0.3),
        )
        self.shape_net = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(64, 512),
            nn.GELU(),
            nn.Dropout(0.3),
            nn.Linear(512, 512),
            nn.GELU(),
            nn.Dropout(0.3),
            nn.Linear(512, 256),
            nn.GELU(),
            nn.Dropout(0.3),
        )
        self.texture_net = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(64, 512),
            nn.GELU(),
            nn.Dropout(0.3),
            nn.Linear(512, 512),
            nn.GELU(),
            nn.Dropout(0.3),
            nn.Linear(512, 256),
            nn.GELU(),
            nn.Dropout(0.3),
        )

        # Enhanced attention mechanism
        self.attention = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(256 * 3, 256), nn.GELU(), nn.Linear(256, 3), nn.Softmax(dim=1)
        )

        # Expanded classification head
        self.fusion = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(256 * 3, 1024),
            nn.GELU(),
            nn.Dropout(0.5),
            nn.Linear(1024, 512),
            nn.GELU(),
            nn.Dropout(0.4),
            nn.Linear(512, 256),
            nn.GELU(),
            nn.Dropout(0.3),
        )
        self.classifier = nn.Linear(256, 99)

    def forward(self, x):
        m = self.margin_net(x[:, :64])
        s = self.shape_net(x[:, 64:128])
        t = self.texture_net(x[:, 128:192])

        combined = torch.cat([m, s, t], dim=1)
        attn_weights = self.attention(combined)

        weighted_features = torch.stack([m, s, t], dim=1) * attn_weights.unsqueeze(-1)
        fused_features = weighted_features.sum(dim=1)

        fused = self.fusion(fused_features)
        return self.classifier(fused)

    for epoch in range(100):
        model.train()
        total_loss = 0.0
        for batch_X, batch_y in train_loader:
            batch_X = batch_X.cuda()
            batch_y = batch_y.cuda()
            optimizer.zero_grad()
            outputs = model(batch_X)
            loss = criterion(torch.log_softmax(outputs, dim=1), batch_y)
            loss.backward()
            optimizer.step()
            total_loss += loss.item() * batch_X.size(0)
        scheduler.step()

        model.eval()
        val_preds = []
        with torch.no_grad():
            for batch_X in val_loader:
                batch_X = batch_X.cuda()
                outputs = model(batch_X)
                val_preds.append(torch.softmax(outputs, dim=1).cpu().numpy())
        val_preds = np.concatenate(val_preds)
        score = log_loss(y_val, val_preds)
        if score < best_score:
            best_score = score
            torch.save(model.state_dict(), f"working/best_{fold}.pt")

    # Test predictions
    model.load_state_dict(torch.load(f"working/best_{fold}.pt"))
    test_dataset = LeafDataset(X_test, None)
    test_loader = DataLoader(test_dataset, batch_size=64)

            batch_X = batch_X.cuda()
            outputs = model(batch_X)
            test_preds.append(torch.softmax(outputs, dim=1).cpu().numpy())
    test_probs.append(np.concatenate(test_preds))
    val_scores.append(best_score)

# Create submission
submission = pd.DataFrame(
    np.mean(test_probs, axis=0), columns=LabelEncoder().fit(train["species"]).classes_
)

submission.to_csv("submission/submission.csv", index=False)

import torch
import torch.nn as nn
import torch.optim as optim
from torch.utils.data import Dataset, DataLoader

from sklearn.preprocessing import StandardScaler, LabelEncoder
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split
from sklearn.metrics import log_loss
import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
import os
from PIL import Image
import torchvision.transforms as transforms
from torch.cuda.amp import autocast, GradScaler


class ResidualBlock(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, in_channels, out_channels, stride=1):
        super().__init__()
        self.conv1 = nn.Conv2d(in_channels, out_channels, 3, stride, 1, bias=False)
        self.bn1 = nn.BatchNorm2d(out_channels)
        self.relu = nn.ReLU(inplace=True)
        self.conv2 = nn.Conv2d(out_channels, out_channels, 3, 1, 1, bias=False)
        self.bn2 = nn.BatchNorm2d(out_channels)
        self.downsample = (
            nn.Sequential(
                nn.Conv2d(in_channels, out_channels, 1, stride, bias=False),
                nn.BatchNorm2d(out_channels),
            )
            if stride != 1 or in_channels != out_channels
            else None
        )

    def forward(self, x):
        identity = x
        out = self.conv1(x)
        out = self.bn1(out)
        out = self.relu(out)
        out = self.conv2(out)
        out = self.bn2(out)
        if self.downsample:
            identity = self.downsample(x)
        out += identity
        return self.relu(out)


class MultiModalNet(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, tab_size, num_classes):
        super().__init__()
        self.cnn = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Conv2d(1, 64, kernel_size=7, stride=2, padding=3, bias=False),
            nn.BatchNorm2d(64),
            nn.ReLU(inplace=True),
            nn.MaxPool2d(3, 2, 1),
            ResidualBlock(64, 64),
            ResidualBlock(64, 64),
            ResidualBlock(64, 128, stride=2),
            ResidualBlock(128, 128),
            ResidualBlock(128, 256, stride=2),
            ResidualBlock(256, 256),
            nn.AdaptiveAvgPool2d(1),
            nn.Flatten(),
        )
        self.dnn = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(tab_size, 1024),
            nn.ReLU(),
            nn.BatchNorm1d(1024),
            nn.Dropout(0.5),
            nn.Linear(1024, 512),
            nn.ReLU(),
            nn.BatchNorm1d(512),
            nn.Dropout(0.3),
        )
        self.classifier = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(256 + 512, 512),
            nn.ReLU(),
            nn.BatchNorm1d(512),
            nn.Dropout(0.3),
            nn.Linear(512, num_classes),
        )

    def forward(self, img, tab):
        img_feat = self.cnn(img)
        tab_feat = self.dnn(tab)
        combined = torch.cat([img_feat, tab_feat], 1)
        return self.classifier(combined)


# Data loading and preprocessing
train_df = pd.read_csv("./input/train.csv", dtype={"id": str})
test_df = pd.read_csv("./input/test.csv", dtype={"id": str})

# Create validation split
train_indices, val_indices = train_test_split(
    np.arange(len(train_df)),
    test_size=0.2,
    stratify=train_df["species"],
    random_state=42,
)
train_data = train_df.iloc[train_indices]
val_data = train_df.iloc[val_indices]

# Feature scaling
scaler = StandardScaler()
feature_cols = [c for c in train_df.columns if c not in ["id", "species"]]
X_train_tab = scaler.fit_transform(train_data[feature_cols])
X_val_tab = scaler.transform(val_data[feature_cols])
X_test_tab = scaler.transform(test_df[feature_cols])

# Label encoding
le = LabelEncoder()
y_train = le.fit_transform(train_data["species"])
y_val = le.transform(val_data["species"])

# Enhanced image transforms with higher resolution and advanced augmentations
transform = transforms.Compose(
    [
        transforms.Grayscale(),
        transforms.Resize((256, 256)),
        transforms.RandomAffine(
            degrees=20, translate=(0.1, 0.1), scale=(0.8, 1.2), shear=10
        ),
        transforms.RandomHorizontalFlip(),
        transforms.RandomVerticalFlip(),
        transforms.RandomApply([transforms.GaussianBlur(3)], p=0.5),
        transforms.RandomResizedCrop(224, scale=(0.7, 1.0)),
        transforms.ColorJitter(brightness=0.2, contrast=0.2),
        transforms.ToTensor(),
        transforms.Normalize([0.5], [0.5]),
    ]
)


class PlantDataset(Dataset):
    def __init__(self, df, tabular, labels=None):
        self.df = df
        self.tabular = tabular
        self.labels = labels
        self.transform = transform

    def __len__(self):
        return len(self.df)

    def __getitem__(self, idx):
        img_id = str(int(float(self.df.iloc[idx]["id"])))
        img = Image.open(f"./input/images/{img_id}.jpg").convert("L")
        tab = torch.tensor(self.tabular[idx].astype(np.float32))
        if self.labels is not None:
            return self.transform(img), tab, torch.tensor(self.labels[idx])
        return self.transform(img), tab


device = torch.device("cuda" if torch.cuda.is_available() else "cpu")
model = MultiModalNet(X_train_tab.shape[1], len(le.classes_)).to(device)
optimizer = optim.AdamW(model.parameters(), lr=0.0005, weight_decay=1e-4)
scheduler = optim.lr_scheduler.ReduceLROnPlateau(
    optimizer, "min", factor=0.5, patience=7
)
scaler = GradScaler()
mixup_alpha = 0.4

# Data loaders with increased workers
train_loader = DataLoader(
    PlantDataset(train_data, X_train_tab, y_train),
    batch_size=32,
    shuffle=True,
    num_workers=8,
    pin_memory=True,
    persistent_workers=True,
)
val_loader = DataLoader(
    PlantDataset(val_data, X_val_tab, y_val),
    batch_size=64,
    num_workers=8,
    pin_memory=True,
    persistent_workers=True,
)

best_logloss = float("inf")

for epoch in range(100):
    model.train()
    for img, tab, y in train_loader:
        img, tab, y = img.to(device), tab.to(device), y.to(device)

        with autocast():
            # Mixup augmentation
            lam = np.random.beta(mixup_alpha, mixup_alpha)
            idx = torch.randperm(img.size(0))
            mixed_img = lam * img + (1 - lam) * img[idx]
            mixed_tab = lam * tab + (1 - lam) * tab[idx]
            y_a, y_b = y, y[idx]

            optimizer.zero_grad()
            outputs = model(mixed_img, mixed_tab)

            y_a_oh = F.one_hot(y_a, num_classes=len(le.classes_)).float()
            y_b_oh = F.one_hot(y_b, num_classes=len(le.classes_)).float()
            mixed_labels = lam * y_a_oh + (1 - lam) * y_b_oh

            loss = F.kl_div(
                F.log_softmax(outputs, dim=1), mixed_labels, reduction="batchmean"
            )

        scaler.scale(loss).backward()
        scaler.step(optimizer)
        scaler.update()

    # Validation
    model.eval()
    val_preds, val_true = [], []
    with torch.no_grad():
        for img, tab, y in val_loader:
            img, tab = img.to(device), tab.to(device)
            outputs = model(img, tab)
            val_preds.append(torch.softmax(outputs, 1).cpu())
            val_true.append(y.cpu())

    val_logloss = log_loss(np.concatenate(val_true), np.concatenate(val_preds))
    scheduler.step(val_logloss)
    print(f"Epoch {epoch+1}: Val LogLoss {val_logloss:.4f}")

    if val_logloss < best_logloss:
        best_logloss = val_logloss
        torch.save(model.state_dict(), "./working/best_model.pt")

# Generate submission
test_loader = DataLoader(
    PlantDataset(test_df, X_test_tab, labels=None),
    batch_size=64,
    num_workers=8,
    pin_memory=True,
)

model.load_state_dict(torch.load("./working/best_model.pt"))
model.eval()
test_preds = []
with torch.no_grad():
    for img, tab in test_loader:
        img, tab = img.to(device), tab.to(device)
        outputs = model(img, tab)
        test_preds.append(torch.softmax(outputs, 1).cpu())

probs = torch.cat(test_preds).numpy()
probs = probs / probs.sum(axis=1, keepdims=True)
probs = np.clip(probs, 1e-15, 1 - 1e-15)

submission = pd.DataFrame(probs, columns=le.classes_)
submission.insert(0, "id", test_df.id.astype(int))
submission.to_csv("./submission/submission.csv", index=False)

print(f"Best Validation LogLoss: {best_logloss:.4f}")

class TabularTransformer(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, input_dim, embed_dim=128, num_heads=8, num_layers=3):
        super().__init__()
        self.embed = nn.Linear(input_dim, embed_dim)
        self.cls_token = nn.Parameter(torch.randn(1, 1, embed_dim))
        encoder_layer = nn.TransformerEncoderLayer(
            d_model=embed_dim, nhead=num_heads, dim_feedforward=512, dropout=0.2
        )
        self.transformer = nn.TransformerEncoder(encoder_layer, num_layers=num_layers)
        self.proj = nn.Sequential(nn.Linear(embed_dim, 512), nn.GELU())

    def forward(self, x):
        x = self.embed(x)  # (B, N) -> (B, E)
        cls_tokens = self.cls_token.expand(x.size(0), -1, -1)
        x = x.unsqueeze(1)  # (B, E) -> (B, 1, E)
        x = torch.cat([cls_tokens, x], dim=1)
        x = self.transformer(x)
        return self.proj(x[:, 0])


class MultiModalNet(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, tab_size, num_classes):
        super().__init__()
        self.cnn = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Conv2d(1, 64, kernel_size=7, stride=2, padding=3, bias=False),
            nn.BatchNorm2d(64),
            nn.ReLU(inplace=True),
            nn.MaxPool2d(3, 2, 1),
            nn.Sequential(*[ResidualBlock(64, 64) for _ in range(3)]),
            nn.AdaptiveAvgPool2d(1),
            nn.Flatten(),
        )
        self.tab_transformer = TabularTransformer(tab_size)
        self.cross_attn = nn.MultiheadAttention(512, 8, dropout=0.2)
        self.classifier = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(1024, 512),
            nn.GELU(),
            nn.Dropout(0.3),
            nn.Linear(512, num_classes),
        )

    def forward(self, img, tab):
        img_feat = self.cnn(img).unsqueeze(0)  # (B, 512) -> (1, B, 512)
        tab_feat = self.tab_transformer(tab).unsqueeze(0)  # (1, B, 512)
        attn_out, _ = self.cross_attn(img_feat, tab_feat, tab_feat)
        combined = torch.cat([attn_out.squeeze(0), tab_feat.squeeze(0)], dim=1)

class LeafDataset(Dataset):
    def __init__(self, tabular_data, ids, labels=None, transform=None):
        self.tabular = tabular_data
        self.ids = ids
        self.labels = labels
        self.transform = transform

    def __len__(self):
        return len(self.ids)

    def __getitem__(self, idx):
        img = Image.open(f"input/images/{self.ids[idx]}.jpg").convert("RGB")
        if self.transform:
            img = self.transform(img)
        tab = torch.FloatTensor(self.tabular[idx])
        return (
            (tab, img, self.labels[idx])
            if self.labels is not None
            else (tab, img, self.ids[idx])
        )


class LeafClassifier(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, num_classes):
        super().__init__()
        self.effnet = models.efficientnet_b4(pretrained=True)
        self.effnet.classifier = nn.Identity()

        self.tab_net = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(192, 512),
            nn.BatchNorm1d(512),
            nn.GELU(),
            nn.Dropout(0.3),
            nn.Linear(512, 512),
            nn.BatchNorm1d(512),
            nn.GELU(),
            nn.Dropout(0.3),
        )

        self.classifier = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(1792 + 512, 1024),
            nn.BatchNorm1d(1024),
            nn.GELU(),
            nn.Dropout(0.5),
            nn.Linear(1024, num_classes),
        )

    def forward(self, tab, img):
        img_feat = self.effnet(img)
        tab_feat = self.tab_net(tab)
        return self.classifier(torch.cat([img_feat, tab_feat], dim=1))

def smooth_cross_entropy(logits, targets, smoothing=0.1):
    num_classes = logits.size(-1)
    one_hot = torch.zeros_like(logits).scatter_(1, targets.unsqueeze(1), 1)
    smoothed_labels = one_hot * (1 - smoothing) + (1 - one_hot) * smoothing / (
        num_classes - 1
    )
    log_probs = torch.nn.functional.log_softmax(logits, dim=-1)
    return torch.mean(-torch.sum(smoothed_labels * log_probs, dim=-1))

        )

        self.branch2 = ResidualBranch(64, 256)

        self.attention = TransformerEncoderLayer(
            d_model=256,
            nhead=8,
            dim_feedforward=1024,

            activation="gelu",

        )
        self.attn_norm = nn.LayerNorm(256)

        )

        features = torch.stack([x1, x2, x3], dim=1)

        weighted = attended.view(attended.size(0), -1)

import os

from torch.utils.data import DataLoader, TensorDataset
import torchvision.models as models
from torchvision import transforms
from PIL import Image


def smooth_cross_entropy(logits, targets, smoothing=0.1):
    num_classes = logits.size(-1)
    one_hot = torch.zeros_like(logits).scatter_(1, targets.unsqueeze(1), 1)
    smoothed_labels = one_hot * (1 - smoothing) + (1 - one_hot) * smoothing / (
        num_classes - 1
    )
    log_probs = torch.nn.functional.log_softmax(logits, dim=-1)
    return torch.mean(-torch.sum(smoothed_labels * log_probs, dim=-1))


def extract_image_features_batch(image_paths, model, batch_size=32):
    preprocess = transforms.Compose(
        [
            transforms.Resize(256),
            transforms.CenterCrop(224),
            transforms.ToTensor(),
            transforms.Normalize(mean=[0.485, 0.456, 0.406], std=[0.229, 0.224, 0.225]),
        ]
    )
    features = []
    for i in range(0, len(image_paths), batch_size):
        batch_paths = image_paths[i : i + batch_size]
        batch_images = []
        for path in batch_paths:
            img = Image.open(path).convert("RGB")
            img = preprocess(img)
            batch_images.append(img)
        batch_tensor = torch.stack(batch_images).to(device)
        with torch.no_grad():
            batch_features = model(batch_tensor)
        batch_features = (
            batch_features.squeeze().cpu().numpy().reshape(len(batch_images), -1)
        )
        features.extend(batch_features)
    return np.array(features)


# Initialize device and image feature extractor
device = torch.device("cuda" if torch.cuda.is_available() else "cpu")
image_model = models.efficientnet_b0(pretrained=True)
image_model = nn.Sequential(*list(image_model.children())[:-1]).to(device)

test_image_features = extract_image_features_batch(test_image_paths, image_model)

margin = [f"margin{i}" for i in range(1, 65)]

X_test_raw = np.hstack([X_test_base, test_image_features])

le = LabelEncoder()

class ResidualBranch(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, input_dim, hidden_dim):
        super().__init__()
        self.block = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(input_dim, hidden_dim),
            nn.LayerNorm(hidden_dim),
            nn.GELU(),
            nn.Dropout(0.3),
            nn.Linear(hidden_dim, hidden_dim),
            nn.LayerNorm(hidden_dim),
        )
        self.shortcut = nn.Linear(input_dim, hidden_dim)

    def forward(self, x):
        return nn.functional.gelu(self.block(x) + self.shortcut(x))


class LeafClassifier(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__()
        self.branch1 = ResidualBranch(64, 256)
        self.branch2 = ResidualBranch(64, 256)
        self.branch3 = ResidualBranch(64, 256)
        self.branch4 = ResidualBranch(1280, 256)

        self.attention = TransformerEncoderLayer(
            d_model=256,
            nhead=8,
            dim_feedforward=1024,
            dropout=0.1,
            activation="gelu",
            batch_first=True,
        )
        self.attn_norm = nn.LayerNorm(256)

        self.head = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(1024, 512),
            nn.LayerNorm(512),
            nn.GELU(),
            nn.Dropout(0.5),
            nn.Linear(512, 99),
        )

    def forward(self, x):
        x1 = self.branch1(x[:, :64])
        x2 = self.branch2(x[:, 64:128])
        x3 = self.branch3(x[:, 128:192])
        x4 = self.branch4(x[:, 192 : 192 + 1280])

        features = torch.stack([x1, x2, x3, x4], dim=1)
        attended = self.attention(features)
        attended = self.attn_norm(attended)
        weighted = attended.view(attended.size(0), -1)
        return self.head(weighted)

test_probs = []

    model = LeafClassifier().to(device)

        TensorDataset(torch.FloatTensor(X_train), torch.LongTensor(y_train)),
        batch_size=32,
        shuffle=True,
        num_workers=4,
        pin_memory=True,
    )

    best_loss = np.inf
    patience = 0
    for epoch in range(100):
        model.train()
        for inputs, targets in train_loader:
            inputs, targets = inputs.to(device), targets.to(device)
            optimizer.zero_grad()
            outputs = model(inputs)
            loss = smooth_cross_entropy(outputs, targets, 0.1)
            loss.backward()
            nn.utils.clip_grad_norm_(model.parameters(), 1.0)
            optimizer.step()
        scheduler.step()

        model.eval()
        with torch.no_grad():
            val_preds = torch.softmax(model(torch.FloatTensor(X_val).to(device)), 1)
            val_loss = log_loss(y_val, val_preds.cpu().numpy())

    # Test-time augmentation

    fold_score = log_loss(y_val, val_preds.cpu().numpy())
    val_scores.append(fold_score)
    print(f"Fold {fold} Val Log Loss: {fold_score:.4f}")

# Model architecture remains unchanged
class TabularModel(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, input_size, num_classes):
        super().__init__()
        self.net = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(input_size, 512),
            nn.BatchNorm1d(512),
            nn.GELU(),
            nn.Dropout(0.3),
            nn.Linear(512, 256),
            nn.BatchNorm1d(256),
            nn.GELU(),
            nn.Dropout(0.2),
            nn.Linear(256, num_classes),
        )

        return self.net(x)

scheduler = optim.lr_scheduler.ReduceLROnPlateau(optimizer, "min", patience=3)

# Label smoothing parameters
epsilon = 0.1
best_logloss = float("inf")
patience = 5
epochs_no_improve = 0

for epoch in range(100):
    model.train()
    for inputs, labels in train_loader:
        inputs, labels = inputs.to(device), labels.to(device)
        optimizer.zero_grad()
        outputs = model(inputs)

        log_probs = torch.log_softmax(outputs, dim=1)
        y_onehot = torch.zeros_like(outputs).scatter(1, labels.unsqueeze(1), 1)
        y_smoothed = y_onehot * (1 - epsilon) + epsilon / num_classes
        loss = (-y_smoothed * log_probs).sum(dim=1).mean()

        loss.backward()
        optimizer.step()

    # Validation remains with original labels

    val_probs, val_labels = [], []
    with torch.no_grad():

    val_probs = torch.cat(val_probs).numpy()
    val_labels = torch.cat(val_labels).numpy()
    current_logloss = log_loss(val_labels, val_probs)
    scheduler.step(current_logloss)

    print(f"Epoch {epoch+1:2d} | Val LogLoss: {current_logloss:.4f}")

    if current_logloss < best_logloss:
        best_logloss = current_logloss
        torch.save(model.state_dict(), "./working/best_model.pt")
        epochs_no_improve = 0
    else:
        epochs_no_improve += 1
        if epochs_no_improve >= patience:
            print(f"Early stopping at epoch {epoch+1}")
            break

# Generate final submission

class GatedFusionNet(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__()
        self.tabular = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(192, 512), nn.BatchNorm1d(512), nn.SiLU(), nn.Dropout(0.5)
        )
        self.cnn = efficientnet_b0(pretrained=True)
        self.cnn.avgpool = nn.Identity()
        self.cnn.classifier = nn.Identity()
        self.img_proj = nn.Conv2d(1280, 512, kernel_size=1)
        self.img_pool = nn.AdaptiveAvgPool2d(1)
        self.gate = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(1024, 512),
            nn.BatchNorm1d(512),
            nn.SiLU(),
            nn.Linear(512, 2),
            nn.Softmax(dim=1),
        )
        self.classifier = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(1536, 1024),
            nn.LayerNorm(1024),
            nn.SiLU(),
            nn.Dropout(0.6),
            nn.Linear(1024, 99),
        )

    def forward(self, x_tab, x_img):
        tab_features = self.tabular(x_tab)
        img_features = self.cnn.features(x_img)
        img_features = self.img_proj(img_features)
        img_features = self.img_pool(img_features).squeeze(-1).squeeze(-1)
        combined = torch.cat([tab_features, img_features], dim=1)
        gate_weights = self.gate(combined).unsqueeze(-1)
        fused_features = (
            gate_weights[:, 0] * tab_features + gate_weights[:, 1] * img_features
        )
        fused_features = torch.cat([fused_features, combined], dim=1)
        return self.classifier(fused_features)


device = torch.device("cuda")
epochs = 50
batch_size = 32
n_splits = 5
n_tta = 5

tta_transforms = [
    transforms.RandomHorizontalFlip(p=1.0),
    transforms.RandomVerticalFlip(p=1.0),
    transforms.RandomRotation(degrees=15),
    transforms.RandomRotation(degrees=(-15, 15)),
    transforms.Lambda(lambda x: x),
]

skf = StratifiedKFold(n_splits=n_splits, shuffle=True, random_state=42)
test_probs = []
val_scores = []

for fold, (train_idx, val_idx) in enumerate(skf.split(train, y)):
    scaler = StandardScaler().fit(train.iloc[train_idx][features])

    train_fold = train.iloc[train_idx].copy()
    val_fold = train.iloc[val_idx].copy()
    test_fold = test.copy()

    for df in [train_fold, val_fold, test_fold]:
        df[features] = scaler.transform(df[features])

    train_ds = LeafDataset(train_fold, "input/images", transform=train_transform)
    val_ds = LeafDataset(val_fold, "input/images", transform=base_test_transform)
    test_ds = LeafDataset(
        test_fold, "input/images", is_test=True, transform=base_test_transform
    )

    train_loader = DataLoader(
        train_ds, batch_size=batch_size, shuffle=True, num_workers=8, pin_memory=True
    )
    val_loader = DataLoader(
        val_ds, batch_size=batch_size, num_workers=8, pin_memory=True
    )
    test_loader = DataLoader(
        test_ds, batch_size=batch_size, num_workers=8, pin_memory=True
    )

    model = GatedFusionNet().to(device)
    optimizer = optim.AdamW(
        [
            {"params": model.cnn.parameters(), "lr": 1e-5},
            {"params": model.tabular.parameters(), "lr": 1e-4},
            {"params": model.classifier.parameters(), "lr": 1e-4},
            {"params": model.gate.parameters(), "lr": 1e-4},
            {"params": model.img_proj.parameters(), "lr": 1e-4},
        ],
        weight_decay=1e-3,
    )

    scheduler = optim.lr_scheduler.CosineAnnealingWarmRestarts(optimizer, T_0=10)
    criterion = nn.CrossEntropyLoss(label_smoothing=0.2)
    scaler = GradScaler()

    best_loss = np.inf
    for epoch in range(epochs):
        model.train()
        for tab, img, y_batch in train_loader:
            tab, img, y_batch = tab.to(device), img.to(device), y_batch.to(device)
            optimizer.zero_grad()
            with autocast():
                outputs = model(tab, img)
                loss = criterion(outputs, y_batch)
            scaler.scale(loss).backward()
            scaler.unscale_(optimizer)
            nn.utils.clip_grad_norm_(model.parameters(), 1.0)
            scaler.step(optimizer)
            scaler.update()
        scheduler.step()

        model.eval()
        val_loss = 0
        with torch.no_grad():
            for tab, img, y_batch in val_loader:
                tab, img, y_batch = tab.to(device), img.to(device), y_batch.to(device)
                outputs = model(tab, img)
                val_loss += criterion(outputs, y_batch).item() * len(y_batch)
        val_loss /= len(val_ds)
        if val_loss < best_loss:
            best_loss = val_loss
            torch.save(model.state_dict(), f"working/best_fold{fold}.pt")

    model.load_state_dict(torch.load(f"working/best_fold{fold}.pt"))
    model.eval()

    val_probs, val_true = [], []
    with torch.no_grad():
        for tab, img, y_batch in val_loader:
            tab, img = tab.to(device), img.to(device)
            outputs = model(tab, img)
            val_probs.append(torch.softmax(outputs, 1).cpu().numpy())
            val_true.append(y_batch.cpu().numpy())
    val_score = log_loss(np.concatenate(val_true), np.concatenate(val_probs))
    val_scores.append(val_score)
    print(f"Fold {fold} Val Log Loss: {val_score:.4f}")

    fold_probs = []
    with torch.no_grad():
        for tab, img in test_loader:
            tta_images = []
            for single_img in img:
                augmented_imgs = [tf(single_img) for tf in tta_transforms]
                tta_images.extend(augmented_imgs)
            tta_images = torch.stack(tta_images).to(device)
            tta_tab = tab.repeat_interleave(n_tta, dim=0).to(device)
            outputs = model(tta_tab, tta_images)
            outputs = outputs.view(tab.size(0), n_tta, -1)
            avg_outputs = outputs.mean(dim=1)
            fold_probs.append(torch.softmax(avg_outputs, 1).cpu().numpy())
    test_probs.append(np.concatenate(fold_probs))

final_probs = np.mean(test_probs, axis=0)
submission = pd.DataFrame(final_probs, columns=le.classes_)
submission.insert(0, "id", test["id"])
submission.to_csv("submission/submission.csv", index=False)

print(f"Mean Val Log Loss: {np.mean(val_scores):.4f} ± {np.std(val_scores):.4f}")

test_df = pd.read_csv("./input/test.csv")

features = train_df.filter(regex="margin|shape|texture").columns
X = train_df[features].values
y = train_df["species"].values
test_X = test_df[features].values

le = LabelEncoder()

X_train, X_val, y_train, y_val = train_test_split(

)

scaler = StandardScaler()

X_val = scaler.transform(X_val)
test_X = scaler.transform(test_X)

)
val_loader = DataLoader(val_dataset, batch_size=batch_size, num_workers=4)
test_loader = DataLoader(test_dataset, batch_size=batch_size, num_workers=4)


class BranchedModel(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, num_classes):
        super().__init__()
        # Feature group processing branches
        self.margin_net = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(64, 128),
            nn.BatchNorm1d(128),
            nn.GELU(),
            nn.Dropout(0.3),
            nn.Linear(128, 128),
        )
        self.shape_net = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(64, 128),
            nn.BatchNorm1d(128),
            nn.GELU(),
            nn.Dropout(0.3),
            nn.Linear(128, 128),
        )
        self.texture_net = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(64, 128),
            nn.BatchNorm1d(128),
            nn.GELU(),
            nn.Dropout(0.3),
            nn.Linear(128, 128),
        )

        # Combined classifier
        self.classifier = nn.Sequential(
            nn.BatchNorm1d(384),
            nn.Linear(384, 256),
            nn.GELU(),
            nn.Dropout(0.2),
            nn.Linear(256, num_classes),
        )

    def forward(self, x):
        margin = x[:, :64]
        shape = x[:, 64:128]
        texture = x[:, 128:]

        margin_out = self.margin_net(margin)
        shape_out = self.shape_net(shape)
        texture_out = self.texture_net(texture)

        combined = torch.cat([margin_out, shape_out, texture_out], dim=1)
        return self.classifier(combined)


device = torch.device("cuda" if torch.cuda.is_available() else "cpu")
model = BranchedModel(num_classes).to(device)
optimizer = optim.AdamW(model.parameters(), lr=0.001, weight_decay=0.01)
scheduler = optim.lr_scheduler.ReduceLROnPlateau(optimizer, "min", patience=3)

epsilon = 0.1
best_logloss = float("inf")
patience = 5
epochs_no_improve = 0

for epoch in range(100):
    model.train()
    for inputs, labels in train_loader:
        inputs, labels = inputs.to(device), labels.to(device)
        optimizer.zero_grad()
        outputs = model(inputs)

        log_probs = torch.log_softmax(outputs, dim=1)
        y_onehot = torch.zeros_like(outputs).scatter(1, labels.unsqueeze(1), 1)
        y_smoothed = y_onehot * (1 - epsilon) + epsilon / num_classes
        loss = (-y_smoothed * log_probs).sum(dim=1).mean()

        loss.backward()
        optimizer.step()

    model.eval()
    val_probs, val_labels = [], []
    with torch.no_grad():
        for inputs, labels in val_loader:
            inputs = inputs.to(device)
            outputs = model(inputs)
            probs = torch.softmax(outputs, dim=1)
            val_probs.append(probs.cpu())
            val_labels.append(labels.cpu())

    val_probs = torch.cat(val_probs).numpy()
    val_labels = torch.cat(val_labels).numpy()
    current_logloss = log_loss(val_labels, val_probs)
    scheduler.step(current_logloss)

    print(f"Epoch {epoch+1:2d} | Val LogLoss: {current_logloss:.4f}")

    if current_logloss < best_logloss:
        best_logloss = current_logloss
        torch.save(model.state_dict(), "./working/best_model.pt")
        epochs_no_improve = 0
    else:
        epochs_no_improve += 1
        if epochs_no_improve >= patience:
            print(f"Early stopping at epoch {epoch+1}")
            break

model.load_state_dict(torch.load("./working/best_model.pt"))
model.eval()

test_probs = []
with torch.no_grad():
    for inputs in test_loader:
        inputs = inputs[0].to(device)
        outputs = model(inputs)
        probs = torch.softmax(outputs, dim=1)
        test_probs.append(probs.cpu())

submission.to_csv("./submission/submission.csv", index=False)

print(f"Best Validation LogLoss: {best_logloss:.4f}")

def scale_features(df, fit=False):

class LeafDataset(Dataset):
    def __init__(self, features, ids, labels=None, transform=None):
        self.features = features.astype(np.float32)
        self.ids = ids
        self.labels = labels
        self.transform = transform or transforms.Compose(
            [
                transforms.Resize(256),
                transforms.CenterCrop(224),
                transforms.ToTensor(),
                transforms.Normalize(

        if self.transform:
            img = self.transform(img)

        return features, img

class LeafClassifier(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, num_classes):
        super().__init__()
        self.margin_net = self._create_branch(64)
        self.shape_net = self._create_branch(64)
        self.texture_net = self._create_branch(64)
        self.resnet = nn.Sequential(
            *list(models.resnet18(pretrained=True).children())[:-1]
        )
        for param in self.resnet.parameters():
            param.requires_grad = False
        self.image_net = self._create_branch(512, 256)
        self.classifier = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(256 * 4, 512),
            nn.BatchNorm1d(512),
            nn.GELU(),
            nn.Dropout(0.5),
            nn.Linear(512, num_classes),
        )

    def _create_branch(self, input_dim, output_dim=256):
        return nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(input_dim, output_dim),
            nn.BatchNorm1d(output_dim),
            nn.GELU(),
            nn.Dropout(0.3),
            nn.Linear(output_dim, output_dim),
            nn.BatchNorm1d(output_dim),
            nn.GELU(),
            nn.Dropout(0.3),
        )

    def forward(self, x_tab, x_img=None):
        if x_img is None:  # Handle BN update case
            x_img = torch.zeros(x_tab.shape[0], 3, 224, 224).to(x_tab.device)

        margin = self.margin_net(x_tab[:, :64])
        shape = self.shape_net(x_tab[:, 64:128])
        texture = self.texture_net(x_tab[:, 128:192])
        img_feat = self.resnet(x_img).flatten(1)
        img_feat = self.image_net(img_feat)
        combined = torch.cat([margin, shape, texture, img_feat], dim=1)
        return self.classifier(combined)


model = LeafClassifier(len(species_columns)).to(device)

class LeafDataset(Dataset):
    def __init__(self, tabular_data, ids, labels=None, transform=None):
        self.tabular = tabular_data

            if self.labels is not None

        )


class LeafClassifier(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, num_classes):
        super().__init__()
        self.effnet = models.efficientnet_b0(pretrained=True)
        self.effnet.classifier = nn.Identity()

        self.tab_net = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(192, 384),
            nn.BatchNorm1d(384),
            nn.SiLU(),
            nn.Dropout(0.3),
            nn.Linear(384, 384),
            nn.BatchNorm1d(384),
            nn.SiLU(),
            nn.Dropout(0.3),
        )

        self.classifier = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(1280 + 384, 768),
            nn.BatchNorm1d(768),
            nn.SiLU(),
            nn.Dropout(0.4),
            nn.Linear(768, num_classes),
        )

    def forward(self, tab, img):
        img_feat = self.effnet(img)
        tab_feat = self.tab_net(tab)
        return self.classifier(torch.cat([img_feat, tab_feat], dim=1))


def mixup_data(x, y, alpha=0.2):
    if alpha > 0:
        lam = np.random.beta(alpha, alpha)
    else:
        lam = 1

    batch_size = x.size()[0]
    index = torch.randperm(batch_size).to(x.device)

    mixed_x = lam * x + (1 - lam) * x[index]
    y_a, y_b = y, y[index]
    return mixed_x, y_a, y_b, lam

        mixed_img, y_a, y_b, lam = mixup_data(img, y, alpha=0.3)

        optimizer.zero_grad()
        with torch.cuda.amp.autocast():
            logits = model(tab, mixed_img)
            loss = lam * criterion(logits, y_a) + (1 - lam) * criterion(logits, y_b)

        loss.backward()
        optimizer.step()
    scheduler.step()

    model.eval()

    with torch.no_grad():
